triage.triage_reason: 個人の観光客の一症例報告であり、公衆衛生上の深刻な影響や異常性、国際的拡大リスクは認められず、タイ当局も新たな規制を導入していないため既知の季節的増加の範囲内と判断される。
triage.notes: COVID-19は既知の疾患であり、季節性の増加として当局が認識済み。個人旅行者の一事例であり、集団感染や医療体制逼迫の情報はない。

article.articleHeadline: Российская туристка тяжело заболела ковидом в Таиланде
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: A Russian tourist fell severely ill with COVID-19 in Thailand.
article.articleSummary: 27-year-old female tourist from Ivanovo, Russia, fell severely ill with COVID-19 while vacationing in Phuket, Thailand. She reported anosmia, high fever, and breathing difficulty; initial fever was followed by chest tightness. Local doctors prescribed medications and instructed ongoing monitoring of blood oxygen saturation, with hospitalization advised if saturation falls. She suspects infection occurred at public places on the island, with an outbreak affecting shop and hotel staff, many of whom continue working. Phuket hospital data indicate a surge, recording 64 new COVID-19 cases in the last week of August. The uptick raises concerns for Russian tourists with trips booked through year-end, with tour operators noting potential disruptions and some travelers cutting vacations short to continue treatment at home.

triage.headline_ja: タイでロシア人観光客がCOVID-19に重症化
triage.triage_reason: 個別重症例に加え、プーケットでの直近1週間で64件の新規COVID-19症例急増が報告されており、観光客・スタッフへの感染拡大懸念と社会的関心（旅行会社の対応等）が確認されるため。
triage.notes: ロシア（Ivanovo）は対象国リストに含まれないため除外。プーケットでの症例増加は現地病院データに基づくが、公式な流行宣言や渡航制限の情報はなし。続報でプーケットの感染状況の推移を確認する必要あり。

article.articleHeadline: राजकोट नगर निगम ने ड्रोन और एआई की मदद से लगाया मच्छरों के पनपने की 4,731 संभावित जगहों की पता, किया छिड़काव - Punjab Kesari
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Rajkot Municipal Corporation used drones and AI to locate 4,731 potential mosquito-breeding sites and carried out spraying.
article.articleSummary: Rajkot Municipal Corporation (RMC) deployed drone-based surveys and AI-assisted surveillance to curb dengue, malaria, and chikungunya in Rajkot. In 59.39 km2, officials identified 4,731 potential mosquito-breeding sites, from 161.85 km2 surveyed to date. Field staff sprayed at 1,340 sites; drones contributed 40 hours 9 minutes of spraying. The operation targets high-risk wards 11, 18, 3, 4, and 13. Data from drone findings are shared with ward health centers for follow-up and spraying as needed. Traditional controls ran 17–23 September 2026: larviciding in 150,172 houses and fogging in 933 houses. Inspections covered 409 non-residential sites; 312 residential and 92 commercial notices were issued. Urban PHC teams monitored waterborne diseases; 304,556 people were surveyed, with 6,559 chlorine tablets, 743 ORS packets, and 3,484 RC tests conducted. Residents are urged to eliminate standing water and cooperate with drone surveys.

triage.headline_ja: ラージコート市自治体、ドローンとAIを活用して蚊の発生源候補地4,731カ所を特定し防除作業を実施
triage.triage_reason: デング・マラリア・チクングニアに対する通常の予防的ベクター対策活動を報じる内容であり、異常な発生や公衆衛生上の深刻な影響を示す情報はない。
triage.notes: 記事は感染症の発生報告ではなく、自治体による予防的なベクター管理（ドローン・AI活用の蚊発生源調査・防除）に関する行政活動の報道。具体的な症例数や流行状況の記載はない。

article.articleHeadline: 90% trẻ sơ sinh nhiễm viêm gan B từ mẹ có thể thành bệnh mạn tính
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: 90% of newborns infected with hepatitis B from their mothers may become chronically infected.
article.articleSummary: HBV infection in a 32-year-old pregnant woman at 34 weeks in Hung Yen, Vietnam, deteriorating with fatigue and jaundice; admitted to Bach Mai Hospital in Hanoi. She has longstanding chronic hepatitis B; husband is also infected. At admission, hepatic jaundice, rising bilirubin and liver enzymes; prothrombin index 57% indicating coagulopathy. The case highlights the substantial risk of mother-to-child transmission (MTCT) and the high probability (85-90%) of chronic HBV infection in newborns when infected at birth, vs ~2-5% in adults. WHO/CDC guidance emphasize early identification and comprehensive management during pregnancy: screen for HBsAg, quantify HBV-DNA, evaluate liver function and fibrosis, and decide maternal therapy to reduce MTCT. Neonatal prophylaxis includes hepatitis B vaccine and HBIG within 24 hours of birth for infants of HBV-positive mothers; antiviral treatment during pregnancy may be indicated for high maternal viral load. Emphasizes continuous monitoring for mother and child and avoiding interruption of care.

triage.headline_ja: 新生児の90%が母親からB型肝炎に感染すると慢性化する可能性
triage.triage_reason: 個別症例に関する医療啓発記事であり、公衆衛生上の緊急事態や異常な流行を示す情報はない。母子感染予防に関する既知の医学的知見の紹介に留まる。
triage.notes: 単一の妊婦症例に基づく啓発記事であり、アウトブレイクや公衆衛生上の異常事象ではないため、対象国としてのイベント発生は認められない。

article.articleHeadline: Việt Nam bắt đầu tiêm vắc xin phòng tay chân miệng do EV71
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Vietnam begins vaccination against EV71-associated hand, foot and mouth disease.
article.articleSummary: Vietnam begins vaccination against EV71-associated hand, foot and mouth disease (HFMD) with Envacgen at nearly 300 VNVC centers nationwide. The vaccine is indicated for children aged 2 months to under 6 years, administered in 2 or 3 doses depending on start age. On its first day, VNVC centers reported tens of thousands of registrations. Envacgen was licensed in Vietnam in March 2026. It targets enterovirus EV71, a major HFMD cause linked to neurologic, respiratory, and cardiovascular complications in young children. Phase III trials conducted in Vietnam and Taiwan yielded an efficacy of 96.8% against EV71-related disease, results published in The Lancet. However, HFMD is caused by multiple viruses; vaccination reduces EV71-related disease but does not prevent HFMD entirely. Clinicians warn that HFMD can progress rapidly (6–8 hours). Transmission is mainly via saliva, blister fluid, or stool, with daycare exposure risk. Families should maintain hygiene and monitor closely after vaccination.

triage.headline_ja: ベトナムでEV71による手足口病の予防ワクチン接種が開始
triage.triage_reason: 既存のHFMD/EV71に対するワクチン接種プログラム開始の報道であり、新規アウトブレイクや異常な公衆衛生事象を示すものではない。
triage.notes: 台湾は第III相臨床試験の実施地として言及されているのみで、疾病発生地としては該当しないため対象国リストにないが、対象国リストにも台湾は含まれていない。記事はワクチン接種キャンペーンに関するもので、アウトブレイク情報ではない。

article.articleHeadline: Dehradun News: छात्र-छात्राओं को रेबीज संक्रमण के कारण, लक्षण और बचाव के उपायों की दी जानकारी
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Dehradun News: Information for Students on the Causes, Symptoms, and Prevention of Rabies Infection.
article.articleSummary: Rabies awareness program in Dehradun, Uttarakhand (Sept 22–28, 2026) highlighted causes, symptoms, and prevention. ANM Meena at Saraswati Shishu Mandir, Naugaonkhala, explained rabies transmission via bites or saliva from infected dogs or other animals, urging precautions and timely vaccination. Do not apply home remedies such as turmeric or chili to wounds, and do not seal wounds with tape or stitches. Wounds should be washed with soap and water, treated with antiseptic, and patients should seek prompt post-exposure vaccination as advised by a clinician. District Chief Medical Officer Dr. Meghna Aswal announced district-wide Rabies Awareness Week activities across medical facilities, schools, and communities to promote awareness and timely treatment after animal bites. Attendees included Principal Bhagwan Singh Negi and other officials.

triage.headline_ja: デヘラードゥーンニュース：学生に対し狂犬病感染の原因、症状、予防策についての情報提供
triage.triage_reason: 本記事は狂犬病啓発週間の教育プログラムに関する報道であり、実際の症例発生や公衆衛生上の緊急事態を示すものではない。
triage.notes: 記事は狂犬病予防啓発活動（Rabies Awareness Week）の報告であり、具体的な感染症例や発生状況の報告ではないため、シグナルとして扱わない。

article.articleHeadline: Kasus Influenza A Makin Marak, Pemkab Bandung Pantau Kenaikan Kasus ISPA dan ILI
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Influenza A cases on the rise, Bandung Regency Government monitors the increase in ARI and ILI cases.
article.articleSummary: Influenza A cases are being monitored in Bandung Regency, West Java, amid rising respiratory illnesses. Health authorities report a 53.3% increase in influenza-like illness (ILI) and a 36.38% rise in acute respiratory infections (ARIs/ISPA) over the past two weeks, based on the Dinkes SKDR surveillance. However, officials have not confirmed a surge in Influenza A, as no Polymerase Chain Reaction (PCR) testing is performed to identify the exact influenza strain. Regent Dadang Supriatna emphasizes prevention to curb transmission, including handwashing with soap (CTPS), cough etiquette, masking, PHBS adherence, and staying home when symptomatic, with prompt care if symptoms worsen. The health system includes 62 puskesmas and 18 government hospitals with 2,601 beds. Citizens are advised not to panic and to seek care if symptoms escalate.

triage.headline_ja: インフルエンザA型症例が増加、バンドン県政府がISPA（急性呼吸器感染症）とILI（インフルエンザ様疾患）の増加を監視
triage.triage_reason: インフルエンザ様疾患・急性呼吸器感染症の増加が報告されているが、PCR検査未実施で株の特定がなされておらず、重症度や国際的拡大の情報も不明なため、続報を注視する段階と判断。
triage.notes: ILIが53.3%、ISPAが36.38%増加と報告されているが、これは季節性変動の可能性もあり、PCR検査未実施のため実際の病原体・株は未確定。地方当局は通常の予防措置を推奨しており、パニックを避けるよう呼びかけている段階。

article.articleHeadline: Jangan Anggap Sepele Influenza, Bisa Picu Pneumonia
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Don't Underestimate Influenza; It Can Trigger Pneumonia.
article.articleSummary: Influenza type A infection can weaken the immune system and enable bacteria in the upper respiratory tract to invade the lungs, potentially causing pneumonia in Jakarta, Indonesia. Early symptoms resemble other acute respiratory infections, with high fever, sore throat, and dry cough, often mistaken for a common cold. Do not ignore persistent fever and cough lasting three days; seek medical evaluation promptly. Early testing with influenza antigen swab or PCR panels helps confirm etiology and guide therapy. Not all influenza patients require antiviral drugs; antivirals are reserved for those with clear indications or high-risk factors. Vulnerable groups include preschool children, 6–7-year-olds starting school, the elderly, and individuals with diabetes, cardiovascular disease, asthma, or COPD. Immunocompromised patients (autoimmune disease, cancer on chemotherapy, HIV) are also at higher risk of complications.

triage.headline_ja: インフルエンザを軽視してはいけない、肺炎を引き起こす可能性がある
triage.triage_reason: 一般的な健康啓発記事であり、特定のアウトブレイクや異常事態を報告するものではないため、シグナルとしての基準を満たさない。
triage.notes: 記事はインフルエンザと肺炎のリスクに関する一般的な医療啓発情報であり、特定の集団発生や統計データは含まれていない。

article.articleHeadline: Rajkot civic body uses drones, AI to map 4,731 mosquito breeding sites
article.articleSummary: Rajkot Municipal Corporation uses drones and AI-assisted surveillance to map 4,731 potential mosquito-breeding sites across 59.39 sq km in Rajkot, aiming to curb dengue, malaria and chikungunya. Of identified sites, 1,340 have been tackled by field teams; drones sprayed for 40 hours 9 minutes. Drone inspections focus on drains, waterlogged areas, pits and riverbed depressions where Aedes breeding can occur. Conventional measures continue: larviciding at 1,50,172 houses and fogging at 933 houses between Sept 17–23; vehicle-mounted fogging covers high-density areas and sensitive sites. Non-residential premises (409) inspected; 312 residential and 92 commercial notices issued for mosquito breeding, with administrative charges recovered. From Sept 17–23, about 3,04,556 people were covered; 6,559 chlorine tablets and 743 ORS packets distributed; 3,484 RC tests conducted. Residents urged to prevent standing water and cooperate with drone surveys and health teams.

triage.headline_ja: ラジコット市が蚊の発生源4,731箇所をドローンとAIでマッピング
triage.triage_reason: デング熱・マラリア・チクングニアの予防的な蚊対策活動に関する行政報告であり、異常な集団発生や重症例の急増は報告されていない。
triage.notes: 記事は感染症の発生報告ではなく、ラジコット市による予防的な蚊媒介病対策（ドローン・AI活用の発生源マッピング、薬剤散布、防疫活動）を紹介する内容。感染者数や症例の異常増加は言及されていない。

article.articleHeadline: Tuberculose tem 58 casos confirmados em Barretos
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Tuberculosis has 58 confirmed cases in Barretos.
article.articleSummary: Barretos, Brazil — 58 tuberculosis cases have been confirmed in 2026 as of September 23, up from 47 in the same period in 2025. The Municipal Health Secretariat is intensifying active case finding through September 30, with TB testing collected at the Postão health post and outreach across urban and rural basic health units (UBS), plus visits to homes and public spaces. Individuals with a cough lasting two weeks or more, fever, night sweats, fatigue, or unexplained weight loss are urged to seek evaluation at a health unit for testing. Early detection and continuous treatment are emphasized; treatment is provided free by the Unified Health System (SUS). After about 15 days on therapy, a patient who adheres to medical guidance is no longer contagious.

triage.headline_ja: バレトスで結核58例確認
triage.triage_reason: 単一自治体での結核症例数の増加報告であり、既知の疾患・地域的対応で管理可能なため、国際的な公衆衛生上の懸念や異常性は認められない。
triage.notes: 地方自治体レベルでの通常の症例増加報告であり、地方保健当局が能動的症例探知と無料治療提供により対応中。結核は既知の風土病であり突発的異常事態には該当しない。

article.articleHeadline: One dead after security forces open fire during Ebola burial in DRC, sources say
article.articleSummary: One person killed and several wounded when security forces opened fire to contain unrest during the burial of a suspected Ebola victim at Katula-Paida cemetery in Beni, North Kivu, DRC. Residents demanded to see the deceased and questioned whether the person had died from Ebola, prompting authorities escorting the burial team to intervene. Investigations are underway to establish the full toll and circumstances of the incident. The Ebola outbreak, declared on May 15, has infected 7,820 people and killed 3,779, according to government data released on Wednesday, underscoring persistent mistrust and a pattern of attacks on burial teams and responders in the region.

triage.headline_ja: DRCでエボラ埋葬時に治安部隊が発砲、1人死亡と情報筋
triage.triage_reason: DRCで進行中のエボラ流行（感染7,820人、死亡3,779人）に加え、埋葬妨害・治安部隊発砲という社会不安が発生しており、公衆衛生上の深刻さと管理可能性への懸念からフルRRAが必要。
triage.notes: 既存の大規模エボラ流行下での住民の不信感・埋葬チームへの攻撃という社会的緊張が新たに顕在化した事例。感染規模（7,820人感染、致死率約48%）が非常に大きく、既存流行の深刻度を示す。

article.articleHeadline: Похороны с силовиками: на похоронах жертвы Эболы в Конго открыли огонь по толпе
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Funeral with security forces: at the funeral of an Ebola victim in Congo, gunfire was opened on the crowd.
article.articleSummary: At the Katula-Paida cemetery in Beni, eastern Democratic Republic of Congo, security forces escorting a medical team opened fire during the funeral of a person with suspected Ebola on September 24, killing at least one person and wounding several; the final casualty count is under investigation. The deceased’s Ebola status was presumed. The melee followed crowds’ demand to see the body, challenging safety rules that require containment in a sealed bag and protective handling, though WHO guidance allows a safe viewing. The DRC’s Ebola outbreak, declared May 15, had 7,820 cases and 3,779 deaths as of September 23. Earlier incidents echo this pattern: in May, Rwampara residents demanded the body for private burial, police used tear gas and warning shots, two treatment tents burned, and 18 Ebola patients escaped isolation after an attack on another facility. In Ben, this is the first fatality among mourners in this flare-up.

triage.headline_ja: 武装部隊同行の葬儀：コンゴでエボラ被害者の葬儀中に群衆へ発砲
triage.triage_reason: DRCで継続中のエボラアウトブレイク（7,820症例、3,779死亡）に関連し、遺体の扱いを巡る住民との衝突・発砲事件が発生。感染制御への抵抗や隔離患者の逃走歴もあり、公衆衛生上の深刻性と国際的拡大リスクが高い。
triage.notes: 記事は葬儀での発砲事件を主軸としているが、背景にあるのはDRCで2026年5月15日に宣言され継続中のエボラアウトブレイクであり、既に大規模な公衆衛生危機として国際的関心が高い事案。ルワンダは文脈上言及されるが本イベントの主発生国はDRCのみ。

article.articleHeadline: Keralam child rights panel seeks report on measles deaths
article.articleSummary: Measles deaths in Malappuram district, Keralam, on Sep 25, 2026: two children aged 10 months (Valavannur) and 18 months (Ponmala) died within a week, with media reports indicating both were unvaccinated. The Keralam Commission for Child Rights directed the district medical officer and the district child protection officer to file reports and investigate whether other children in the district have not received the measles vaccine. Acting chairperson Cicily Joseph and member P Shajesh Bhaskar led the decision, underscoring vaccination as the health department's responsibility and calling for verification of immunization status among local children. The article does not specify laboratory confirmation. The move signals an official prompt to address potential vaccination gaps and to bolster disease surveillance in northern Malappuram.

triage.headline_ja: ケララ州児童権利委員会、麻疹による死亡事例について報告を要求
triage.triage_reason: 麻疹による小児死亡2件が未接種児で発生し、公的機関（児童権利委員会）が調査を指示するなど社会的・行政的関心が高まっているため、IHR基準（深刻性・異常性）を満たしフルRRAへの移行が妥当。
triage.notes: 実験室確認の有無は記事に明記されておらず不明。ワクチン未接種児の他事例調査が進行中であり、地域内での感染拡大可能性については続報が必要。

article.articleHeadline: US Pledges $267 Million More In Ebola Aid To Congo
article.articleSummary: US pledges an additional $267 million to fight the Ebola outbreak in Congo, bringing total U.S. aid to $887 million. The outbreak began in Ituri province, northeastern Congo, in May and has spread to Uganda; UN count as of Sept 22 records at least 3,700 deaths, making it the second-deadliest Ebola outbreak on record after 2014–2016 West Africa. The new funding satisfies a G7 commitment of up to $500 million and aims to bolster the UN's $2.13 billion response plan, which is only 48% funded, leaving about $1.1 billion unfunded. The aid complements U.S. support to OCHA; since early 2025, U.S. contributions to OCHA across 21 countries total about $3.8 billion. WHO declared PHEIC on May 17; as of Sept 16, transmission is declining in the epicenter but multiple outbreaks remain. No U.S. cases reported; risk to travelers remains low.

triage.headline_ja: 米国、コンゴのエボラ対策支援としてさらに2億6700万ドルを拠出
triage.triage_reason: エボラ出血熱の大規模アウトブレイクでWHOがPHEICを宣言済み、死者3,700人超、ウガンダへの越境拡大も確認されており、IHR基準を複数満たす。
triage.notes: ウガンダへの拡大が言及されているが、ウガンダは対象国リストに含まれないためverified_locationsには含めない。米国は資金拠出国であり発生国ではないため除外。既にPHEIC宣言済みでフルRRA継続対象と考えられる。

article.articleHeadline: Albay Cathedral helps fight dengue with 4 p.m. bell tolls
article.articleSummary: Legazpi City, Albay Province, Philippines — dengue fever is at the forefront of public health in Albay, where 1,785 dengue cases are cited. In response, the St. Gregory the Great Albay Cathedral will ring its bells for one minute at 4 p.m. daily to urge residents to clean surroundings and eliminate mosquito breeding sites. The initiative follows a request from the Albay Provincial Health Office and promotes the 'seek and destroy' strategy—taktak, taob, takip and tuyo—to prevent dengue spread by disposing of dirty and stagnant water. Priests will remind parishioners during Mass, and residents are encouraged to coordinate with barangay officials and other institutions for organized cleanup drives. The campaign coincides with the Season of Creation, and the bells will continue 'as long as it is needed' to reinforce cleanliness and orderliness.

triage.headline_ja: アルバイ大聖堂、午後4時の鐘でデング熱対策を後押し
triage.triage_reason: フィリピン・アルバイ州における季節性のデング熱流行に対する地域コミュニティの啓発活動を伝える記事であり、異常性や重篤性、国際的拡大リスクを示す情報がない。
triage.notes: デング熱はフィリピンで毎年季節的に発生する疾患であり、本記事は地域の予防啓発活動（教会の鐘を用いた清掃呼びかけ）を紹介する内容。症例数（1,785件）は示されているが、重症度や死亡者数など深刻性を示す情報はなく、フルリスク評価の必要性は低いと判断。

article.articleHeadline: Viral Menu MBG di Pati Berulat dan Ada Cacing, Plt Bupati Sidak SPPG
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: MBG's Viral Menu in Pati Infested with Maggots and Worms, Acting Regent Inspects SPPG.
article.articleSummary: On 25 September 2026 in Pati Regency, Central Java, Indonesia, MBG (free nutritious meals) distributed to students were found contaminated with live earthworms in parcels at MAN 1 Pati and leaf-worm larvae in spinach soup at SMK BTB Pati. Plt. Regent Risma Ardhi Chandra led surprise inspections of five School Food Service Programs (SPPG) in Cluwak district, revealing issues such as insufficient vegetable washing and substandard hygiene in food preparation facilities. Authorities plan regular checks of all 172 SPPG across Pati to prevent potential mass food poisoning and to sanction noncompliant providers, including temporary suspensions or license revocation. This followed a prior week incident in Gembong district linked to MBG. Officials emphasize strict supervision and corrective actions to ensure safe, nutritious meals for students.

triage.headline_ja: MBGの給食メニューが虫混入で炎上、代理県知事がSPPGを抜き打ち視察
triage.triage_reason: 牛結核として分類されているが、記事内容は学校給食への虫混入・衛生管理問題であり感染症の発生事例ではないため。
triage.notes: 疾患名（牛結核）とタグ付けは記事内容と一致していない。記事は給食の異物混入・衛生管理の問題を扱っており、感染症事例ではないためverified_locationsは空とした。

article.articleHeadline: मौसम बदलते ही पशुओं में बढ़ता है बीमारियों का खतरा, सफाई, खान-पान, टीकाकरण का दें ध्यान
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: As the weather changes, the risk of diseases in animals increases; pay attention to cleanliness, diet, and vaccination.
article.articleSummary: As weather fluctuations and sudden rain or cold intensify, animal health in Gonda, India is at increased risk. Veterinarians warn farmers to maintain cleanliness of housing, provide clean water and fresh, nutritious fodder, and shield animals from cold winds and dampness. Common seasonal risks include cold, fever, cough, and respiratory problems in livestock, alongside digestive issues from contaminated water or spoiled feed. Contagious mouth-and-hoof disease (foot-and-mouth disease) remains a concern, causing sores on the mouth and feet and capable of spreading to other animals through contact. Timely vaccination is essential; participate in department-led campaigns to immunize livestock. If a sick animal shows reduced appetite, lethargy, persistent cough, high fever, or breathing difficulty, isolate it and seek veterinary advice promptly. Regular monitoring and avoiding self-medication are advised by Dr. Rakesh Kumar Tiwari.

triage.headline_ja: 季節の変わり目に家畜の病気リスクが増加、清潔・食事・予防接種に注意
triage.triage_reason: 季節性の家畜飼育に関する一般的な予防啓発記事であり、具体的な口蹄疫発生や流行の報告がないため、公衆衛生上のシグナルとしての基準を満たさない。
triage.notes: 記事は獣医師による季節性動物疾患予防の一般的な助言記事であり、実際の口蹄疫発生報告や流行状況の記述はない。

article.articleHeadline: RDC : l'épidémie d'Ebola ne recule pas, elle se déplace, alerte MSF
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: DRC: The Ebola outbreak is not receding; it is moving, MSF warns.
article.articleSummary: Ebola outbreak in the Democratic Republic of Congo continues to expand rather than recede, MSF warns. Since its May declaration, the epidemic has reported over 7,200 confirmed cases and 3,500 deaths, with the real toll likely higher due to surveillance gaps. The virus is moving into new provinces: Sud-Ubangi is now the seventh affected province, and North Kivu accounts for about half of new cases with rising test positivity; undetected transmission chains are taking hold in major foci. In Ituri, the initial epicenter, activity appears slower, but national transmission persists. MSF rapid-response teams operationalize early detection, case management, infection prevention and control, contact tracing, surveillance, and community engagement to contain new foci before they escalate. In areas like Bambu, health systems are strained by underfunding, understaffing, and weak patient referral. A stronger international response, including vaccination and WHO support, is urgently needed.

triage.headline_ja: DRC：エボラ流行は後退せず、拡大している―MSFが警告
triage.triage_reason: DRCでエボラ流行が7200例・3500人死亡に達し、新たな州（南ウバンギ）へ拡大中で、国際的な支援（ワクチン・WHO支援）が緊急に必要とされているため、IHR基準・WPRO基準ともに複数該当する重大シグナル。
triage.notes: 発生地域にVeneto・Bambù（イタリア）が含まれるが、記事内容はDRC国内のエボラ流行拡大に関するものであり、イタリアの地名は無関係（Bluedotの地域抽出誤り）と判断し除外した。

article.articleHeadline: Nord-Kivu : plusieurs carcasses d'hippopotames découvertes dans la rivière Semuliki, l'ICCN appelle à la vigilance
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: North Kivu: Several hippopotamus carcasses discovered in the Semuliki River, the ICCN calls for vigilance.
article.articleSummary: In eastern Democratic Republic of Congo, several hippopotamus carcasses were found in the Semuliki River near Virunga National Park. On 25 September 2026, the ICCN urged vigilance as laboratory analyses are under way to determine the deaths’ cause, amid a re-emergence of anthrax in the Virunga area. An August 2026 case had been confirmed in central Virunga’s Rutshuru territory, in the Kibirizi health zone, with a previous April 2025 outbreak linked to hippos around Lake Edward near the RDC-Uganda border. Authorities stress that hippo deaths due to anthrax are not new. Precautions include avoiding contact with carcasses, not consuming meat (even if cooked), keeping children and livestock away, avoiding near-water sources, and washing hands regularly. New carcasses or unusual mortality should be reported, and anyone exposed should seek health care if symptoms appear.

triage.headline_ja: 北キブ州：セムリキ川で複数のカバの死骸が発見、ICCNが警戒を呼びかけ
triage.triage_reason: コンゴ民主共和国ヴィルンガ国立公園周辺でカバの炭疽菌による大量死が再発しているが、過去にも同様の事例があり異常ではなく、現時点で人への感染確定例もないため、続報を注視する段階と判断した。
triage.notes: 炭疽菌によるカバの死骸発見は過去にも複数回確認されており（2025年4月、2026年8月）、今回は再興事例。人間への感染確定例は記事中に言及なく、予防的注意喚起の段階。ラボ分析の結果待ちであり、続報により深刻度・拡大リスクの再評価が必要。ウガンダ・ルワンダ・オーストラリアは地理的言及のみで記事の主題ではないため除外。

article.articleHeadline: Tshopo : le gouverneur appelle la population au respect des mesures préventives contre Ebola - ACP
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Tshopo: the governor calls on the population to comply with preventive measures against Ebola - ACP.
article.articleSummary: An Ebola virus disease outbreak in Tshopo Province, northeastern Democratic Republic of the Congo, prompts a public appeal from Governor Paulin Lendongolia for continued adherence to preventive measures and collaboration with response teams. In Kisangani, the governor urged residents to observe preventive measures, cooperate with response teams, and show solidarity, responsibility, and vigilance amid the outbreak. The appeal follows the death of Dr Victor Kingombe, chief staff physician at Kisangani’s De Smet Hospital, who died from Ebola after more than a week’s hospitalization at the Ebola Treatment Center located in Block Météo, Makiso commune. The governor's message also acknowledges the dedication and risks faced by health and paramedical personnel. The statements underscore the ongoing response to the Ebola outbreak in the area and the need for community compliance to control transmission.

triage.headline_ja: チョポ州:知事がエボラ対策の予防措置遵守を住民に呼びかけ - ACP
triage.triage_reason: コンゴ民主共和国チョポ州でエボラ出血熱の流行が継続しており、医療従事者の死亡例も発生していることから、IHR基準・WPRO基準ともに複数該当し社会的関心も高い。
triage.notes: 医師の死亡例が報告されており、医療従事者への感染拡大が懸念される。続報でのケース数・致死率等の詳細確認が必要。

article.articleHeadline: Tshopo : les élus appelés à servir de relais dans la lutte contre Ebola - ACP
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Tshopo: Elected Officials Called Upon to Serve as a Relay in the Fight Against Ebola - ACP
article.articleSummary: Kisangani, 25 September 2026 — In Tshopo province, northeastern Democratic Republic of the Congo, provincial MPs were urged by the speaker to act as liaisons between Ebola virus disease response teams and local communities to bridge gaps and bolster trust in the ongoing Ebola response. Deputy Matheus Kanga emphasized lawmakers should serve as a conduit between the response operation, communities, and electorates. The appeal follows challenges in Bafwasende territory where health workers face ignorance, denial, and, in some instances, violence against staff. The latest provincial health division report records 42 confirmed Ebola cases, 17 deaths, and 13 recoveries. The call was made at an extraordinary assembly session with the response team delegation, Assembly leadership, and Health Minister Dr Simon Bokongo.

triage.headline_ja: ツショポ州：エボラ対策における仲介役を務めるよう議員に要請 - ACP
triage.triage_reason: エボラ出血熱の確定症例42件、死亡17件を含む継続中のアウトブレイクであり、地域社会での抵抗・暴力事例も報告されているため、重症度・拡大リスクの観点からフルリスク評価が必要と判断。
triage.notes: 記事はコンゴ民主共和国ツショポ州における進行中のエボラ対応の社会的側面（住民との信頼構築、暴力・否認への対応）を扱っており、既存のアウトブレイク管理の一環と考えられるが、症例数・死亡者数の規模と地域社会での抵抗の存在から継続監視・フル評価が妥当。

article.articleHeadline: Namibia beefs with FMD
article.articleSummary: Foot-and-Mouth Disease (FMD) confirmed in Namibia after 63 cattle showed clinical signs, with 10 of 11 samples from Karasburg (south of the Redline, //Kharas region) testing positive; diagnosis by the Central Veterinary Laboratory. A nationwide suspension on movement, marketing, import and export of all cloven-hoofed animals and by-products, plus a halt to slaughter at export/local abattoirs and markets, has been enacted under the National FMD Contingency Plan, with intensified surveillance and roadblocks. The outbreak threatens Namibia’s beef exports to the EU, US, China and Norway, risking premium-market access. The economy could lose N$2.5–6 billion in export revenue if markets are disrupted; the sector supports over 90,000 rural livelihoods, more than N$17 billion in value, and >N$6 billion in annual exports. EU/UK account for 55–65% of volumes; 2026 first five months exported N$1.43 billion; Norwegian quota largely used, with potential N$365 million earnings. Prolonged suspensions (12–24 months) could trigger further losses (up to about N$3 billion by six months).

triage.headline_ja: ナミビア、口蹄疫（FMD）発生で対応強化
triage.triage_reason: 口蹄疫はナミビアの家畜に発生した動物疾病であり、対象国（対象地域リスト）に該当する国では発生していないため、ヒト公衆衛生上の懸念は低い。
triage.notes: 本事案はナミビアの牛における口蹄疫発生であり、対象国リスト（Zambia, Philippines, Thailand, Ghana, DRC, Brazil, Indonesia, China, Myanmar, Vietnam, India）に該当する国では発生していない。中国・米国・ノルウェー・EUは輸出市場として言及されているのみで、発生国ではないため verified_locations は空とした。動物疾病でありヒトへの直接感染性はないため、公衆衛生上の緊急性は低いと判断。

article.articleHeadline: Disdik KBB Antisipasi Penyebaran Influenza A di Satuan Pendidikan
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: West Bandung Regency Education Office Anticipates the Spread of Influenza A in Educational Institutions.
article.articleSummary: As of 25 September 2026, the West Bandung Regency Education Office issued Circular Letter No. 400.3.1/-DISDIK/2026 to anticipate the spread of Influenza A in educational facilities. The guidance directs schools to heighten vigilance for respiratory illness and implement prevention measures among students, teachers, and staff. When a learner or staff member exhibits symptoms—fever, cough, runny nose, sore throat, body aches, or fatigue—their return to school should be avoided; they should rest at home until recovered, and absences must not be penalized pending parental notification. The policy reinforces PHBS (personal hygiene and healthy living): regular handwashing with soap, proper cough etiquette, and not sharing food or utensils; classrooms should be cleaned, ventilation maintained, and masking advised for symptomatic individuals in certain circumstances. If unusually rising cases occur, schools should promptly coordinate with Puskesmas or health facilities for further action.

triage.headline_ja: 西バンドン県教育局、教育機関でのインフルエンザA感染拡大を予防
triage.triage_reason: 季節性インフルエンザAに対する学校向けの予防的な行政通達であり、重大な公衆衛生上の異常事態や国際的拡大リスクを示す情報はない。
triage.notes: 地方教育局による予防的な通達であり、具体的な症例数や重症例、異常な流行の記載はない。通常の季節性インフルエンザ対策の一環と判断される。

article.articleHeadline: How mistrust helped create an Ebola hotspot in east Congo
article.articleSummary: As of 25 September 2026, Congo's North Kivu region is experiencing its worst-ever Ebola outbreak, with cases on the rise and government figures placing the case-fatality rate at about 60%. Mistrust between communities and authorities is identified as a major obstacle to controlling transmission in this eastern hotspot. By contrast, neighboring Ituri—the outbreak’s origin—shows signs that transmission is easing in some of the most affected areas. Reuters Dakar correspondent Clement Bonnerot explains why mistrust is shaping the response and sustaining transmission in North Kivu. The article contrasts worsening conditions in North Kivu with improving trends in Ituri, underscoring how social dynamics can influence outbreak control in east Congo.

triage.headline_ja: 不信感がコンゴ東部でエボラのホットスポットを生み出した経緯
triage.triage_reason: コンゴ民主共和国北キブ州で過去最悪規模のエボラ流行が進行中で、致死率約60%、感染拡大が継続しており公衆衛生上の深刻な影響と異常事態に該当する。
triage.notes: DakarはReuters記者の所在地であり、発生地域としては誤り。実際の発生地はコンゴ民主共和国の北キブ州およびイツリ州のみ。

article.articleHeadline: Chennai Flu, Dengue Surge Triggers 12-Hour Bed Waits
article.articleSummary: Chennai hospitals report a sharp seasonal rush as respiratory infections and dengue drive admissions, with private wards full and emergency-bed waits up to 12 hours. Respiratory viruses detected include RSV, adenovirus, rhinovirus and parainfluenza, alongside influenza (including H1N1); dengue cases are rising. Between September 1–18, 2026 Chennai logged 614 dengue cases, about 18% higher than the total for all of September 2025; August recorded 605 cases, roughly 66% higher than August 2024. By September 18, 2026 the year-to-date dengue tally approached 2,600, though still below 2025 and 2024 totals. Officials note dengue often increases pre-monsoon and can stay elevated into November or December, prompting intensified mosquito-control and fever-surveillance. Dengue symptoms (high fever, body pain, fatigue) overlap with influenza; severe dengue features include abdominal pain, persistent vomiting, bleeding, rapid breathing, or weakness—seek urgent care for warning signs, especially in older adults and those with chronic diseases.

triage.headline_ja: チェンナイでインフルエンザ・デング熱が急増、病床待ち12時間の事態に
triage.triage_reason: 季節性の呼吸器感染症・デング熱の増加により病院が逼迫しているが、当局は例年のパターン（プレモンスーン期の増加）と説明しており、異常性や国際的拡大リスクは明確でない。病床逼迫という重症度面の懸念から経過観察とする。
triage.notes: デング熱・インフルエンザ・RSV等の複合的な季節性増加により医療機関が逼迫している事例。前年比で症例数増加が見られるが、当局は季節性パターンとして説明しており緊急性は限定的。今後の推移（11-12月まで続くとされる）を注視する必要がある。

article.articleHeadline: 增一人染登革熱　潛伏期曾訪馬來西亞
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Another dengue fever case; had visited Malaysia during the incubation period.
article.articleSummary: As of 25 September 2026, 5 pm, Hong Kong reports one new imported dengue fever case, with infection in the incubation period after visiting Malaysia. Year-to-date dengue totals reach 32 cases (30 imported, 2 local); 2025 had 59 dengue cases, all imported, and 2024 had 161 (156 imported, 5 local). Regarding chikungunya fever, no new local cases in the past week; following a local case last week, the Centre has screened over 3,200 residents/workers in affected areas with no additional cases detected, and three earlier mild cases tested negative for chikungunya virus. The year records 3 chikungunya cases in Hong Kong (2 imported, 1 local); 2025 saw 82 cases (11 local). Public health guidance urges Mid-Autumn Festival outdoor participants to take mosquito bite precautions in parks, fields, and beaches.

triage.headline_ja: デング熱新規1例、潜伏期にマレーシア訪問歴あり
triage.triage_reason: 香港での輸入デング熱症例および直近のチクングニア熱局所感染の定期サーベイランス報告であり、重大な異常性や公衆衛生上の深刻な影響は認められないが、蚊媒介感染症の継続的な国内伝播リスクがあるため経過観察とする。
triage.notes: 記事は香港（中国特別行政区）の定期的な感染症サーベイランス報告。マレーシアは輸入症例の感染地であるが対象国リストに含まれないため除外。局所感染例が僅かに存在するが、当局による積極的スクリーニングで追加症例は検出されていない。

article.articleHeadline: தஞ்சையில் வீடு வீடாக தீவிர டெங்கு தடுப்பு ஆய்வு: பழைய டயர்களில் கொசுப்புழு இருக்கா என சோதனை
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: In Thanjavur, door-to-door intensive dengue prevention survey: testing whether old tyres contain mosquito larvae.
article.articleSummary: Thanjavur City Corporation conducted door-to-door dengue prevention inspections in Ward 21 (Cherppanayakkan Ward) as part of intensified vector-control measures. Under Thanjai District Collector Revathi and Commissioner Deepna Visweswari, health and sanitation staff are carrying out preventive work across all wards, focusing on breeding sites due to the rainy season and weather changes. Inspectors checked homes for standing water in water tanks, unused vessels, flower pots, coconut shells, and old tyres, stressing that even small accumulations can produce mosquito larvae. Residents were urged to remove unnecessary items, keep surroundings clean, and suitably store or dispose of tyres to prevent breeding. Anyone with fever or body pain should seek medical care promptly. Mosquito spraying is ongoing in high-risk areas, with continued surveillance and strong public cooperation required to curb dengue transmission.

triage.headline_ja: タンジャーヴールで住宅一軒一軒を対象にした集中デング熱予防調査：古タイヤの中の蚊の幼虫の有無を検査
triage.triage_reason: 通常の季節的なデング熱予防活動を報じる内容であり、異常な流行や重症例の急増を示す情報はない。
triage.notes: 記事は行政による通常の予防的ベクター対策活動を報じるもので、症例数や異常な流行状況についての言及はない。

article.articleHeadline: Отдыхавшая в Таиланде россиянка тяжело заболела коронавирусом
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Russian woman vacationing in Thailand fell seriously ill with coronavirus.
article.articleSummary: On 25 September 2026, a 27-year-old Russian woman from Ivanovo fell seriously ill with COVID-19 during a vacation in Phuket, Thailand. She reported high fever, chest heaviness, loss of smell, and breathing difficulties. Local physicians treated her and advised returning to hospital if her blood oxygen saturation dropped. The patient suspected infection occurred in public venues, noting that many staff in shops and hotels were ill with COVID-19 but still working. The report references earlier coverage that Russians were cancelling or delaying holidays to Thailand amid a COVID-19 outbreak, with groups of tourists becoming infected. The information is sourced to the Shot Telegram channel; the article does not provide details on laboratory confirmation or the exact infection source beyond the public-place exposure suggestion.

triage.headline_ja: タイ旅行中のロシア人女性が新型コロナウイルスに重症化
triage.triage_reason: 個人の重症例報告であり、Telegramチャンネルからの未検証情報で検査確認も明記されていないが、観光客間での集団感染や現地スタッフの罹患継続を示唆しており、続報を注視する必要がある。
triage.notes: 情報源がTelegramチャンネル（Shot）であり、検査による確定診断や公式発表の裏付けがないため、信頼性は限定的。ただしプーケットでの観光客感染例増加や施設スタッフの罹患継続の指摘があり、地域的な感染拡大の可能性を示す情報として経過観察が望ましい。

article.articleHeadline: List of 11 Schools in Batang with Students Suspected of MBG Food Poisoning, Regency Government Halts SPPG Kitchen Distribution
article.articleSummary: Batang Regency, Central Java, has suspended MBG program distribution from a single Bawang District kitchen operated by SPPG after hundreds of beneficiaries were suspected of food poisoning on 23 September 2026. Eleven schools in Bawang District, with roughly 2,700 beneficiaries, receive meals from this kitchen. Deputy Regent Suyono said the SPPG kitchen distribution is halted for all district recipients. As of 8:38 p.m. WIB, 275 people in Bawang District sought treatment at various health facilities due to overwhelmed Batang hospitals. Healthy students continue attending school; those ill receive treatment and recovery care. The report notes no laboratory-confirmed diagnosis or specific infection source beyond the implicated kitchen.

triage.headline_ja: バタン県の11校でMBGプログラムによる食中毒疑いの学生が発生、県政府がSPPG厨房からの配食を停止
triage.triage_reason: 275名が治療を受け病院が対応に追われるなど中等度の公衆衛生影響があり、政府が配食停止措置を取るなど行政的関心も高いため、フルリスク評価への移行が妥当。
triage.notes: 本事案は感染症ではなく学校給食プログラム（MBG）による食中毒疑いのクラスターであり、病原体の検査確認は未報告。感染性疾患としてのリスクは低いが、大量発生かつ行政対応が取られている点でモニタリング価値あり。

article.articleHeadline: 本港新增一宗外地傳入登革熱個案　患者潛伏期訪馬來西亞
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Hong Kong reports a new imported dengue fever case; the patient visited Malaysia during the incubation period.
article.articleSummary: As of 25 September 2026, Hong Kong reports a new imported dengue fever case, with the patient having visited Malaysia during the incubation period. The Centre for Health Protection notes 2026’s dengue total at 32 cases: 30 imported and 2 locally transmitted. Regarding last week’s locally acquired chikungunya fever case in Tai Kok Tsui, CHP says that by 5:00 pm today, more than 3,200 residents and workers in the district have been assessed with no additional cases identified. Blood tests were conducted on three individuals who previously exhibited mild chikungunya symptoms; results were negative for chikungunya virus.

triage.headline_ja: 香港で新たに国外由来のデング熱感染例を確認　患者は潜伏期間中にマレーシアを訪問
triage.triage_reason: 輸入デング熱症例の追加報告であり、地域内で拡大の兆候はなく、チクングニア熱についても追加症例なしと確認された定例的なサーベイランス報告のため。
triage.notes: デング熱症例は香港在住者がマレーシア渡航中に感染した輸入例であり、マレーシアでの発生事例として扱うものではない。チクングニア熱については地域内の追加調査で新規感染者なしと確認され、既に沈静化傾向。

article.articleHeadline: Health Alert: कानपुर में नहीं थम रहा स्वाइन फ्लू का संक्रमण, तीन संक्रमित मरीज और मिले, अब तक 47 केस मिल चुके - kanpur swine flu dengue cases rise 3 new infections
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Health Alert: Swine flu infection continues in Kanpur, three more infected patients found, 47 cases reported so far.
article.articleSummary: Kanpur reports ongoing swine flu and dengue outbreaks, with three new dengue and three new swine flu cases recorded on Friday. Since January, dengue total = 125; swine flu total = 47. Dengue confirmed in a 23-year-old man from Mandhna, a 20-year-old woman from Bilhaur, and a 51-year-old man from Barra. Swine flu confirmed in a 56-year-old man from Jaggi Purwa and a 50-year-old man from Ghatampur; an 18-year-old girl, Pinky, from Wajidpur tested positive after fever. Deputy CMO Dr. Rajeshwar Singh says vector-control and malaria teams are active in city and rural areas, conducting daily larva destruction and fever-sampling in Ambedkar Nagar Kakadev, Sanigawan, Kalyanpur, Sujanpur, Gujaini Colony, Paniki, Barra, Swaroop Nagar, Ratanlal Nagar, Chaman Ganj, Tilak Nagar, Vijay Nagar, Sarvodaya Nagar, Chunni Ganj. Most patients are recovering at home under alert-team monitoring. Scrub typhus detected in a 50-year-old woman from Rampuram.

triage.headline_ja: Health Alert: カンプールでスワインフル感染が止まらず、新たに3人の感染者、累計47例に
triage.triage_reason: 季節性のデング・スワインフルの地域的な症例増加報告であり、深刻な公衆衛生上の異常事態やIHR基準の複数該当は認められないが、複数疾患（デング、スワインフル、つつが虫病）の併発と当局の対応継続があるため経過観察とする。
triage.notes: 地方紙報道でカンプール市内の季節性感染症（デング・スワインフル・つつが虫病）の局地的増加。市当局によるベクター対策・発熱サンプリングが継続実施中。国際的拡大の兆候なし。

article.articleHeadline: Wapres minta nakes RSUD Arosuka antisipasi penyakit pascabanjir
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: The Vice President asks Arosuka Regional General Hospital's healthcare workers to anticipate post-flood diseases.
article.articleSummary: In Solok Regency, West Sumatra, Vice President Gibran Rakabuming urged staff at Arosuka Regional General Hospital to treat flood victims and preempt post-disaster illnesses. During a visit to RSUD Arosuka in Koto Gaek Guguak, Gunung Talang, he called for fast, coordinated care throughout the emergency phase, ensuring adequate medicines and referral pathways. He urged the hospital to prepare for post-flood diseases, including diarrhea, skin infections, dengue fever, and wound infections, and to supply vitamins for residents in evacuation shelters. Health services should reach people in shelters and those in independent shelters, not only patients who come to the hospital. Regular monitoring of vulnerable groups—pregnant women, the elderly, people with disabilities, and children—was emphasized. He spoke with a patient who had a wrist fracture treated by reposition; the broader goal is sustained health coverage through recovery.

triage.headline_ja: 副大統領、アロスカ県立病院の医療従事者に洪水後の疾病への備えを要請
triage.triage_reason: 洪水後の一般的な公衆衛生対策を要請する内容で、デング熱の具体的な発生report・症例数増加等は示されておらず、特段の異常性や社会的関心の高まりも確認できない。
triage.notes: 副大統領による災害対応視察に関する記事であり、デング熱を含む複数疾患への備えを呼びかける一般的な予防喚起の内容。具体的な感染事例数や流行状況の記載はない。

article.articleHeadline: Wapres Gibran Minta Nakes Waspadai Ledakan Wabah Penyakit di Pengungsian Korban Banjir Solok
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Vice President Gibran asks health workers to watch for a surge in disease outbreaks among Solok flood victims in evacuation centers.
article.articleSummary: Solok Regency, West Sumatra, Indonesia: As of 25 September 2026, Vice President Gibran Rakabuming urged health workers at RSUD Arosuka and allied facilities to brace for potential post-flood disease outbreaks among evacuees. Risks include diarrhea, skin infections, dengue fever (DHF), and wound infections in crowded shelters with standing water mixed with mud, poor sanitation, and damaged access to clean water. Health teams should actively visit evacuation sites, not wait for patients, and prioritise vulnerable groups—children, the elderly, pregnant women, and people with disabilities—for regular monitoring. Ensure steady supplies of medicines and vitamins to bolster immunity, and maintain capacity for referrals and emergency care. An injured resident (forearm fracture) received medical attention during the visit, with assurances that basic medicines and healthcare will be sustained through the emergency response. Emphasis on proactive surveillance and shelter-based care alongside hospital referrals. Keywords: outbreak prevention, evacuation centers, public health measures.

triage.headline_ja: ギブラン副大統領、ソロック洪水被災者の避難所における疾病流行への警戒を保健医療従事者に要請
triage.triage_reason: 現時点では実際の感染症流行ではなく、洪水後の避難所における疾病リスクへの注意喚起であり、具体的な症例数や流行の確認情報がないため経過観察とする。
triage.notes: 洪水後の避難所での衛生状態悪化によるデング熱等の感染症リスクに関する予防的注意喚起記事であり、実際の感染症アウトブレイクの確定情報は含まれていない。副大統領の発言という点で政治的関心は高いが、具体的な症例報告がないためPICKUPには至らない。

article.articleHeadline: Emergenza Ebola in Congo, centri di cura sotto pressione
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Ebola emergency in Congo, treatment centers under pressure.
article.articleSummary: In Butembo, Nord Kivu Province, the Ebola outbreak has intensified, with health facilities under severe strain from rising cases, concentrated mainly in densely populated urban areas. Early fear and distrust of Ebola treatment centers have led many people to delay care, complicating transmission. MSF reports more than 1,300 cases in Nord Kivu with a case-fatality rate above 62%, compared with about 45% in Ituri, where transmission has begun to slow. The situation underscores ongoing pressure on treatment centers and persistent community challenges in outbreak control in eastern Democratic Republic of the Congo.

triage.headline_ja: コンゴでエボラ緊急事態、治療センターに大きな負荷
triage.triage_reason: 北キブ州で1,300例超・致死率62%超のエボラ流行が拡大し、治療センターが逼迫、コミュニティの不信感により医療忌避が続くなど、IHR基準・WPRO基準ともに複数該当する重大な公衆衛生事案である。
triage.notes: MSFが北キブ州で1,300例超・致死率62%超と報告。イトゥリ州では致死率約45%で伝播が鈍化傾向にあるが、北キブ州都市部での治療忌避・遅延が伝播継続の要因となっている。国際的拡大や渡航制限に関する情報は記事中に明記されていない。

article.articleHeadline: ฟันผุ อย่าชะล่าใจ หมอเผยเคสคนไข้ไม่แปรงฟันนอน ไม่ใช่หนักแค่กลิ่นปาก แต่เชื้อลามถึงปอด
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Dental caries: Don’t underestimate it. A doctor reveals cases of patients who don’t brush their teeth before bed; it’s not just bad breath—the bacteria can spread to the lungs.
article.articleSummary: Thai doctors warn that dental caries and gingivitis can seed serious lung infections. In a case discussed on 24 September 2026, a patient who regularly drinks and sleeps without brushing developed a pulmonary infection later identified as a lung abscess caused by oral bacteria. Dr. Orawan Wongsombat and Dr. Thanakorn Wongsombat urged vigilance: severe mouth odor or infection reflects pathogens that can descend into the lungs. When the mouth harbors heavy bacterial load—caries and gum disease—and saliva is aspirated during sleep or swallowing is impaired, oral microbes can reach the lungs, causing chronic infection and abscess formation in the lungs. The advice stresses consistent oral hygiene and prompt dental assessment to prevent systemic spread beyond the teeth.

triage.headline_ja: 虫歯を軽視しないで:歯を磨かずに寝る患者の症例を医師が公表、口臭だけでなく細菌が肺まで広がる
triage.triage_reason: 個別患者の口腔衛生に関する健康啓発記事であり、感染症の公衆衛生上のアウトブレイクや国際的拡大リスクを示すものではない。
triage.notes: 本記事は口腔衛生と肺膿瘍リスクに関する一般的な医療啓発記事であり、感染症アウトブレイクのシグナルではない。

article.articleHeadline: Trong 4 năm, cả nước có 365 người tử vong vì bệnh dại
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Over four years, the country recorded 365 deaths from rabies.
article.articleSummary: From 2022 through 2026, Vietnam has recorded over 90,000 dog- or cat-bite incidents and 365 rabies deaths, with vaccination and treatment costs approaching 1,000 billion dong. In Dak Lak province, hundreds of bite cases have occurred, including 7 deaths. On September 25, 2026, Buon Ma Thuot hosted a conference to strengthen rabies prevention as part of World Rabies Day activities, reviewing the 2022-2030 National Program and pressing for intensified vaccination, bite management, and surveillance. Officials urged immediate medical care for bite victims, pet vaccination, and steady vaccine and antisera supplies; the aim for 2026-2030 is to eliminate rabies deaths in the country by 2030, through cross-sector coordination. A nationwide ceremony is planned for September 26 with 1,000 participants, including vaccination drills and outbreak response for dogs and cats. In Quang Ngai province, eight people were bitten and samples from a suspected rabid dog were collected.

triage.headline_ja: 4年間で全国365人が狂犬病で死亡
triage.triage_reason: 狂犬病はベトナムで既に流行しているエンデミック疾患であり、今回の記事は過去4年間の統計レビューと世界狂犬病デーの啓発活動に関する定例報告であるため、新規性・異常性は低いが、継続的な咬傷被害と散発的な死亡例があるため経過観察が必要。
triage.notes: 記事は狂犬病予防に関する国家プログラム（2022-2030年）のレビューと世界狂犬病デー関連の啓発イベントが主題であり、新たな異常発生を示す内容ではない。ただし咬傷被害の継続とダクラク省・クアンガイ省での散発的死亡例・疑い犬の検体採取は今後の動向注視が必要。

article.articleHeadline: Việt Nam lần đầu triển khai tiêm vắc xin phòng bệnh tay chân miệng
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Vietnam rolls out its first vaccine against hand, foot and mouth disease.
article.articleSummary: Vietnam rolls out EV71 vaccine for hand, foot and mouth disease (HFMD) through VNVC in partnership with Substipharm Biologics (Switzerland), with vaccination at nearly 300 VNVC centers nationwide. HFMD is especially dangerous in children under 3, with EV71 driving most severe cases and deaths. In 2023 Vietnam recorded over 181,000 HFMD cases and 31 deaths; EV71 caused the majority of hospitalizations (about 82%) and 90% of severe cases. The EV71 vaccine is for children aged 2 months to under 6 years, with a 2–3 dose schedule by age. Phase III Vietnamese trials showed about 96.8% efficacy against EV71-HFMD and strong cross-genotype protection. Taiwan’s deployment since Aug 2023, with over 600,000 doses, reports favorable safety and effectiveness; no EV71-related severe HFMD cases in 2024–2026. On day one, registrations surged in Hanoi, Ho Chi Minh City, Da Nang, Can Tho, and other provinces, with many recipients under 3 years old. Health experts hail it as a long-awaited measure to reduce hospitalizations.

triage.headline_ja: ベトナムが初めて手足口病ワクチンの接種を開始
triage.triage_reason: 既知の流行性疾患（HFMD/EV71）に対する新規ワクチン導入に関する報道であり、新たなアウトブレイクや異常事態を示すものではない。
triage.notes: 記事はEV71ワクチンの導入・接種開始を伝えるポジティブな公衆衛生施策のニュースであり、感染急増や異常発生を報告するものではないため、シグナルとしては見送り。

article.articleHeadline: 2026年秋冬季传染病防控进校园活动（结核篇）举行
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Autumn–Winter 2026 On-Campus Infectious Disease Prevention and Control Activities (Tuberculosis Chapter) Held
article.articleSummary: Autumn–winter on-campus tuberculosis prevention activities were conducted in Jiujiang, Jiangxi, led by the Jiujiang City Center for Disease Control and Prevention in collaboration with the education system. Employing a three-in-one model of screening, education, and supervision, the effort aims to strengthen campus health defenses. On September 20, experts trained over 150 participants at Jiangxi Vocational and Technical University, including students, campus doctors, and health teachers. The session covered TB transmission and symptoms, highlighting persistent coughing or sputum production for more than two weeks as a key warning signal, and urged early medical evaluation, reporting, isolation, and treatment. Guidance emphasized ventilation and disinfection in classrooms and dormitories, plus hand hygiene and healthy routines to reduce spread. TB is preventable and curable; with standard full-course therapy, most patients are non-infectious after recovery.

triage.headline_ja: 2026年秋冬季感染症予防対策キャンパス活動(結核編)開催
triage.triage_reason: これは結核予防に関する教育・啓発活動の報告であり、実際の感染拡大やアウトブレイクの報告ではない。
triage.notes: 記事は九江市におけるキャンパス向け結核予防啓発活動の実施報告であり、具体的な症例数や発生状況の報告ではない。定型的な公衆衛生教育活動のためシグナルとして扱わない。

article.articleHeadline: Ebola à Isiro : le personnel soignant attend l'arrivée des vaccins pour se protéger - ACP
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Ebola in Isiro: healthcare workers await the arrival of vaccines to protect themselves - ACP
article.articleSummary: Isiro, Democratic Republic of Congo — As of 25 September 2026, the arrival of an Ebola vaccine in Isiro (capital of Haut-Uélé province, in northeastern DRC) was welcomed by Dr. Gilbert Malango, the Isiro health zone medical chief, to protect frontline treatment-center workers from transmission. He noted that among confirmed cases, frontline staff (doctors and nurses) have been infected while attempting to save lives, so a preventive vaccine would be a critical safeguard for those most exposed. The health zone leader also urged residents to maintain a positive stance in the fight against Ebola and to strictly adhere to barrier measures to bolster the effectiveness of existing outbreak controls and efforts to eradicate the disease.

triage.headline_ja: イジロにおけるエボラ出血熱：医療従事者が自身を守るためのワクチン到着を待つ - ACP
triage.triage_reason: コンゴ民主共和国イジロでエボラ出血熱の確認症例が発生し医療従事者への感染も報告されており、公衆衛生上重大かつ国際的拡大リスクのある疾病のためフルRRAへの移行が妥当。
triage.notes: エボラ出血熱は致死性が高く、医療従事者への感染が既に確認されているため感染拡大リスクが高い。ワクチン導入状況や現在の症例数など続報の確認が必要。

article.articleHeadline: Đồng Nai họp triển khai các biện pháp cấp bách phòng, chống dịch bệnh sốt xuất huyết
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Dong Nai holds a meeting to implement urgent measures to prevent and control the dengue fever outbreak.
article.articleSummary: Dengue outbreak in Dong Nai Province, Vietnam: From the start of 2026 through 25 September, Dong Nai recorded over 14,700 dengue cases and 6 deaths, with 95 of 95 communes/wards affected. The Northwest region remains high in cases, while the Southeast shows an increasing trend. All four dengue virus serotypes (D1–D4) are circulating, including documented co-infection with D1 and D2, raising the risk of severe disease. Weather fluctuations and persistent larval habitats continue to drive transmission. On 25 September, the Department of Health held a hybrid meeting with 95 commune/ward leaders to implement urgent control measures, emphasizing immediate action under the '4 at site' principle: mobilize local authorities, secure chemicals, sprayers, and personnel, and investigate/contain outbreaks within 24–48 hours of case confirmation. The City CDC will lead surveillance, weekly analyses by district, monitor vector indices and serotype circulation, and support high-risk areas; regional centers must ensure adequate supplies and that clinics provide treatment and prevention information to minimize severe cases and deaths.

triage.headline_ja: ドンナイ省、デング熱の流行防止に向けた緊急対策実施のための会議を開催
triage.triage_reason: ベトナム・ドンナイ省で年初来14,700例超・死亡6例のデング熱流行が発生し、全血清型（D1-D4）の同時流行と重複感染による重症化リスクが報告され、当局が緊急対策会議を開催するなど行政の高い関心が確認されるため。
triage.notes: デング熱はベトナムにおける季節性の風土病であり国際的拡大リスクは低いが、全血清型の同時流行・重複感染による重症化と、全95コミューンへの拡大、当局の緊急対応が確認されており、続報を含めたフルリスク評価が望ましい。

article.articleHeadline: Brucelose: por que o diagnóstico rápido é essencial para proteger a pecuária brasileira
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Brucellosis: Why rapid diagnosis is essential to protect Brazilian livestock.
article.articleSummary: Brucellosis remains a priority in Brazilian livestock health, with the latest PNCEBT/MAPA update (October 2025) showing uneven disease presence across states. Santa Catarina records the lowest risk, with 0.9% foci, the only state classified as low risk for bovine and bubaline brucellosis. The disease causes abortions, infertility, and reduced productivity, with zoonotic potential. Rapid, accurate diagnostics are crucial to curb spread and enable timely control measures. Molecular diagnostics, detecting Brucella genetic material directly, are gaining ground over traditional serology by speeding confirmation and guiding actions such as animal isolation and epidemiological investigations. Despite progress, regional differences in herd size, vaccination coverage, production systems, and veterinary services remain challenges. Lab modernization, automation, and molecular tools strengthen surveillance and public-health protection against brucellosis in Brazil.

triage.headline_ja: ブルセラ症：迅速な診断がブラジルの畜産業を守るために不可欠な理由
triage.triage_reason: 家畜のブルセラ症に関する診断技術・獣医療の一般解説記事であり、急性の公衆衛生上の異常事態やヒトへの感染拡大は報告されていない。
triage.notes: 動物衛生（家畜ブルセラ症）に関する業界向け解説記事で、既知の疾病の地域差・診断技術に関する内容。ヒトへの感染症危機情報ではない。

article.articleHeadline: 本港今年錄32宗登革熱個案 基孔肯雅熱暫無新增｜METROHK.com.hk
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Hong Kong records 32 dengue fever cases this year; no new chikungunya fever cases for now | METROHK.com.hk
article.articleSummary: Hong Kong reports 32 dengue fever cases this year (as of Sept 24): 30 imported and 2 locally acquired. One additional dengue case in Sept 18–24 had travelled to Malaysia. Chikungunya totals remain 3 cases (2 imported, 1 local); the latest local case was a woman in Tai Kok Tsui, prompting screening of about 3,200 residents/workers; three mild symptomatic individuals were negative for chikungunya. No new locally transmitted chikungunya cases were detected in Sept 18–24. Globally, dengue incidence has risen; last year more than 5 million cases and over 4,000 deaths in 90+ countries; Jan–Aug 2026 around 2.2 million cases and over 1,000 deaths. In Asia, Sri Lanka and Vietnam exceed 90,000; Cambodia, Indonesia, Malaysia over 70,000; Bangladesh over 60,000; Singapore over 2,400; Guangdong, China, 431 by Aug 31. Public health measures urge continued mosquito control and personal protection: repellents with DEET or alternatives; pregnant women up to 30% concentration, children up to 10%; remove standing water and report mosquito problems to 1823. Travelers to Southeast Asia should take precautions.

triage.headline_ja: 本港、今年の登革熱症例32件を記録、基孔肯雅熱の新規症例なし｜METROHK.com.hk
triage.triage_reason: 香港における登革熱・チクングニア熱の症例数は少なく、重症例もないため深刻性は低いが、蚊媒介感染症としての流行しやすさがあり、地域全体でのデング熱増加傾向もあるため経過観察が必要。
triage.notes: 記事は香港（中国）の登革熱・チクングニア熱の定例監視報告が主題。ベトナム、カンボジア、インドネシア、スリランカ、マレーシア、バングラデシュ、シンガポール、広東省の数値は地域比較の統計情報として言及されているのみで、主題ではないため除外。

article.articleHeadline: G20+ Mobilises US$2.9 Billion for Ebola Response as Africa CDC Calls for Full Transparency and Traceability of Every Dollar
article.articleSummary: US$2.9 billion mobilised at the G20+ Foreign Ministers Meeting on Accelerating Collective Action to Defeat Ebola, held 23 September 2026 in New York (UNGA margins). Total commitments include US$886 million from the United States, €500 million from the European Union, and over US$433 million from the World Bank, among others, directed to the Ebola response in the Democratic Republic of the Congo (DRC) and Uganda within the Great Lakes region. Funds target treatment, surveillance, contact tracing, PPE and other frontline interventions through cross-border activities and nationally led priorities. Africa CDC co-leads the Incident Management Support Team with WHO. A central message stresses transparency: tracing every dollar from commitment to disbursement to on-ground services. Africa CDC will strengthen its Financial Tracking Mechanism with the DRC government and partners to provide a consolidated view of commitments, disbursements, expenditures, locations and results, accelerating resources to health zones and communities.

triage.headline_ja: G20+がエボラ対応に29億米ドルを動員、アフリカCDCは全資金の透明性と追跡可能性を要求
triage.triage_reason: コンゴ民主共和国・ウガンダでのエボラ出血熱流行に対しG20+が29億ドルを動員する国際的対応であり、深刻な公衆衛生影響と国際的拡大リスク、社会的・政治的関心の高さが確認されるためフルリスク評価に進むべき案件。
triage.notes: 記事はG20+外相会合における資金動員に関する内容であり、ニューヨーク・オーストラリア・米国は会議開催地または資金拠出国であり発生地域ではない。ウガンダも実際の流行国だが対象国リストに含まれないため verified_locations から除外。

article.articleHeadline: Ebola : une formation des enseignants sur les mesures de prévention prévue en Ituri - ACP
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Ebola: Teacher Training on Prevention Measures Planned in Ituri
article.articleSummary: Ebola virus disease prevention training is planned for teachers from three education provinces of Ituri in northeastern Democratic Republic of Congo, with Bunia as the focal point. The initiative aims to equip teachers with knowledge to recognize suspicious signs and to adopt appropriate conduct when confronted with a child displaying symptoms compatible with Ebola. Sensitization will also extend to members of Parent Committees to strengthen family-level awareness of the disease, its signs, protective measures, and the actions to take in suspected cases. Yvon Muke, provincial director of Education and New Citizenship for Ituri 1, said the start date has not yet been fixed, but preparations are underway for a rapid rollout. The training is described as highly anticipated, intended to bolster prevention efforts in schools and within communities.

triage.headline_ja: エボラ：イトゥリ州で教員向け予防対策研修を計画
triage.triage_reason: エボラは重篤な感染症だが、本記事は教員向け予防研修の計画段階の内容であり、実際の症例発生や流行状況についての情報がないため、現時点ではフルRRAに進む根拠が乏しい。DRCイトゥリ州は過去にエボラ流行歴があるため継続的な注視が必要。
triage.notes: 記事は実際の症例報告ではなく、教員・保護者向けの予防啓発研修計画に関する内容。イトゥリ州は過去にエボラ流行が発生した地域であり、背景として警戒が続いている可能性がある。続報で実際の症例発生状況を確認する必要あり。

article.articleHeadline: Riposte contre Ebola - sécurité, un front commun indissociable pour la Monusco en Ituri - ACP
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Ebola Response - Security, an Inseparable United Front for MONUSCO in Ituri - ACP
article.articleSummary: Ebola response in Ituri, Democratic Republic of the Congo, is inseparable from the security situation, UN Special Representative James Swan said during his 24 September 2026 visit to Ituri. The province remains the epicenter of the Ebola outbreak while armed groups, notably the ADF, drive grave security challenges. Insecurity hampers access to health care, restricts movement of response teams, and heightens vulnerability among communities displaced by conflict. MONUSCO reaffirmed that civilian protection and outbreak response must be joint priorities, with operational adjustments including mobile base deployments and rapid reaction teams to enable rapid repositioning as threats evolve. The mission underscored continued partnership with loyalist forces FARDC against the ADF as essential to improving security and the effectiveness of public health interventions. The two crises are interlinked and require a unified approach to safeguard civilians and curb Ebola transmission.

triage.headline_ja: エボラ対応 ― 治安、イトゥリにおけるMONUSCOにとって不可分の共同戦線 - ACP
triage.triage_reason: エボラ出血熱はIHR基準に該当する重大疾患であり、コンゴ民主共和国イトゥリ州で治安悪化により対応が阻害されているという公衆衛生上深刻な状況であるため、フルRRAへ進めるべきシグナルと判断する。
triage.notes: エボラは既知の継続中アウトブレイクであり新規性は低いが、治安悪化との複合的危機として対応能力低下・拡大リスクが懸念される。続報でMONUSCOの活動状況・症例数推移を確認する必要あり。

article.articleHeadline: La déforestation est la première cause de l'épidémie d'Ebola (Expert en environnement) - ACP
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Deforestation is the leading cause of the Ebola outbreak (Environmental expert) - ACP
article.articleSummary: Kinshasa, 25 September 2026, at a conference in the Democratic Republic of the Congo, deforestation is identified as the leading cause of the Ebola virus disease outbreak, with mining as the second driver. Professor Pierre-Albert Ngueliele states habitat destruction displaces animal reservoirs carrying microbes toward humans, increasing spillover risk. He cites 2004–2005 data: 54,000 hectares of forest vanished in Tshopo and about 600,000 hectares across the DRC. As forests shrink, wildlife move near parks and villages, elevating human–animal contact and infection risk. He advocates intelligent reforestation and ecologist involvement, warning that mining destroys biodiversity. The public should respect hygiene and environmental standards and avoid eating dead animals found in forests. The event highlighted emergence of the Bundibugyo strain and aims to improve prevention, early diagnosis, and patient management, closing with patents awarded to speakers.

triage.headline_ja: 森林伐採がエボラ流行の最大の原因（環境専門家） - ACP
triage.triage_reason: エボラはDRCで公衆衛生上重大な疾患であり、Bundibugyo株の出現に言及しているが、本記事は森林伐採要因に関する専門家会議の解説記事であり、新規感染者数や地域拡大等の具体的疫学データが不明のため、続報の確認が必要。
triage.notes: 記事はエボラ流行の環境的要因（森林伐採・鉱業）に関する専門家会議の内容が中心で、具体的な症例数や発生規模、地理的拡大に関する情報は含まれていない。Bundibugyo株出現への言及があり、実際の流行状況について続報を確認する必要がある。

article.articleHeadline: Haut-Uélé: baisse des cas d'Ebola dans la zone de santé d'Isiro - ACP
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Upper Uele: decline in Ebola cases in the Isiro health zone - ACP
article.articleSummary: Isiro health zone, Haut-Uélé, in northeastern Democratic Republic of Congo, reports a notable decline in people testing positive for Ebola virus disease. Authorities say daily confirmed cases dropped from four to five per day to periods of two to three days with no new cases. Dr. Gilbert Malango, chief medical officer for Isiro health zone, says the downward trend is sustained and, with strong community collaboration, could end the outbreak in Isiro and across the province. He stresses intensified surveillance and prompt testing of all alerts to ensure negative results, avoiding complacency. The response requires unconditional involvement from all societal sectors to maintain the decrease and prevent renewed transmission.

triage.headline_ja: オートウエレ州:イシロ保健ゾーンでエボラ症例が減少 - ACP
triage.triage_reason: エボラ出血熱は既知のアウトブレイクであり深刻な公衆衛生リスクを伴うため、進行中の状況としてフルRRA対象とする。ただし本記事自体は症例減少という改善傾向を報告している。
triage.notes: 既知のエボラアウトブレイクの継続報道。今回の記事は症例減少という好転を報告しているが、依然として進行中のアウトブレイクであるため既存のRRAの更新情報として扱うべき。

article.articleHeadline: Influenza A Terdeteksi di DIY, 24 Kasus Muncul, Sekolah Belum Diliburkan
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Influenza A Detected in the Special Region of Yogyakarta, 24 Cases Reported, Schools Not Yet Closed
article.articleSummary: Influenza A detected in the Special Region of Yogyakarta (DIY), Indonesia, with 24 laboratory-confirmed cases reported as of 25 September 2026. Among these, 11 are H1N1pdm09 and 11 are H3N2, while 2 cases remain untyped. All confirmations come from hospital-based sentinel laboratory testing; reports reflect a year-round circulating seasonal influenza in Indonesia. Symptoms include fever, cough, and sore throat. Despite 24 cases, officials say there is no week-to-week rise; four-week ISPA data show a downward trend after a prior increase. Testing is limited to sentinel facilities, so many ISPA cases at other outlets are not typed. Public health measures emphasize hygiene, handwashing with soap and running water, and cough etiquette; masks for the sick; strengthen immunity. Kota Yogyakarta Disdikpora reports no confirmed student influenza cases and no closures; schools are urged to follow a five-step approach: monitor, prevent, protect, report, and respond, and track illness-related absenteeism.

triage.headline_ja: 特別州ヨグヤカルタでインフルエンザA型を検出、24例が報告、学校は休校せず
triage.triage_reason: 季節性インフルエンザの通常範囲内の報告であり、週ごとの増加傾向もなく、公衆衛生上の深刻な影響や異常性は認められない。
triage.notes: H1N1pdm09とH3N2による季節性インフルエンザの通常のサーベイランス報告。当局は週次増加なしと確認し、学校閉鎖等の措置も取られていない。

article.articleHeadline: Nord-Kivu : alerte sanitaire après la découverte de carcasses d'hippopotames dans une rivière - ACP
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: North Kivu: public health alert after the discovery of hippopotamus carcasses in a river - ACP.
article.articleSummary: North Kivu, Democratic Republic of the Congo, is under a public health alert after the discovery of several hippopotamus carcasses in the Semuliki River near Virunga National Park. Issued by ICCN, the notice informs local riverine communities that the cause of death is not yet established; laboratory analyses are ongoing. The alert references a prior anthrax outbreak recorded in April 2025 in the Lake Edward area and calls for heightened vigilance. Precautionary measures include: do not touch, move, cut, or consume meat from any dead or sick animal, even if cooked or dried; keep children and cattle away from affected zones; avoid using water near carcasses; promptly report any unusual mortalities to veterinary services and park authorities; seek rapid medical care if symptoms arise.

triage.headline_ja: 北キブ州：川でカバの死骸発見後、公衆衛生警戒発令 - ACP
triage.triage_reason: コンゴ民主共和国北キブ州のセムリキ川で複数のカバの死骸が発見され、2025年4月に同地域（エドワード湖）で発生した炭疽アウトブレイクとの関連が疑われ公衆衛生警戒が発令された。動物の異常死亡と人獣共通感染症の既往歴があり、フルリスク評価が望ましい。
triage.notes: 原因は未確定でラボ分析中。過去（2025年4月）に同地域で炭疽アウトブレイクの記録があり、今回も同様の可能性が示唆されている。ヒトでの症例報告はまだない。オーストラリアの地域情報は記事内容と無関係のため除外。

article.articleHeadline: Россиянам рассказали, как подобрать лечение при гонконгском гриппе. Новости. Первый канал
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Russians were told how to choose treatment for the Hong Kong flu. News. Channel One.
article.articleSummary: Hong Kong flu symptoms in Russia mirror those of ordinary influenza, with fever rising to 38–40°C, malaise, weakness, headaches, and eye and muscle pains. Distinguishing the Hong Kong strain from other flu variants requires laboratory tests. Antiviral medicines may help within the first 48 hours after onset, but should be used only after consultation with a doctor. Patients are advised to drink plenty of warm fluids and observe bed rest. Across Russia, respiratory viral infections and influenza are rising; Rospotrebnadzor reports over the past week more than 700,000 cases, about one-third higher than the previous week. The article emphasizes staying at home at the first signs of illness. These insights come from Channel One health coverage featuring physician Nadezhda Chernyshova.

triage.headline_ja: ロシア国民に香港型インフルエンザの治療法選択について解説。ニュース。チャンネル1。
triage.triage_reason: 季節性インフルエンザ（いわゆる香港型）の一般的な症状・治療に関する健康情報記事であり、異常性や国際的拡大リスクを示す内容はない。
triage.notes: 記事はロシア国内の季節性インフルエンザ流行状況と一般的な治療アドバイスに関するもの。「香港型インフルエンザ」は株の通称であり、香港・中国での発生を示すものではないため、対象国リストには該当なし。

article.articleHeadline: RDC eleva a casi 7.900 los casos y 3.800 los muertos a causa del...
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: DRC raises the number of cases to nearly 7,900 and deaths to 3,800 due to the...
article.articleSummary: Democratic Republic of the Congo reports 7,890 Ebola cases and 3,799 deaths, with 70 new cases and 20 new deaths in the last 24 hours. Case fatality rate is 48.1% and contact tracing stands at 83.4%. The outbreak’s epicenter is Ituri, accounting for about 76.5% of confirmed infections, with spread to seven provinces: North Kivu, South Kivu, Tshopo, Haut-Uele, Bas-Uele, and Ubangi. Of 167 health zones across these provinces, 63 have reported cases, and Ituri has 28 of its 36 zones affected. Currently, 893 patients are hospitalized or in isolation, and 1,966 have recovered. This is the deadliest Ebola outbreak in the DRC’s history and the second deadliest globally documented. The DRC declared the Kasai outbreak ended in December 2025 and remains highly experienced in Ebola management since 1976.

triage.headline_ja: コンゴ民主共和国、エボラ流行による感染者数を約7,900人、死者数を3,800人に上方修正
triage.triage_reason: 致死率48.1%の大規模エボラ流行で、DRC史上最悪かつ世界で2番目に致死性の高いエボラ流行であり、7州・63保健地域に拡大している国際的懸念事案。
triage.notes: 史上最悪規模のエボラ流行で7州・63保健地域に拡大、致死率48.1%と極めて高い。継続的なモニタリングとフルリスク評価が必要。

article.articleHeadline: মশার আঁতুড়ঘরের খবর দিল এআই, ডেঙ্গি, ম্যালেরিয়া রুখতে অভিনব উদ্যোগ
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: AI flags mosquito breeding grounds; an innovative initiative to curb dengue and malaria.
article.articleSummary: Rajkot, Gujarat, India is deploying artificial intelligence and drones to curb dengue, malaria, and chikungunya by targeting mosquito breeding grounds. In a 59.39 sq km monitored area within the city’s 161.85 sq km, drones and AI identified 4,731 mosquito breeding habitats. Health workers have already visited 1,340 sites and carried out insecticide spraying. The remaining breeding sites are being addressed by drone-led spraying. The initiative concentrates on wards with the highest reported dengue, malaria, and chikungunya cases and uses drone surveillance to locate larval habitats that are often hidden from routine inspections in standing water. The approach leverages AI to pinpoint breeding hotspots and deploy targeted vector control, aiming to curb transmission in the urban landscape. As of 25 September 2026, the program scales up city-wide mosquito control.

triage.headline_ja: AIが蚊の発生源を特定、デング熱・マラリア対策に革新的な取り組み
triage.triage_reason: 既存の蚊媒介感染症対策としてAI・ドローンを活用した取り組みに関する内容で、新規の異常な感染拡大や公衆衛生上の緊急事態を示す情報はない。
triage.notes: 記事はグジャラート州ラージコートでの媒介動物対策技術導入に関する内容であり、感染症流行の急増や異常事態を報告するものではない。

article.articleHeadline: Ebola en RDC : le rôle d'une coordination dans une réponse expliqué à Kinshasa - ACP
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Ebola in the DRC: the role of a coordination in a response explained to Kinshasa - ACP
article.articleSummary: On 25 September 2026 in Kinshasa, a conference outlined the role of coordination in the Ebola virus disease (EVD) response in the Democratic Republic of the Congo (DRC) amid Bundibugyo strain emergence. The event stressed that effective response requires strong coordination and alignment with IHR urging a Public Health Emergency Operations Center (COUSP) to support incident management. Prof. Christian Ngandu, COUSP coordinator at the Institut National de Santé Publique (INSP), described INSP’s role in detection, prevention, and rapid response, and how COUSP coordinates with program directorates to control the outbreak. Innovations cited include early deployment of staff, provincial decentralization, vaccination for frontline protection, surveillance of high-risk contacts, and antiviral therapies. A plan from 1 August 2026 to 27 February 2027 emphasizes risk communication, case surveillance, laboratories, treatment centers, and preventive measures, with animal surveillance noted. Conference organized by ViCtorious Development Initiative and INSP, under the Ministry of Public Health.

triage.headline_ja: コンゴ民主共和国のエボラ対応：キンシャサで説明されたコーディネーションの役割
triage.triage_reason: Bundibugyo株によるエボラ出血熱の継続対応に関する会議報告であり、疾患の重篤性および流行の可能性からWPRO基準に複数該当するためフルRRAへの移行が妥当と判断した。
triage.notes: 記事は既存のエボラ（Bundibugyo株）アウトブレイクへの対応調整に関する会議報告であり、新規発生の詳細（症例数・死亡数・拡大範囲）は記載されていない。続報にて感染規模や国際的拡大の有無を確認する必要がある。

article.articleHeadline: हर बुखार वायरल नहीं होता! डेंगू, फ्लू और वायरल फीवर में क्या है अंतर, ये Warning Signs जरूर जानें
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Not every fever is viral! What is the difference between dengue, flu, and viral fever? Be sure to know these warning signs.
article.articleSummary: Dengue, Flu (Influenza), and Viral Fever can share fever and body aches during seasonal changes, making early differentiation hard. Noida-based Integrated Doctor Dr. Sanjay Varshney notes dengue presents with sudden high fever, severe headache, eye pain, muscle and joint aches, and marked weakness; nausea, vomiting, and a red rash may occur. Important warning signs persisting after fever include severe abdominal pain, repeated vomiting, nasal or gum bleeding, blood in vomit or stool, extreme weakness, restlessness, and breathing difficulty, all requiring urgent medical care. Flu typically begins abruptly with fever plus cough, sore throat, runny or congested nose, headache, body aches, and fatigue; chills may occur. Warning signs needing prompt evaluation are trouble breathing, chest pain, dizziness, confusion, and rapid deterioration. Viral fever refers to fever from viral infections and can include fatigue, body pains, headache, sore throat, and nasal symptoms. Diagnosis should be guided by a doctor with possible tests.

triage.headline_ja: すべての発熱がウイルス性とは限らない！デング熱、インフルエンザ、ウイルス性発熱の違いとは？知っておくべき警告サイン
triage.triage_reason: 特定のアウトブレイクや症例数増加の報告ではなく、医師による一般的な症状鑑別・啓発記事であり、公衆衛生上の異常事態を示す内容ではない。
triage.notes: 記事は特定の発生事例ではなく、季節性の発熱疾患（デング熱・インフルエンザ・ウイルス性発熱）の症状の違いを説明する医療啓発記事。地域名（Noida/Uttar Pradesh/India）は医師の所在地として記載されているのみで、実際のアウトブレイクの発生を示すものではない。

article.articleHeadline: Kasus ILI di Situbondo Bertambah 25 Orang dalam Sepekan, Total Jadi 92
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Influenza-like illness (ILI) cases in Situbondo increase by 25 cases in a week, bringing the total to 92.
article.articleSummary: Influenza-like illness (ILI) in Situbondo Regency, East Java, Indonesia rose to 92 cases in Week 37 (Sept 13–19, 2026), up 25 from 67 the prior week. Data from public health centers (Puskesmas) and regional hospitals compiled by the Situbondo Health Office indicate spread across 10 districts: Sumbermalang, Mlandingan, Banyuglugur, Bungatan, Kendit, Situbondo, Kapongan, Arjasa, Banyuputih, and Besuki, reported via Puskesmas Widoropayung. Health officials led by Dwi Herman Susilo say the increase reflects ongoing transmission of illnesses with influenza-like symptoms. Preventive measures urged include maintaining clean living habits, regular handwashing, and masking during activity to reduce droplet transmission. The report highlights routine surveillance and continued prevention efforts to limit further spread; no additional details on laboratory confirmation or fatalities are provided.

triage.headline_ja: スンボンド県でインフルエンザ様疾患(ILI)の症例が1週間で25人増加、累計92人に
triage.triage_reason: ILI症例の増加が報告されているが、検査確定情報や重症度・死亡例の記載がなく、通常の季節性感染症サーベイランスの範囲内とみられるため、続報を注視する。
triage.notes: 検査室での病原体確認情報がなく、ILIという臨床症候群の報告に留まる。死亡例や重症例の報告もないため、通常のサーベイランス範囲内と考えられる。

article.articleHeadline: SP registra mais um caso de sarampo e agora são 37 no Estado
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: São Paulo records another measles case, bringing the total to 37 in the state.
article.articleSummary: As of 25 September 2026, the State of São Paulo has recorded 37 measles cases this year, with a new case diagnosed in São Paulo city. The patient is a 42-year-old man with no vaccination history. Of the 37 cases, 27 occurred in individuals without vaccination or with incomplete vaccination. Two cases (registered between March and April) were imported from other countries. The remaining cases, notified between June and August, were identified and monitored by the São Paulo Epidemiological Surveillance Center (CVE-SP) and municipal health surveillance. Field teams conduct epidemiological investigations, identify and monitor contacts, and implement transmission-control measures for suspected or confirmed cases. Vaccination is the primary preventive measure; the measles-mumps-rubella (MMR) vaccine is available at Primary Health Units (UBS).

triage.headline_ja: サンパウロ州で麻疹の新規症例が1件確認され、州内の累計は37例に
triage.triage_reason: 麻疹症例が継続的に発生しており未接種者が多いが、大規模な流行や国際的拡大の兆候はなく、現時点では監視対応が中心の事案。
triage.notes: 37例中27例が未接種または不完全接種者であり、ワクチン接種率の低さが感染拡大リスクを示唆。ただし地方自治体レベルで監視・対応が行われており、外部支援の必要性は低い。
