article.articleHeadline: Flu Burung Pernah Mewabah di Indonesia, Begini Cara Pemerintah Menekan Penyebarannya
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Avian influenza has previously broken out in Indonesia; here's how the government is containing its spread.
article.articleSummary: Indonesia's avian influenza (AI) vaccination program, initiated after the 2003 outbreak, is highlighted as a cornerstone of the country's animal-health policy. Speaking in Bogor on 24 September 2026, Dr. Agung Suganda of the Ministry of Agriculture said vaccination preserves poultry health and productivity, and has helped prevent outbreaks while keeping production high. He noted that despite initial global resistance to AI vaccination, Indonesia’s experience shows the approach can eliminate large-scale farm losses; there have been no AI outbreaks since 2003, with only minimal residual cases. The strategy has influenced other countries to adopt vaccination to protect livestock health, food security, and livelihoods. Additionally, Indonesia's animal-health sector is expanding vaccine development and distribution, including to several African markets, underscoring vaccines as a preventive pillar for the sector.

triage.headline_ja: インドネシアで過去に鳥インフルエンザが流行、政府はどのように感染拡大を抑えたか
triage.triage_reason: 本記事は2003年以降のインドネシアの鳥インフルエンザワクチン接種政策に関する歴史的・政策解説であり、現在進行中のアウトブレイクの報告ではない。新規感染事例の発生は述べられていない。
triage.notes: 記事は2003年以降アウトブレイクがないと明記しており、現行の感染症イベントではないため対象国の verified_locations には含めない。政策・ワクチン戦略の紹介記事。

article.articleHeadline: भिवानी में लंपी से गोवंश प्रभावित: गो किसान समृद्धि ट्रस्ट ने उठाए रोकथाम पर सवाल, सरकार से वैक्सीन, दवा और चिकित्सा दल भेजने की अपील
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Cattle affected by Lumpy Skin Disease in Bhiwani: Gau Kisan Samriddhi Trust raises questions about prevention, appeals to the government to send vaccines, medicines, and medical teams.
article.articleSummary: Lumpy Skin Disease affecting cattle in Bhiwani district, Haryana, has prompted the Gau Kisan Samriddhi Trust to demand urgent government action. The trust urges deployment of veterinary medical teams, vaccination campaigns, and ready treatment facilities for sick animals in affected villages. Its president, Mahendra Singh Godara, notes that LSD in 2022 devastated cattle herds and caused farmers’ financial losses, urging lessons be implemented to curb a recurrence. He claims neighboring Rajasthan is witnessing rapid spread, urging Haryana’s veterinary department to intensify surveillance and take immediate measures in affected areas. In 2022, the trust conducted about 400 village awareness programs and submitted memoranda to officials, including a foot march from Seewani to Bhiwani. The group calls for effective medicines and vaccines. Locally, a goshalas in Khawa is treating ill cattle, offering a free medicinal decoction to farmers and workers; officials are urged to provide broader support, vaccination, testing, and timely care.

triage.headline_ja: ビワニ市でランピースキン病により牛が影響を受ける：ゴウ・キサン・サムリッディ・トラストが予防対策に疑問、政府にワクチン・薬・医療チームの派遣を要請
triage.triage_reason: 動物疾病（人獣共通感染症ではない）であり公衆衛生への直接的影響は不明だが、インド国内で拡大傾向にあり、地域の畜産業への影響と政府支援要請があるため経過観察が妥当。
triage.notes: ランピースキン病は牛の疾患であり、ヒトへの感染性はないため公衆衛生上のリスクは基本的に低い。ただし畜産経済への影響と地域拡大（ラジャスタン州にも波及）が報告されており、動物衛生上の観点から継続監視が望ましい。

article.articleHeadline: Congo's Ebola outbreak spreads as North Kivu hospitals fill up
article.articleSummary: Congo’s eastern Ebola outbreak centers on North Kivu and Ituri, with spillover to South Ubangi. The Kitatumba Ebola treatment center in Butembo is at full capacity (29 beds) as cases surge; two new centers were opened in Butembo, bringing the city’s total to four. A 10-year-old boy died in triage before admission, illustrating patient delays and triage strain. The Bundibugyo species has circulated for months and was only confirmed in Ituri in May, complicating response amid funding cuts, surveillance gaps, armed conflict, and no approved vaccines or treatments for this strain. As of Tuesday, Congo reported 7,820 confirmed cases and 3,779 deaths; Ituri remains worst-affected, while North Kivu accounts for about one-third of new cases and deaths. WHO notes a geographic redistribution and a massive outbreak, with mistrust and attacks on responders hindering containment; some Ituri areas show slowing transmission, but officials warn against assuming resolution.

triage.headline_ja: コンゴのエボラ出血熱、北キブ州の病院が満床となる中で拡大
triage.triage_reason: エボラ出血熱の大規模アウトブレイク（累計7,820症例、3,779死亡）が継続し、承認されたワクチン・治療法がない株であること、武力紛争や資金不足による対応困難、地理的拡大が認められるためIHR基準複数該当。
triage.notes: Bundibugyo種のエボラで承認済みワクチン・治療薬がなく、武力紛争や資金不足により対応が困難。北キブ州・イトゥリ州で症例急増、南ウバンギ州にも波及。WHOは地理的再分布と大規模アウトブレイクを指摘。

article.articleHeadline: Lapas Cianjur Gelar Pemeriksaan Kesehatan Untuk Cegah Penyakit Menular
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Cianjur Prison Holds Health Examinations to Prevent Infectious Diseases.
article.articleSummary: Cianjur Class IIB Prison conducted free health screenings for 150 individuals (100 inmates and 50 staff) in collaboration with the Cianjur Health Office and Cianjur Puskesmas to curb infectious disease spread, notably tuberculosis (TB). The initiative aims for early detection of health issues and prompt follow-up by health workers if any indicators are found, following established procedures. Prison warden Prayogo Mubarak stressed that health is essential in a shared prison environment, making early detection crucial. By implementing routine assessments, authorities seek to identify health concerns sooner and prevent potential transmission within the facility, contributing to broader public health efforts in Cianjur Regency.

triage.headline_ja: チアンジュル刑務所、感染症予防のため健康診断を実施
triage.triage_reason: 刑務所内での予防的な健康診断・早期発見の取り組みに関する内容であり、異常な発生や公衆衛生上の深刻な影響を示す情報はない。

article.articleHeadline: RDC : la déforestation et l'exploitation minière pointées parmi les facteurs de l'épidémie d'Ebola - LePotentiel
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: DRC: Deforestation and Mining Highlighted as Factors in the Ebola Outbreak - LePotentiel
article.articleSummary: Deforestation and mining are identified as key environmental drivers of the Ebola outbreak in the Democratic Republic of Congo, according to Prof. Pierre-Albert Ngueliele during a Kinshasa conference on Ebola-environment interactions. Deforestation is highlighted as the leading factor, followed by mining activity. Ngueliele argues that urgent Ebola response measures must be paired with environmental safeguards, calling for stronger public policies to curb rapid forest loss and unregulated mining that damage forests, savannas, and rivers. He stresses that epidemic control should integrate environmental considerations, especially in areas where human activities alter ecosystems. The conference underscored the health–environment–economic nexus and highlighted ongoing challenges in the DRC regarding forest preservation and resource exploitation, emphasizing that effective outbreak management cannot ignore environmental context.

triage.headline_ja: DRC：森林伐採と鉱山開発がエボラ流行の要因として指摘される - LePotentiel
triage.triage_reason: エボラ流行自体は既知の事象であり、本記事は環境要因についての専門家見解に焦点を当てた分析記事であるため、新規シグナルというより既存流行の背景情報として経過観察が妥当。
triage.notes: 本記事はエボラ流行そのものの新規報告ではなく、既存の流行に対する環境要因（森林伐採・鉱山開発）の分析・提言に焦点を当てたもの。流行の規模・症例数・死亡者数など疫学的詳細は記載されていないため、既存のRRA対象イベントの続報として扱うのが適切。

article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Double attack of swine flu and viral infections in Bhopal: 80 patients diagnosed, 2 dead; 30% of patients in the OPD are suffering from seasonal illnesses.
article.articleSummary: Swine flu (H1N1) and other respiratory viruses are spreading in Bhopal and across Madhya Pradesh as cooler weather arrives. In Bhopal, the last month has seen 80 confirmed H1N1 cases with 2 fatalities. Outpatient departments report a rise in viral infections, with about 30% of OPD attendees presenting seasonal illnesses. The article notes weather change as a driver but provides no laboratory confirmation details or specific symptoms. No information on infection sources or imported/exported cases is given. The report, from Nai Dunia correspondents in Bhopal, highlights an ongoing urban and statewide health concern during the early cold season. Published date: 2026-09-25.

article.articleHeadline: Ebola : un notable recommande le renforcement de la sensibilisation communautaire à Oicha - ACP
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Ebola: a prominent figure recommends strengthening community sensitization in Oicha - ACP
article.articleSummary: An influential notable in Oicha, North Kivu, DRC, calls for intensified community sensitization and strict observance of Ebola preventive measures as the outbreak persists. In remarks to ACP on 25 September 2026, Gervais Kanzalinzali urged ongoing efforts to educate residents about Ebola, criticizing those who minimize its seriousness or dismiss it as a hoax or profitable topic. Citing information from the Oicha health zone, he noted 22 confirmed Ebola cases and argued this should prompt greater vigilance to protect uninfected people. He urged youths and youth organizations to join forces in educating communities that Ebola requires constant attention and adherence to preventive guidance from health workers. He warned against politicizing the issue, stressing that protecting youths and families hinges on continued outreach and compliance with preventive measures.

article.articleHeadline: 中部爆病例 秋節連假嚴防登革熱 | 中華日報|中華新聞雲
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Central Taiwan sees a surge in cases; strict dengue fever prevention during the Mid-Autumn Festival long weekend.
article.articleSummary: As of 25 September 2026, Central Taiwan reports a new locally acquired dengue fever case amid the Mid-Autumn Festival long weekend, prompting intensified prevention by the Tainan City Government. Nationally, 174 dengue-confirmed cases have been recorded, including 11 locally transmitted; the rest are imported from Southeast Asia and South Asia, with Vietnam contributing 42, Indonesia 29, and the Philippines 20. A recent Central Taiwan local case tested positive for Dengue Virus Type 1, with the strain similar to earlier Vietnam-imported strains. The CDC Southern District Center and the National Health Research Institutes’ Center for Mosquito-borne Disease Prevention and Control, along with other agencies, held the eighth interagency dengue prevention working group meeting. They urged medical facilities to heighten symptom screening, use rapid diagnostic tests, and report suspected cases promptly to prevent community spread, while advising the public to eliminate standing water before reunions.

article.articleHeadline: Ufes participa de pesquisa internacional que busca cura para Hepatite B - Sim Notícias
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: UFES participates in international research that seeks a cure for Hepatitis B - Sim Notícias
article.articleSummary: International collaboration led by Johns Hopkins Medicine seeks a cure for Hepatitis B through the BICC study, including Brazil (Hucam-Ufes, USP), the United States, India, Senegal, and Uganda. The study monitors chronic Hepatitis B patients, including those co-infected with HIV, to understand disease progression and translate findings into clinical practice. In Espírito Santo, Hucam-Ufes, led by Tânia Reuter, will follow 75 patients over a five-year period. Recruitment at Hucam runs July 2026–June 2027—or until 75 participants are enrolled—with a consortium-wide target of 600 participants: 400 with HIV/HBV co-infection and 200 with HBV alone. Chronic HBV can cause cirrhosis and liver cancer; vaccines exist but no cure. Hucam currently treats about 850 chronic HBV patients, representing a large share of viral hepatitis care in Espírito Santo, with partnerships with Grande Vitória municipalities and the State Health Secretariat to broaden participation. The study is translational, aiming to bring lab discoveries closer to cure.

article.articleHeadline: Sorotipo III de Streptococcus agalactiae chega a Minas Gerais e amplia alerta sanitário na tilapicultura
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Streptococcus agalactiae serotype III arrives in Minas Gerais and broadens sanitary alert in tilapia farming.
article.articleSummary: Streptococcus agalactiae serotype III has arrived in Minas Gerais, including the Triângulo Mineiro, expanding the sanitary alert for tilapia farming. After outbreaks in the Northeast (Piauí, Pernambuco, Ceará, Bahia) with 25–35% mortality in affected lots, the pathogen has been detected in the Southeast. The SIMPOP symposium data show that movement of juveniles and lot exchanges likely drive regional spread, though the Paraná region remains uncertain. Whole-genome sequencing confirms serotype III ST283, but reveals genetic differences between Northeast isolates and newer Minas Gerais samples, aiding reconstruction of dispersion when combined with dates and supply chains. More than 12,500 fish have been analyzed over six years, enabling regional risk maps to guide diagnosis and vaccination strategies. Pathogen movement is dynamic; vaccination programs must consider regional pathogen presence. Published 2026-09-25.

triage.headline_ja: Streptococcus agalactiae セロタイプIIIがミナスジェライス州に到達し、ティラピア養殖における衛生警戒を拡大
triage.triage_reason: 対象は魚類（ティラピア）の水産養殖病であり、ヒトの公衆衛生への直接的な影響は報告されていない。動物疾患カテゴリのみで人獣共通感染症としての言及もなく、対象国（ブラジル）ではあるが人への健康リスクを示す情報がないためフルRRA対象外。
triage.notes: 本事例は水産養殖業（ティラピア）における魚類の細菌感染症であり、ヒトへの感染リスクについての記載はない。Streptococcus agalactiaeはヒトにも感染する可能性がある種だが、本記事は水産業の経済的損失・衛生管理の観点に限定されている。

article.articleHeadline: Cuma Flu, Anak Tetap Sekolah? Belajar dari Influenza A
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Just the Flu, Do Kids Still Go to School? Lessons from Influenza A.
article.articleSummary: Published 2026-09-25: Influenza A is discussed; the piece questions whether school-aged children with respiratory illness should attend school, highlighting broader public health implications for classmates and household members. Influenza A (and B) drive seasonal flu; common symptoms include fever that comes on abruptly, cough, sore throat, runny nose, muscle aches, fatigue. Despite Indonesia's Ministry of Health surveillance update as of 19 September 2026 showing flu activity still categorized as low, vigilance remains, especially for children under 5, and particularly under 2, and those with asthma or chronic conditions. The author cites CDC guidance: fever or worsening/untreated respiratory symptoms warrant staying home. Return to school criteria: fever-free for at least 24 hours without antipyretics, overall respiratory symptoms improved for at least 24 hours, and the child well enough to participate. Light cough may persist after recovery; decisions should consider the child's overall condition and school policy.

article.articleHeadline: Tamil Nadu shocker: 40 students fall ill after dead lizard found in government school sambar; 2 cooks relieved | Today News
article.articleSummary: Dead lizard found in sambar served as part of Tamil Nadu government's midday meal at Kottaiyur Middle School (Kadambathur block, Tiruvallur district) triggered illness in about 40 students, prompting hospital assessments for vomiting, dizziness, and related symptoms. The incident, linked to the Tamil Nadu Chief Minister's Breakfast Scheme, has led Tiruvallur Collector S. Kavitha to relieve two cooks (Arthi, Dhanalakshmi) and initiate disciplinary proceedings against the headmaster, a teacher, and the block development officer overseeing the program. Initial investigations point to contamination via a shed-style kitchen that could have allowed a lizard to enter the food. Authorities ordered thorough cleaning, insect control, and repainting of the premises; teachers have been instructed to sample meals before distribution as a precaution. Police reported no ongoing cases of food poisoning among students or staff at this time; investigation ongoing.

article.articleHeadline: Molécula elimina parasita da malária sem resistência
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Molecule Eliminates the Malaria Parasite Without Resistance.
article.articleSummary: Malaria: A new molecule, designated 2d, eliminates Plasmodium falciparum and P. vivax in laboratory tests and in mice, without resistance development. WHO 2025 estimates over 282 million malaria cases and about 610,000 deaths, with 75% of victims under five. The international team, including the Institute of Physics of São Carlos (IFSC), USP, modified known antimalarials to create 18 synthetic compounds from pironaridine and quinacrine. 2d proved effective against multidrug-resistant P. falciparum strains and against parasite samples from patients in Porto Velho, Rondônia, Brazil, and from the Amazon. Microscopy shows 2d accumulates near the parasite’s digestive vacuole, blocking detoxification of a toxic byproduct and causing death by poisoning. In mice, oral 2d eliminated circulating parasites with 100% survival after 30 days, and no resistance emerged. Further development—toxicity tests, pharmacology optimization, and human trials—will pursue regulatory approval (e.g., Anvisa).

article.articleHeadline: O que é a doença mão-pé-boca?
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: What is hand, foot, and mouth disease?
article.articleSummary: Hand, foot, and mouth disease (HFMD) is described on Consultório do Rádio Livre, a Brazilian radio segment from Rádio Jornal. Pediatrician and neonatologist Dr. Amanda Pereira Duncan says the infection is caused by a virus and highly contagious, producing painful, sometimes itchy skin lesions that can occur beyond the hands, feet, and mouth. Pediatric infectious disease specialist Dr. Alexandra Costa notes transmission via respiratory droplets. The program recommends that an affected child avoid contact with others and practice strict hand hygiene to prevent spread. Common in young children, the discussion emphasizes minimizing exposure during illness and urges parents and caregivers to seek guidance from healthcare professionals.

article.articleHeadline: Doenças emergentes na pecuária de corte
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Emerging Diseases in Beef Cattle Production
article.articleSummary: Brazil is the world’s leading beef exporter, with market access dependent on rigorous herd-health verification and surveillance for emerging diseases. In 2025, the World Organisation for Animal Health (OIE) recognized Brazil as Foot-and-Mouth Disease-free without vaccination; maintaining this status requires ongoing vigilance, rapid notification of suspected cases, and adherence to sanitary standards to sustain access to major import markets. Emerging diseases are shaped by climate-driven shifts in vectors (ticks, flies, mosquitoes), intensified production, antimicrobial resistance, and wildlife–livestock interfaces (wild boar, bats, capybaras). Key threats and risk factors include: Foot-and-Mouth Disease; Bovine Parasitic Tristeza (TPB); Bovine Viral Diarrhea (BVD) and Infectious Bovine Rhinotracheitis (IBR); Bovine Respiratory Disease complex; Leptospirosis; Bovine Trichomoniasis; Bovine Trypanosomiasis; Avian Influenza; Contagious Nodular Dermatitis; Epizootic Hemorrhagic Disease. Several are not yet recorded in Brazil but are part of MAPA import requirements for bovine genetic material.

triage.headline_ja: 肉牛生産における新興疾病
triage.triage_reason: 実際の発生事例報告ではなく、ブラジルの牛肉輸出産業における新興疾病リスクや監視体制についての一般的な解説記事であるため。
triage.notes: 記事は具体的な発生事例を報じるものではなく、ブラジルの牛肉産業における疾病サーベイランス体制や口蹄疫清浄国ステータス維持の重要性を説明する業界向け解説記事。複数の疾病（口蹄疫、レプトスピラ症、鳥インフルエンザ等）が列挙されているが、いずれも実際の発生確認ではなくリスク要因としての言及。

article.articleHeadline: বাড়ছে শ্বাসতন্ত্রের সংক্রমণ, বাতাসেই ছড়িয়ে থাকে যক্ষ্মার জীবাণু, রোগ থেকে বাঁচতে কী করবেন? জানাচ্ছেন চিকিৎসক
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Rising respiratory infections; Mycobacterium tuberculosis spreads through the air; what should you do to protect yourself from the disease? Doctor explains.
article.articleSummary: Rising respiratory infections in Kolkata are linked to weather changes and severe air pollution. Mycobacterium tuberculosis, the TB-causing bacterium, spreads via airborne droplets when an infected person coughs, sneezes, talks, or spits; inhaled droplets reach the lungs and cause infection. Protection includes masks, covering coughs with a tissue or elbow, nutritious diet, and soap-and-water handwashing. BCG vaccination is mandatory for newborns; pneumococcal vaccine is recommended for adults over 65 or those with diabetes, kidney or liver disease, cancer, AIDS, or on steroids. Influenza vaccine is advised to prevent flu and pneumonia. Avoid antibiotic misuse to prevent resistance; seek medical advice for respiratory symptoms. Vitamin D from 15–20 minutes of daily sunlight, adequate hydration, and good sleep support immunity. TB treatment via DOTS is free at government centers for a full 6-month course; non-adherence risks drug-resistant TB.

article.articleHeadline: DR Congo running short of health workers as Ebola outbreak intensifies, WHO says
article.articleSummary: DR Congo faces an Ebola outbreak across seven provinces, with 7,773 confirmed cases and 3,759 deaths. North Kivu surged 73% over three weeks before later declines, while Ituri fell 26% and Haut-Uele 15% between Aug 31 and Sept 20, 2026. The epidemic remains largely out of control over a wide geographic area. Severe health worker shortages complicate response: a single Ebola treatment centre requires about 300 professionals, with staffing bottlenecks worsened by armed insecurity, displacement, large population movement, and strikes. Wage disputes and payroll verification reveal ghost workers and unpaid salaries. Children under five have case fatality rates above 60%, adults around 40%. Authorities warn the crisis could eclipse the 2014–2016 West Africa outbreak (Guinea, Liberia, Sierra Leone) unless foreign funding, security guarantees for aid workers, and rapid scale-up of personnel accompany intensified containment efforts.

triage.headline_ja: コンゴ民主共和国、エボラ出血熱の流行拡大に伴い医療従事者不足に直面 ― WHOが警告

article.articleHeadline: Nagaland: Measles outbreak reported in Tizit, health department intensifies surveillance
article.articleSummary: Measles outbreak reported in Tizit block, Mon district, Nagaland, prompting intensified surveillance, vaccination, and public-awareness efforts. The Nagaland Health and Family Department, led by Mon CMO Supongmenla Walling and district programme manager Moie Bonnie Konyak, held a block-level review at Community Health Centre, Tizit to assess outbreak status. A measles vaccination drive is planned from October 12, with advance awareness activities and a revised immunisation micro-plan, including lists of unvaccinated children to guide implementation. A World Health Organization field team conducted an on-site assessment and coordinated with district health authorities, followed by a meeting with the district administration to bolster public awareness and information dissemination in affected villages. The Health Department outlined measures to contain transmission and prevent further spread. The article does not report any case or death counts.

article.articleHeadline: Alerta de dengue: veja a lista de 35 bairros com risco alto - ACidade ON Campinas
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Dengue Alert: See the List of 35 Neighborhoods at High Risk - ACidade ON Campinas
article.articleSummary: Campinas' Health Secretariat issued the 39th Arboviral Alert of 2026, naming 35 neighborhoods with higher dengue transmission risk in the last week. Regions affected span East, Northwest, North, Southwest, South and Southeast. Examples include Parque São Quirino, Jardim Campos Elíseos, Vila Orosimbo Maia, Jardim Nova Europa, Jardim Itatiaia, and Jardim Amazonas. There have been 3,998 dengue cases in Campinas from January 1 to September 21, 2026, with no dengue deaths thus far. To curb arboviruses, authorities will intensify vector-control in these areas; 1,240,442 property visits and 53,382 fogging operations were conducted Jan 1 to Sep 15. The alert notes that 80% of Aedes aegypti breeding sites are inside residences; residents should remove standing water, regularly change water in plant pots, seal water tanks, and keep yards clear.

triage.headline_ja: デング熱警報：リスクの高い35地区のリストを確認 - ACidade ON Campinas
triage.triage_reason: ブラジル・カンピーナス市における季節性デング熱の定例サーベイランス情報であり、死亡例もなく、地方自治体による通常のベクター対策活動の一環と考えられるため、異常性・国際的拡大リスクは認められない。
triage.notes: デング熱はブラジルで毎年流行する風土病であり、本記事は地方自治体（カンピーナス市保健局）による定例の第39回アルボウイルスアラートで、死亡例ゼロ、通常のベクター対策活動の報告に留まる。国際的な関心や支援要請の兆候は見られない。

article.articleHeadline: La Namibie, touchée par la fièvre aphteuse, suspend ses exportations de viande
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Namibia, affected by foot-and-mouth disease, suspends its meat exports.
article.articleSummary: Foot-and-mouth disease (FMD) outbreaks in Namibia prompt an immediate suspension of bovine and ovine meat exports after the first southern-focused outbreak in six decades. FMD is a highly contagious viral disease of cattle, sheep, and goats, causing fever, vesicles, lameness, and sometimes death, but it poses no risk to humans. The virus breached a sanitary cordon separating northern endemic areas from the southern outbreak zone, marking Namibia’s first epidemic since independence (1990). Namibia becomes the eighth Southern African nation affected by FMD since the start of the year, following Botswana, Lesotho, Mozambique, South Africa, Zambia, and Zimbabwe. In 2025 Namibia exported over 13,000 tonnes of beef, with more than 90% shipped to Europe. The government ordered an immediate halt to all cattle slaughter; Meatco is evaluating in-transit beef shipments and declined to comment on recalls.

article.articleHeadline: Việt Nam launches hand, foot and mouth vaccine for young children
article.articleSummary: Envacgen, a vaccine against EV71-caused hand, foot and mouth disease, launched nationwide in Việt Nam for children from two months to under six years, rolled out via the VNVC Vaccination System at nearly 300 centres. Phase-3 Việt Nam trials with >3,000 children showed 96.8% efficacy against EV71-associated HFMD, no EV71 cases among vaccinees, and a strong immune response to multiple EV71 sub-genotypes; safety was favorable with sustained protection in follow-up. Taiwan has administered >600,000 doses since 2023. In Việt Nam, HFMD is a major pediatric concern; 2023 saw >181,000 cases and 31 deaths, with EV71 accounting for about 82% of hospitalisations and 90.4% of severe cases. Day one saw tens of thousands of registrations across Hà Nội, HCM City, Đà Nẵng, Cần Thơ; under-three children comprised ~70%. The program aims to reduce outbreaks and severe disease during peak season.

triage.headline_ja: ベトナムが幼児向け手足口病ワクチンの接種を開始
triage.triage_reason: 本記事は既存の風土病であるHFMD（EV71）に対する新規ワクチン導入のニュースであり、新規アウトブレイクや異常事態の発生を報じるものではないため、シグナルとしての緊急性は低い。
triage.notes: 記事は過去(2023年)のHFMD流行統計を引用しつつ、新ワクチン(Envacgen)の全国展開開始を報じるもの。新規の感染症アウトブレイクの発生を示す内容ではないためDISMISSと判断。Taiwanは接種実績の参考情報として言及されているのみで、発生地域ではない。

article.articleHeadline: 彰化50多歲夫妻富國島旅遊 返台發燒確診登革熱 ｜ 公視新聞網 PNN
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Couple in their 50s from Changhua travel to Phu Quoc Island; after returning to Taiwan, developed fever and were diagnosed with dengue fever | PTS News Network (PNN).
article.articleSummary: Two imported dengue fever cases in Changhua County, Taiwan involve a middle-aged couple who traveled to Phu Quoc Island, Vietnam from Sep 12–15 and returned with headache, fever and rash. After an initial clinic visit on Sep 21 and persistent symptoms, a rapid test was positive and they were diagnosed on Sep 23; both are hospitalized. The tour group included 21 travelers across four counties, with health authorities conducting follow-up. Around the couple’s home, 75 households were surveyed; 38 standing-water containers were positive for mosquito breeding, indicating elevated risk of Aedes transmission. Large-scale disinfection and source reduction were implemented to curb spread. Officials urge returning travelers to seek medical care within two weeks of return and disclose travel history; emphasize eliminating standing water to block breeding. Southeast Asia travel is driving imported dengue risk, and repeat infections may lead to severe dengue with hemorrhagic complications.

triage.headline_ja: 彰化在住の50代夫婦、フーコック島旅行後に発熱、デング熱と診断（台湾）
triage.triage_reason: 台湾における輸入症例（ベトナム・フーコック島渡航歴あり）で、地域内蚊媒介リスクへの対応は行われているが、国際的な公衆衛生上の重大性や渡航制限等の懸念は認められない。
triage.notes: 本事例は台湾（対象国リスト外）での輸入症例だが、感染地はベトナム（フーコック島）。台湾は対象国リストに含まれないため、verified_locationsにはVietnamのみ記載。地域の蚊媒介リスク（ボウフラ発生）に対する防疫対応が実施されている。

article.articleHeadline: Schools told to step up measures against dengue, other infections in Erode
article.articleSummary: On 25 September 2026, in Erode district, Tamil Nadu, schools were instructed to curb dengue, malaria and other infections by preventing water stagnation, removing mosquito breeding sources, and keeping campuses clean. Weekly fever and mosquito-control awareness programmes were ordered. Each school must cover overhead and underground water tanks, remove containers that hold water, trim vegetation, and maintain hygienic surroundings. A designated teacher should monitor these measures and lead ongoing student education on personal hygiene, handwashing, safe drinking water, and cleanliness. District Health Officer P. Aruna outlined transmission and prevention for dengue, malaria, scrub typhus, leptospirosis and related diseases. Students with fever, headache, body pain, vomiting or diarrhea should be taken to the nearest government health facility and should not attend school. HPV vaccination for girls aged 14-15 to prevent cervical cancer was emphasized. Coordination between School Education and Health Departments, led by District Collector S. Kandasamy, was requested.

triage.headline_ja: エロード地区の学校にデング熱などの感染症対策強化を指示
triage.triage_reason: 季節性の予防的注意喚起であり、異常な流行や重症例の急増を示す情報はなく、通常の学校向け衛生対策の指示に留まる。
triage.notes: 地方自治体（District Health/Education Departments）による予防的・季節的な啓発活動の指示であり、実際の症例数急増や異常な発生パターンは記載されていない。

article.articleHeadline: Itapeva registra 30 casos confirmados de dengue, segundo boletim atualizado - Jornal Ita News
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Itapeva records 30 confirmed dengue cases, according to the latest bulletin - Ita News Journal
article.articleSummary: Itapeva reports 30 confirmed dengue cases (out of 574 notified) as of 22 September 2026, per the municipal Health Department dengue bulletin. No dengue-related hospitalizations or suspected deaths have been recorded to date. The dengue virus remains circulating in the municipality. Health authorities urge residents to prevent Aedes aegypti proliferation through about 10 minutes of weekly yard inspections, eliminating water-collecting containers, cleaning gutters and drains, keeping water tanks capped, and properly disposing of materials that can breed mosquitoes. The city reiterates the campaign: 'Sem água parada, sem mosquito, sem dengue!' For information and reports, residents can call 0800 090 0134 or follow Instagram @saudeitapeva.

triage.headline_ja: イタペヴァ、最新報告によりデング熱確定症例30件を記録
triage.triage_reason: デング熱は当該地域の風土病であり、症例数も少なく重症例・死亡例なし。異常性や国際的拡大リスクも認められない。
triage.notes: ブラジルは対象国リストに含まれていないため verified_locations は空。地方自治体レベルの日常的な公衆衛生報告であり、シグナルとして取り上げる必要性は低い。

article.articleHeadline: Scientists begin monitoring UK for hidden Ebola & deadly 'eye-bleeding disease'
article.articleSummary: UK Health Security Agency expands the Prism wastewater surveillance programme to detect dangerous infections—Ebola, Marburg virus, Crimean-Congo hemorrhagic fever, and Lassa fever—in UK sewage and hospital waste to prevent outbreaks. None have emerged in the UK, but all are listed pandemic threats by UKHSA and WHO. The scheme will also sample waste from busy sites and transport hubs; wastewater testing for poliovirus continues, and Prism originated by tracking norovirus strains to inform winter pressures. Prof. Robin May notes the goal is early detection and strengthened pandemic preparedness, with potential future expansion to rural settings. Ebola is rare but deadly and not airborne; a positive UK test would trigger transfer to High Level Isolation Units at facilities such as the Royal Free (London) or Royal Victoria Infirmary (Newcastle). The effort follows warnings and posters for travellers from DRC and Uganda amid a major DRC outbreak (over 3,000 deaths).

triage.headline_ja: 科学者ら、英国で潜伏エボラ出血熱と致死性の『眼出血病』の監視を開始
triage.triage_reason: 本記事は英国下水サーベイランスプログラム(Prism)の拡大に関する内容であり、英国内での実際の感染確認はない。DRCのアウトブレイクは背景情報として言及されているのみで、本記事の主題ではない。
triage.notes: 記事はUKの予防的サーベイランス体制強化がテーマ。DRCでの大規模エボラアウトブレイク（3000人以上死亡）は背景として言及されているが、本記事の主題ではなく、新規発生報告でもないため対象国から除外した。UK自体は対象国リストに含まれない。

article.articleHeadline: Công tác phòng, chống bệnh dại vẫn còn nhiều trở ngại
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Rabies prevention and control efforts still face numerous obstacles.
article.articleSummary: Rabies remains a major public health challenge in Vietnam. During 2022–2025, rabies deaths reached 323 nationwide (mean 80.75/year), up 8.8% from 2017–2021 (74.2/year). A September 25 conference in Buon Ma Thuot, Dak Lak, led by the Ministry of Health and the Ministry of Agriculture and Rural Development, reviewed control efforts. From 2017–2021, dogs and cats numbered about 7.47 million, with an average vaccination rate of 49.2%, far below the 70% target required to interrupt dog-to-human transmission. Across 2022–2025, 1,119 outbreaks were recorded, involving 1,482 animals infected and 2,069 killed; by Sep 21, 2026, 171 outbreaks occurred in 22 provinces. Human PEP uptake rose to about 2.56 million treatments (years not specified). Vaccination coverage across provinces is uneven: 2024 highs 61.19%, 2025 42.66%, and by Sep 2026 49.71%, with Dak Lak reporting 15–37.3% in 2022–2025. The program emphasizes One Health and VAHIS integration, but gaps in dog management and vaccination persist.

triage.headline_ja: 狂犬病の予防・制圧対策には依然として多くの障害がある
triage.triage_reason: ベトナムにおける狂犬病は既知の風土病であり、本記事は行政会議での対策状況のレビューであって新規の異常事象ではないが、ワクチン接種率が目標を大きく下回り死亡者数も増加傾向にあるため、今後の推移を注視する必要がある。
triage.notes: 本記事はベトナムの保健省・農業農村開発省合同会議での狂犬病対策の進捗レビューであり、2022〜2025年の死亡者数増加やワクチン接種率の地域差（目標70%に対し平均49.2%）など、既存の課題が継続していることを示す統計報告。新規の異常発生というよりも既知の風土病対策の遅れを示すものであり、フルRRAよりも継続監視が適切と判断した。

article.articleHeadline: الصحة العالمية انخفاض إصابات إيبولا مع ارتفاع أعداد المتعافين
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: World Health Organization: Ebola infections decline as the number of recoveries rises.
article.articleSummary: As of 25 September 2026, the World Health Organization reports Ebola infections are declining with rising recoveries, though response challenges remain in the Democratic Republic of the Congo (DRC) amid active armed conflict. The outbreak is caused by the Bundibugyo strain of Ebola, first identified in 2007 in Bundibugyo, Uganda, and named after that district. The strain re-emerged in 2012 in Ituri Province, DRC, and has reappeared about 14 years later in the same region. Early response faced obstacles, including limited diagnostic tools and the absence of licensed vaccines or treatments for this strain, though there are therapies and vaccines in trials.

triage.headline_ja: 世界保健機関：エボラ出血熱の感染者数が減少し、回復者数が増加
triage.triage_reason: コンゴ民主共和国でエボラ出血熱（ブンディブギョ株）のアウトブレイクが継続中で、武力紛争により対応が困難な状況にあり、公衆衛生上の重大な懸念があるため。
triage.notes: ウガンダは1976年の株の発見地として言及されているが、現在の発生地はDRCイトゥリ州であるため、verified_locationsからは除外した。武力紛争により対応が困難な状況が続いている点に注意。

article.articleHeadline: Enchente do Rio Iguaçu acende alerta para casos de leptospirose
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Iguaçu River flood raises alert for leptospirosis cases.
article.articleSummary: Flooding from the Iguaçu River in União da Vitória raises leptospirosis risk. Leptospira bacteria spread mainly through contact with floodwater or mud contaminated with urine from infected rats. Transmission occurs when entering affected homes, handling belongings, or cleaning waterlogged areas. Incubation ranges from 1 to 30 days, most often 7–14 days after exposure. Early symptoms mimic flu: fever, headache, muscle pains (calves), chills, loss of appetite, nausea, vomiting; diarrhea, joint pains, eye changes, cough may occur. Some cases progress to renal failure, jaundice, hemorrhage, pulmonary involvement, potentially death without treatment. Prevention emphasizes avoiding floodwater contact; use rubber boots, waterproof boots, gloves; wash with soap and water after leaving the water; clean mud with PPE, disinfect areas; discard foods touched by floodwater; ensure potable water. Diagnosis via clinical evaluation and lab tests; treated with antibiotics; do not self-medicate. Reinforce post-flood hygiene and rodent control.

triage.headline_ja: イグアス川の氾濫、レプトスピラ症患者急増への警戒を喚起
triage.triage_reason: 洪水後のレプトスピラ症リスクに関する一般的な予防啓発記事であり、実際の症例数や異常な流行拡大の報告がないため、シグナルとしての優先度は低い。
triage.notes: 記事は洪水後のレプトスピラ症予防に関する一般的な注意喚起であり、具体的な感染者数や重症例の報告は含まれていない。地域限定的な公衆衛生広報記事と判断される。

article.articleHeadline: الصحة العالمية: انخفاض إصابات إيبولا مع ارتفاع أعداد المتعافين - اليوم السابع
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: World Health Organization: Ebola infections decline as recoveries rise - The Seventh Day
article.articleSummary: Bundibugyo-strain Ebola virus disease is spreading in the Democratic Republic of Congo, with Ituri as the epicenter and rising activity in North Kivu. About four months after the outbreak was declared, case counts are trending downward and recoveries are increasing, though transmission remains within the DRC amid active armed conflict that hinders surveillance and response. A small number of cases crossed into Uganda but were quickly contained. Early response faced diagnostic gaps and a lack of licensed vaccines or therapeutics specific to the Bundibugyo lineage; some vaccines and treatments are in trials. Community trust remains a major challenge, with emphasis on government leadership and community ownership of the response. The WHO warns that reductions in global health-security funding since COVID-19 hamper preparedness for future pandemics.

triage.headline_ja: 世界保健機関：エボラ感染者数が減少し、回復者数が増加
triage.triage_reason: コンゴ民主共和国で継続中のブンディブギョ株エボラ出血熱の流行で、ウガンダへの越境例も発生しており、武力紛争下でサーベイランスと対応が阻害されている点からIHR基準・WPRO基準を複数満たすためフルRRAへの移行が適切。
triage.notes: ウガンダへの越境例が報告されているが対象国リストに含まれないため verified_locations から除外。感染は主にDRC（イトゥリ州が震源、北キブ州で活動増加）で発生。

article.articleHeadline: Tren kasus pneumonia di Jakbar naik drastis pada triwulan ketiga 2026
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Pneumonia cases in West Jakarta rise sharply in the third quarter of 2026.
article.articleSummary: West Jakarta Health Office reports a sharp rise in pneumonia (lung infection) cases in Q3 2026. Using the New All Records (NAR) data, Q2 recorded 9,688 cases, increasing to 15,998 in Q3. Drivers include climate change, environmental factors and air pollution, plus immune status; pathogen evolution and transmission dynamics; intrinsic vulnerability in children; and smoking, which raises exposure to tobacco smoke. Authorities continue periodic surveillance and have collected samples sent to the Public Health Laboratory Centre (Balai Besar Laboratorium Kesehatan Masyarakat) for further specification of influenza-like illness (ILI) cases. Cross-sector coordination is underway to encourage symptomatic residents to seek care at health facilities. Public health measures urged include adherence to Clean and Healthy Living (PHBS), mask use, and proper cough etiquette to curb transmission.

triage.headline_ja: 西ジャカルタで2026年第3四半期に肺炎症例が急増
triage.triage_reason: 肺炎症例の急増が報告されているが、環境要因や既知の呼吸器疾患による可能性が高く、病原体の特定作業中であるため、続報を注視する必要がある。
triage.notes: 記事では肺炎症例増加の要因として気候変動・大気汚染・免疫状態・喫煙などが挙げられており、特定の新規病原体によるアウトブレイクとは明記されていない。ILI症例の病原体特定結果（インフルエンザ等）の続報が待たれる。

article.articleHeadline: Dinkes Cirebon mengintensifkan tracing Tb hingga 412 desa
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Cirebon Health Office intensifies TB tracing across 412 villages
article.articleSummary: TB tracing expanded across 412 villages in Cirebon Regency, West Java, Indonesia, under the Free Health Check (CKG) program. From early August to the third week of September 2026, tracing reached about 34,000 people in 340 villages. Of roughly 18,000 test results entered into the Ministry of Health system, about 2,200 were suspected TB, with 74 confirmed TB cases receiving immediate treatment and follow-up. Affected households (234 people) are being treated and monitored, while ongoing tracing targets those with contact exposure, coughing, or risk factors such as diabetes mellitus and hypertension. The Dinkes aims to screen 46,600 people (about 100 per village) by end-November 2026. The effort is supported by mobile X-ray units to detect TB and other respiratory disorders, as expansion to all 412 villages proceeds per the regent’s plan.

triage.headline_ja: チルボン保健局、412村に及ぶ結核トレーシングを強化
triage.triage_reason: 結核はインドネシアで地方保健当局による通常の公衆衛生対策（スクリーニング・トレーシング）の一環であり、異常な発生や国際的拡大のリスクは認められない。
triage.notes: 地方自治体による既存の結核対策プログラム（CKG）の一環としての定期的なスクリーニング活動報告であり、新規アウトブレイクや異常事態を示すものではない。

article.articleHeadline: Influenza A Mengintai, Dosen Unair Beri Tips Cegah Penularan pada Anak
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Influenza A Lurks, UNAIR Lecturer Shares Tips to Prevent Transmission to Children
article.articleSummary: Influenza A remains a concern in Indonesia. As of 19 September 2026, Health Ministry data show influenza A accounted for 46% of tests in week 36, up from 35% the prior week. Among 185 specimens tested, 86 were positive: 76 influenza A (H1N1)pdm09, 8 influenza A (H3N2), and 2 influenza B (Victoria). Universitas Airlangga Medical Faculty lecturer dr. Priyo Budi Purwono notes factors such as weather changes and human interactions driving the rise. Influenza A can affect upper and lower respiratory tracts and spreads via respiratory droplets and contaminated objects. Early symptoms emerge after a 1–7 day incubation: fever, body aches, runny nose, sore throat, and cough, often resembling other respiratory infections, complicating clinical diagnosis. Children are more susceptible due to immature hygiene practices and developing immunity. Complications include pneumonia, shortness of breath, adventitious lung sounds, hypoxemia, and potential respiratory failure. Diagnosis relies on nasal/throat swabs; chest X-ray or other tests as indicated.

triage.headline_ja: インフルエンザAが潜伏、エアランガ大学講師が子どもへの感染予防のコツを解説
triage.triage_reason: 季節性インフルエンザAの陽性率上昇が報告されているが、通常の季節性流行の範囲内であり、重大な公衆衛生上の異常性や国際的拡大の兆候は明確でない。
triage.notes: 季節性インフルエンザ（H1N1pdm09主体）の陽性率上昇に関する一般啓発記事であり、重症例クラスターや異常な変異株の報告はない。継続的なサーベイランスデータの推移を注視する。

article.articleHeadline: Leptospirose avança em SP com 347 casos até agosto de 2026
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Leptospirosis advances in São Paulo with 347 cases as of August 2026.
article.articleSummary: Leptospirosis in São Paulo state reaches 347 cases from January–August 2026, with the capital accounting for 93, Mogi das Cruzes and Campinas 34 each, and Santos 33; total 451 cases in 2025. Leptospira bacteria are shed in the urine of infected animals, mainly urban rats, and can contaminate water in flood drains, sewers, and mud. Humans acquire infection from contact with this water or mud, even without skin breaks; incubation is 1–30 days (commonly 7–14). Early symptoms include fever, headache, loss of appetite, nausea/vomiting, and muscle pains (calves), with diarrhea, joint pain, red eyes, and cough also possible. About 15% may develop severe disease with jaundice, kidney failure, hemorrhages, or respiratory distress. Antibiotics are recommended by the SUS at suspicion, most effective in the first week; severe cases may require hospitalization. Prevention centers on avoiding floodwater, wearing boots and gloves, covering cuts, cleaning flooded areas with protective gear, discarding food touched by floodwater, ensuring potable water, and reducing rodent presence.

triage.headline_ja: サンパウロ州でレプトスピラ症が拡大、2026年8月までに347例
triage.triage_reason: サンパウロ州における季節性・地域風土病的なレプトスピラ症の増加報告であり、IHR基準・WPRO基準ともに該当性が低く、国際的関心や支援要請も見られない。
triage.notes: 毎年発生する洪水関連のレプトスピラ症で、2025年の451例と比較しても顕著な異常増加は見られない。ヒト-ヒト感染はなく、国内医療体制（SUS）で対応可能とみられる。

article.articleHeadline: Get yellow fever jab only at govt-authorised centres: Mohali health dept warns against private hospitals - The Tribune
article.articleSummary: As of 25 September 2026, yellow fever vaccination is available only at Government of India-authorised centres in Punjab: Civil Hospital, Mohali, and AIIMS, Bathinda, with private hospitals not authorised. Civil Hospital Mohali administers the vaccine on Mondays, Tuesdays and Fridays. Travellers should bring original passport, photocopies, and required documents. Proof of yellow fever vaccination is mandatory for entry into yellow fever endemic countries; complete vaccination at least two weeks before travel and do not delay. Officials urge vigilance against unauthorised hospitals or certificates; vaccination and certification should be obtained only from authorised centres. Yellow fever is a viral disease transmitted by mosquitoes; vaccination provides effective protection and is particularly important for travellers to endemic countries. Information from Mohali district health department identifies nodal officer Dr Girish Dogra and civil surgeon Dr Sangeeta Jain.

triage.headline_ja: 黄熱病の予防接種は政府認可の施設でのみ受けるように:モハリ保健局が民間病院に対して警告
triage.triage_reason: 本記事はインド国内での黄熱病発生ではなく、渡航者向けワクチン接種の行政案内であり、公衆衛生上の異常事態や国際的拡大リスクは認められない。
triage.notes: 記事はインドのパンジャブ州モハリ地区における黄熱病ワクチン接種の行政手続きに関するもので、インド国内での黄熱病発生を示すものではない。渡航者向けの予防接種案内であり、黄熱病の流行地は主にアフリカ・南米であるため、対象国リストには該当しない。

article.articleHeadline: ข่าวสาร : ศูนย์เวชศาสตร์ชันสูตรและนวัตกรรมด้านสุขภาพสัตว์ คณะสัตวแพทยศาสตร์ มช. ร่วมแสดงความยินดี! "ห้องปฏิบัติการซีรัมวิทยา" ผ่านการทดสอบความชำนาญการตรวจเชื้อไวรัสโรคโลหิตจางติดเชื้อในม้า (EIAV) ระดับประเทศ ประจำปี 2569 - มหาวิทยาลัยเชียงใหม่
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: News: Center for Diagnostic Pathology and Innovation in Animal Health, Faculty of Veterinary Science, Chiang Mai University, congratulates the Serology Laboratory on passing the national proficiency test for detecting Equine Infectious Anemia Virus (EIAV) for the year 2026.
article.articleSummary: As of 25 September 2026, Chiang Mai University’s Center for Diagnostic Pathology and Innovation in Animal Health, Faculty of Veterinary Science, congratulates its Serology Laboratory for passing Thailand’s national proficiency test for detecting antibodies to Equine Infectious Anemia Virus (EIAV) in 2026. The proficiency testing results met acceptance criteria, indicating reliable EIAV antibody detection using Agar Gel Immunodiffusion (AGID). The acknowledgment comes from the National Institute of Animal Health, Department of Livestock Development. The achievement highlights validated laboratory capacity in serology for EIAV, supporting disease surveillance and diagnostic confidence in horses within Thailand. No outbreak or case counts are reported; the note emphasizes quality assurance and ongoing proficiency in AGID-based EIAV antibody testing conducted by the Chiang Mai University facility.

triage.headline_ja: チェンマイ大学獣医学部診断病理・動物衛生イノベーションセンター、血清学研究室が2026年度馬伝染性貧血ウイルス（EIAV）検査の国家技能試験に合格したことを祝福
triage.triage_reason: 実際の発生や症例報告ではなく、検査機関の技能試験合格を伝える内容であり、公衆衛生上の懸念や異常事態は認められない。
triage.notes: 本記事は疾病発生報告ではなく、検査室の品質管理・技能試験合格に関する広報内容。実際のEIAV症例や発生は報告されていない。

article.articleHeadline: Namíbia suspende exportações de carne de bovino devido a foco de febre aftosa
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Namibia suspends beef exports due to outbreak of foot-and-mouth disease.
article.articleSummary: Namibia suspended beef and sheep meat exports after the first outbreak of foot-and-mouth disease (FMD) in the southern livestock belt in six decades. Government spokesperson Romeo Muyunda told AFP that this is the country’s first epidemic since independence in 1990 and will hit the sector. FMD is a highly contagious viral disease not dangerous to humans but virulent in cattle, sheep and goats, causing fever, blisters and sometimes death. The outbreak breached a sanitary cordon that separates the endemic north from the south, marking the first spread to the southern region since 1964; Namibia borders Angola to the north. Namibia is the eighth Southern African country affected by FMD this year, following Botswana, Lesotho, Mozambique, South Africa, Zambia and Zimbabwe. In 2025 Namibia exported over 13,000 tonnes of beef, more than 90% to Europe. Meatco says it will review transit shipments; no recalls announced yet.

triage.headline_ja: ナミビア、口蹄疫の発生により牛肉輸出を停止
triage.triage_reason: 口蹄疫は人間には無害だが、60年ぶり・南部地域初という異常性と輸出停止という貿易制限措置が確認され、IHR基準（異常性・貿易制限）に2つ該当するためフルRRA検討対象とする。
triage.notes: 本イベントは動物疾病（口蹄疫）であり人間の公衆衛生への直接的影響はないが、家畜貿易・経済への影響が大きいため注視対象。記事主題はナミビアだが、ナミビアは対象国リストに含まれないため除外。Zambiaは『今年FMDに感染した南部アフリカ諸国』の一つとして明記されているため含めた。

article.articleHeadline: انخفاض إصابات إيبولا وارتفاع أعداد المتعافين بشكل ملحوظ
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Decrease in Ebola cases and a notable rise in the number of recoveries.
article.articleSummary: Bundibugyo Ebola virus disease outbreak in the Democratic Republic of Congo (DRC) amid active armed conflict. The Bundibugyo strain, first identified in Uganda in 2007, reappeared in Ituri in 2012 and again about 14 years later in the same region. Response challenges include ongoing conflict, limited diagnostics, and the absence of licensed vaccines or treatments for this strain, though some therapies and vaccines are in trials. Early detection was delayed, allowing months of undetected transmission. About four months after declaration, cases remain largely confined to the DRC with only a few cross-border exports to Uganda that were contained. The overall trend shows a decline in cases, especially in Ituri, with rising numbers in North Kivu, increasing recoveries, and improving contact tracing; however, the outbreak is not yet over and control efforts are strengthening gradually.

triage.headline_ja: エボラ感染者数の減少と回復者数の顕著な増加
triage.triage_reason: ワクチン・治療薬が未承認のBundibugyo株エボラが武力紛争下のDRCで継続しており、ウガンダへの越境例も発生しているため、IHR基準（深刻性・異常性・国際拡大リスク）を複数満たす。
triage.notes: 記事は既存アウトブレイクの経過報告であり、宣言から約4か月が経過、症例は減少傾向だが北キブ州で増加あり、収束には至っていない。ウガンダへの越境例は封じ込め済みだが対象国リストに含まれないため除外。

article.articleHeadline: Africa CDC hails 2.9-bln-USD pledge at G20+ Ebola meeting, urges rapid rollout
article.articleSummary: Addis Ababa, Sept. 25 — Africa CDC welcomed 2.9 billion USD mobilized at the G20+ Foreign Ministers Meeting on Accelerating Collective Action to Defeat Ebola, convened in New York on the UN General Assembly margins, to support the Ebola response in Africa. The agency called the 'historic mobilization' a step toward stopping transmission and saving lives, but stressed that pledges must be rapidly converted into disbursements, implementation, and measurable results in affected communities. Africa CDC Director-General Jean Kaseya urged tracing every dollar—from commitment to disbursement, to expenditure, to services delivered. The meeting brought together the Democratic Republic of the Congo (DRC) and Uganda governments, G20 members, Africa CDC, and international partners, underscoring cross-border financing aligned with nationally led priorities to reach frontline areas quickly. DRC health authorities reported 7,773 confirmed Ebola cases and 3,759 deaths as of Monday; WHO warned the outbreak remains uncontrolled, despite signs of improvement.

triage.headline_ja: アフリカCDC、G20+エボラ会議での29億米ドルの拠出表明を歓迎、迅速な実行を要請
triage.triage_reason: コンゴ民主共和国で確認症例7,773例・死亡3,759例に達し、WHOも「制御不能」と警告する深刻なエボラ流行が継続しており、国際社会が大規模資金拠出を行うなど社会的・政治的関心も極めて高い。
triage.notes: 会議開催地のエチオピア（アディスアベバ）や米国（ニューヨーク）は会議開催国であり流行発生国ではないため除外。ウガンダは対象国リストに含まれないため除外。

article.articleHeadline: Forscher untersuchen PCR-Tests mit positivem Affenpocken-Befund - Was bedeutet ein positives Ergebnis?
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Researchers examine PCR tests with a positive monkeypox finding - What does a positive result mean?
article.articleSummary: Mpox PCR positives in DRC: 2,700 positives (April 2024–April 2026) from four cities: Goma, Kamituga, Kinshasa, Uvira. About 35% may not reflect true infection. CT value analysis shows two clusters: low CT (high viral load, active infection) and CT values near detection limit (low viral load, rest-virus trace). Possible contamination suspected; surface swabs in two treatment centers showed Mpox DNA; control samples negative. Most false-positives lacked Mpox antibodies, suggesting no prior infection. Implications: misclassification affects surveillance, vaccination decisions; could lead to unnecessary treatments, hospitalizations, quarantine, stigma, and strain resources in the DRC. Authors caution that this may not generalize to higher-resource settings; context is environmental contamination with stable Mpox DNA.

triage.headline_ja: 研究者が陽性のサル痘（Mpox）判定を示したPCR検査を調査 - 陽性結果は何を意味するのか？
triage.triage_reason: 本記事はDRCにおける既存のMpox流行下でのPCR検査の偽陽性・環境汚染に関する検査方法論の科学的検証記事であり、新規アウトブレイクや症例急増を報告するものではないため、シグナルとしての緊急性は低い。
triage.notes: 記事はDRCの既存Mpox流行下でのPCR検査における偽陽性（環境汚染由来）の問題を扱う研究レポートであり、新規の公衆衛生上の脅威報告ではない。ただし誤分類がサーベイランスやワクチン接種判断、資源配分（隔離・治療・スティグマ）に影響しうる点は既存流行対応の質に関わる示唆として留意。

article.articleHeadline: 彰化50多歲夫妻富國島旅遊 返台發燒確診登革熱
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Changhua couple in their 50s travel to Phu Quoc Island; upon returning to Taiwan with fever, diagnosed with dengue fever.
article.articleSummary: Two imported dengue fever cases in Changhua County, Taiwan, linked to travel to Phu Quoc Island, Vietnam. A middle-aged couple traveled September 12–15 to Phu Quoc; after returning they developed fever, headache, and rash, with rapid test positive on September 22 and clinical confirmation on September 23; both are hospitalized. In total, 21 travelers from the same tour group across four counties are under health tracing. Around the patients’ residence, authorities inspected 75 households; 38 standing-water containers were found, with 13 testing positive for dengue vectors, signaling elevated transmission risk. Southeast Asia travel is driving higher importation risk. Physicians warn that repeat dengue infections increase the risk of severe dengue with hemorrhagic complications. Returnees should seek care within two weeks and report travel history; households should eliminate standing water to prevent community spread.

triage.headline_ja: 彰化在住の50代夫婦、フーコック島旅行後に発熱、帰台後デング熱と確定診断
triage.triage_reason: 台湾での輸入デング熱症例（2例）であり、現時点で大規模な公衆衛生上の危機や国際的拡大の兆候はないが、感染源地域（ベトナム）で蚊媒介密度が高いことが確認されており、今後の推移を注視する必要がある。
triage.notes: 感染は台湾ではなくベトナムのフーコック島（Kiến Giang省）で発生したとみられる輸入症例。台湾は対象国リストに含まれないため除外。現地での蚊媒介陽性率が高く（13/38容器）、今後の輸入症例増加リスクに留意。

article.articleHeadline: Sarampión en Loreto: 23 brigadas del Minsa llegan a Alto Monte para frenar avance de la enfermedad
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Measles in Loreto: 23 Ministry of Health brigades reach Alto Monte to curb the spread of the disease.
article.articleSummary: As of 25 September 2026, a measles outbreak in Loreto, Peru: a 16-year-old died from complications; more than 23 cases are reported in Alto Monte, San Pablo District, Mariscal Ramón Castilla Province, with the patient unvaccinated and diagnosed by clinical criteria and epidemiological link. The Ministry of Health expanded control measures and plans October vaccination campaigns with 23 brigades in Alto Monte (19 for immunization, 4 for care), supported by the Loreto Regional Health Directorate, PAHO, and a specialist team from Lima. Campaigns will extend to Yurimaguas, San Juan, Punchana, Iquitos, Belén, Caballococha, Datem del Marañón, Santa Rosa, San Pablo and Mazán to raise coverage. About 23,000 people in Loreto have been vaccinated; nationally, 1,239,601 doses have been administered since April, with stock over 2,000,000 doses. A first-quarter 2027 phase aims to deliver 1.4 million additional doses via a nationwide sweep, alongside active case finding and contact tracing to curb transmission.

triage.headline_ja: ロレト県で麻疹流行：保健省の23の医療班がアルト・モンテに到着し感染拡大の阻止を図る
triage.triage_reason: 麻疹の流行はペルーで発生しており、対象国（フィリピン等）は記事の主題ではないため対象国リストに該当する国がなく、見送りとする。
triage.notes: 発生地域にPhilippines (1694008) が含まれるが、記事本文はペルー・ロレト県の麻疹流行のみを扱っており、フィリピンは主題ではないため除外。対象国リストに該当する国は存在しない。

article.articleHeadline: В ДР Конго подтверждено более 7,8 тысячи случаев Эболы, погибли почти 3800
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: In DR Congo, more than 7,800 Ebola cases have been confirmed; nearly 3,800 have died.
article.articleSummary: In the Democratic Republic of Congo, Ebola virus disease has reached 7,890 confirmed cases and 3,799 deaths as of 25 September 2026, per the National Institute of Public Health. About 2,000 people have recovered; 893 are currently in medical care. The case fatality rate is 48.1%. The outbreak spans seven provinces and roughly 38% of health zones. In the last 24 hours, 70 new confirmed cases were reported, including 11 deaths among residents. Ituri and North Kivu each reported 31 cases; Haut-Uele (Upper Uele) 6; Bas-Uele (Lower Uele) and Chopo 1 each. Ebola virus disease is a severe acute viral illness with high mortality, transmitted by direct contact with blood, secretions, organs, or other bodily fluids of infected people, and by contact with contaminated surfaces or materials.

triage.headline_ja: DRコンゴでエボラ感染確認7,800例超、死者約3,800人
triage.triage_reason: エボラ出血熱がDRコンゴ7州・38%の保健地区に拡大し、致死率48.1%と極めて深刻。IHR基準複数該当かつ社会的関心・国際支援の必要性が高い大規模アウトブレイクである。
triage.notes: 既知の継続中アウトブレイクの進捗報告。新規症例は複数州(イトゥリ、北キブ、上ウエレ、下ウエレ、チョポ)にわたり拡大継続中。フルRRAでの継続評価が必要。

article.articleHeadline: अदृश्य कीटकामुळे कसा गेला चेन्नईतील विद्यार्थ्याचा जीव? काय आहे स्क्रब टायफस? लक्षणं आणि उपचार
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: How did a Chennai student die from an invisible insect? What is scrub typhus? Symptoms and treatment.
article.articleSummary: A 20-year-old student living in the Anna University hostel in Chennai died last week from scrub typhus, a bacterial infection caused by Orientia tsutsugamushi and transmitted by chigger mites. Though once tied mainly to rural areas, India's NCDC said in 2024 that urban cases occur too. Early symptoms mimic other fevers: abrupt fever, severe headache, and chills; severe illness can affect the lungs, heart, kidneys, or brain, with some patients developing confusion. About half show an eschar—dark crust at the bite site. Scrub typhus is a rickettsial disease carried by tiny chiggers (0.2–0.4 mm). Globally, about 1 million new cases occur each year; untreated mortality can exceed 30%. Early diagnosis and prompt treatment can cure, while delays worsen prognosis. NCID advises testing if fever lasts beyond five days without a clear source. Prevention: cover skin in tall grasses and seek care promptly if bite marks or fever appear.

triage.headline_ja: 見えない虫でチェンナイの学生はどのように命を落としたのか？スクラブチフスとは何か？症状と治療法
triage.triage_reason: 単発の死亡例報告であり、アウトブレイクや集団発生を示す情報はないが、都市部での発生という異例性から続報を注視する。
triage.notes: 本記事は単一の死亡例に関する啓発的な内容であり、集団感染やアウトブレイクの報告ではない。スクラブチフスはヒト-ヒト感染しないベクター媒介性疾患であり、国際的拡大リスクは低い。都市部（チェンナイ）での発生が従来の農村部中心の疫学と異なる点は注目に値する。

article.articleHeadline: Pemkab Kobar tingkatkan kewaspadaan penyakit jelang peralihan musim
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Kotabaru Regency Government steps up vigilance against diseases ahead of the seasonal transition.
article.articleSummary: Kotawaringin Barat Regency in Central Kalimantan is heightening vigilance ahead of the transition from dry season to rainy season, targeting diseases tied to environmental and weather changes. Major concerns include acute respiratory infections (ARIs), fever, diarrhea, and other seasonal illnesses that may rise. Officials warn that shifting weather can affect air quality, access to clean water, and sanitation, directly impacting public health. The local government has strengthened surveillance and intensified monitoring across health facilities to enable early detection and response, alongside promotive and preventive measures. Community education on hygiene, environmental sanitation, and safe drinking water is emphasized. Cross-sector coordination is essential for seasonal disease management and to prevent extraordinary outbreaks. In Arut Utara district, a 2.3 billion rupiah health-service budget for 2027 supports puskesmas and equipment, expanding northern Kobar health access.

triage.headline_ja: コバル県政府、季節の変わり目を前に疾病警戒を強化
triage.triage_reason: 具体的な感染症の発生や症例報告ではなく、季節の変わり目に備えた一般的な予防的注意喚起であり、IHR・WPRO基準のいずれにも該当しない。
triage.notes: 具体的な疾患名・症例数・アウトブレイクの報告なし。季節変化に伴う一般的な公衆衛生対策の記事であり、特定の感染症イベントとは言えない。

article.articleHeadline: Ituri : le nouveau chef de la santé s'engage à consolider les acquis contre Ebola - ACP
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Ituri: the new health chief commits to consolidating the gains against Ebola - ACP
article.articleSummary: As of 25 September 2026, in Bunia, Ituri province, Democratic Republic of the Congo, the new head of the provincial health division (DPS/Ituri), Dr. Alex Kalume, pledged to consolidate the gains achieved in the Ebola virus disease (EVD) response. He described Ituri’s DPS as a large but operational system whose effectiveness relies on every health-system actor, and said he would lead with humility, listening and learning from his predecessors. The handover ceremony, presided over by Dr. Jeanne Alasha, advisor to the military governor in charge of health, framed the transition as an opportunity to add value to ongoing efforts. The article focuses on leadership continuity rather than new outbreak data or laboratory confirmations.

triage.headline_ja: イトゥリ:新保健局長がエボラ対策の成果継続を約束-ACP
triage.triage_reason: 新任保健局長の就任表明に関する記事であり、新規発生データや検査確定情報は含まれず、既存対応の継続を確認する内容に過ぎない。
triage.notes: 記事はリーダーシップの継続性に焦点を当てており、新規のアウトブレイクデータや検査確認は含まれていない。過去のエボラ対応に関する言及のみ。

article.articleHeadline: Ituri : la jeunesse appelle à la paix et à la riposte contre Ebola - ACP
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Ituri: Youth call for peace and a response to Ebola - ACP
article.articleSummary: On 25 September 2026, in Bunia, Ituri Province, Democratic Republic of the Congo, the Ituri Provincial Youth Council urged joint action for peace and the Ebola response after meeting with military governor General-major Kasongo Mulumba Gaby. They expressed readiness to collaborate with provincial authorities to restore lasting peace and to contribute to the fight against Ebola. They requested the governor's backing to facilitate the return of displaced people to their home areas, and highlighted ready-to-implement action plans for Ebola response. For peace and security, they asked for signature of their global action plan outlining youth-led initiatives to restore peace, and for the establishment of the provincial technical secretariat for UN Security Council resolutions 1325 and 2250. The Cenajic umbrella supports these community efforts; the youth stress collective responsibility to eradicate Ebola and secure lasting peace.

triage.headline_ja: イツリ州：若者たちが平和とエボラ対応への協力を呼びかけ - ACP
triage.triage_reason: エボラ関連の記事だが、内容は若者評議会と知事の会合における平和・対応協力の呼びかけであり、新規感染者数や発生状況などの疫学的情報が記載されていないため、続報を注視する必要がある。
triage.notes: 記事はイツリ州の若者評議会が知事とのエボラ対応・平和維持に関する協力を呼びかける政治的・社会的な内容であり、具体的な感染者数や新規発生の有無など疫学データが記載されていない。DRCではエボラの流行歴があるため、続報で新規症例やアウトブレイクの詳細が確認された場合はPICKUPへの再評価が必要。

article.articleHeadline: சென்னை மாநகராட்சியில் 1,00,378 தெருநாய்களுக்கு ரேபிஸ் தடுப்பூசி - மாநகராட்சி ஆணையாளர் தகவல்
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Rabies vaccination for 100,378 stray dogs in Chennai Municipal Corporation — Municipal Commissioner informs.
article.articleSummary: From 11 Aug to 25 Sep 2026, Chennai Municipal Corporation conducted large-scale anti-rabies vaccination and endectoparasiticidal camps, vaccinating 100,378 stray dogs. The operation, led by veterinarians from Tamil Nadu Veterinary and Animal Sciences University and trainees, uses nets to capture dogs, administers rabies vaccine and endectoparasiticide, marks each with dye, and releases them at the same location; photos of vaccinated dogs are uploaded to a mobile app. Approximately 30 teams target about 3,000 dogs per day, with three mandals treated per cycle across three zones. Current reach includes Kodambakkam (3,290), Thiru Vi Ka Nagar (2,609), and Perungudi (771). Across MCC, vaccinated totals include Thiruvottiyur 12,313; Manali 7,200; Madhavaram 15,038; Thondiarpet 12,477; Royapettah 8,598; Ambattur 21,844; Anna Nagar 11,895; Alandur 4,343. 41 workdays completed; 34 days remain for zones 9, 11, 13, and 15 to achieve Rabies-Free Chennai.

triage.headline_ja: チェンナイ市当局、野良犬10万378匹に狂犬病ワクチン接種 — 市コミッショナーが発表
triage.triage_reason: 野良犬への狂犬病予防接種の日常的な公衆衛生活動報告であり、ヒトの症例発生や異常な流行を示す情報がないため、シグナルとしての基準を満たさない。
triage.notes: 本記事はチェンナイ市による野良犬向け狂犬病予防接種キャンペーンの進捗報告であり、ヒト感染事例や異常な疫学的変化の報告はない。地方自治体主導の予防対策として通常業務の一環と判断される。

article.articleHeadline: Ebola à Lolwa : l'attente de trois jours des résultats freine la riposte (Médecin-chef de zone) - ACP
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Ebola in Lolwa: the three-day wait for results slows the response (Zone Chief Medical Officer) - ACP
article.articleSummary: Ebola in Lolwa, Ituri Province, Democratic Republic of the Congo, faces delays in outbreak response due to laboratory results taking up to three days because samples must be sent to Komanda, slowing timely decisions. The Lolwa health zone reports 34 confirmed Ebola cases, with 26 deaths and 11 recovered; two patients remain in care at the Ebola Treatment Center at the General Hospital. Lolwa is among affected zones alongside Mabandifo and Pekele. Dr. Patrick Mbarikale, the zone medical chief, cites surveillance constraints from limited resources and inadequate training of surveillance actors, hindering alert reporting and team mobility. He calls for broader training across response cadres and strengthened logistics. The zone presently has only one motorcycle for field coverage, and the vehicle allocated to activities is out of service, limiting outbreak management. Note: the article notes that the sum of deaths, recoveries, and patients under treatment exceeds 34; verification advised.

triage.headline_ja: ロルワでのエボラ出血熱：検査結果待ちの3日間が対応を遅らせる（地域保健責任医師）
triage.triage_reason: コンゴ民主共和国イトゥリ州ロルワで確認34例・死亡26例のエボラ出血熱アウトブレイクが継続中であり、検査体制・監視体制・物流の脆弱性から対応遅延が生じている。致死率が高く公衆衛生上深刻でWHO通知相当の可能性が高い。
triage.notes: 記事内で死亡・回復・治療中の合計が確認症例数34を超えている旨の注記あり、数値の整合性は要検証。検体をコマンダへ送付するため結果判明まで3日を要し、対応の遅延要因となっている。

article.articleHeadline: Koiranpennun raapaisukin voi altistaa rabiekselle - vaara vaanii näissä kohteissa
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Even a puppy's scratch can expose you to rabies - danger lurks in these areas.
article.articleSummary: Rabies is almost always fatal once symptoms develop. Even a scratch can transmit rabies if the animal's claws carry the virus. A British tourist died of rabies in 2025 after being scratched by a puppy while in Morocco; he did not seek treatment until symptoms appeared. Incubation ranges from weeks to months. Early symptoms include fever, malaise, restlessness, and headache; later, hypersalivation, painful swallowing, then paralysis, coma and death. Transmission is mainly through bites, but saliva on wounds or mucous membranes can transmit; scratches contaminated with saliva can also. Travelers should avoid contact with pets, stray dogs, cats, and wildlife. Vaccination exists; pre-exposure vaccination is advised for longer stays or remote areas; post-exposure treatment must be sought immediately after exposure. Most deaths occur in Africa and Asia; risk also exists in popular destinations like Vietnam, Malaysia, Thailand, India, Indonesia, the Philippines, Sri Lanka, and Morocco; risk in Europe is low.

triage.headline_ja: 子犬の引っかき傷でも狂犬病に感染する可能性がある - 危険はこれらの地域に潜んでいる
triage.triage_reason: 本記事は狂犬病に関する一般的な啓発・旅行者向け注意喚起記事であり、特定の新規発生イベントの報告ではない。具体的な死亡例（モロッコ、2025年）も対象国リスト外であり、緊急のシグナルとして扱う必要はない。
triage.notes: 記事は狂犬病一般に関する健康啓発記事で、特定の国での新規アウトブレイクや異常事象を報じるものではない。言及されている国々（ベトナム、マレーシア、タイ、インド、インドネシア、フィリピン、スリランカ、モロッコ）は「リスクが存在する旅行先」として一般論的に列挙されているのみで、具体的な発生イベントの主題ではないため、verified_locationsには含めない。

article.articleHeadline: Villupuram district administration steps up disease surveillance ahead of monsoon
article.articleSummary: Villupuram district in Tamil Nadu has intensified monsoon preparedness to tackle outbreaks of water- and vector-borne diseases, led by Collector Sheik Abdul Rahman. Fever surveillance, mosquito-larvae control, fogging, nilavembu kudineer distribution, and medical camps are expanding in rural areas, in coordination with the Rural Development Department. Sanitation work, chlorination of drinking water, and repair of pipelines are underway. Dengue and chikungunya, transmitted by daytime-biting Aedes aegypti, prompt residents to keep water-storage containers covered, clean tanks weekly, and remove discarded plastic items such as tyres, coconut shells, broken pots, and bottles. Change water in flower pots, use mosquito nets and protective clothing for children, and cooperate with health workers conducting control activities. Dengue symptoms include fever, body and muscle pains, severe headache, fatigue, rashes, nausea, and stomach pain. Fever lasting more than three days warrants testing at primary health centres or hospitals; avoid self-medication and report illness to health workers.

triage.headline_ja: ビルプラム県当局、モンスーンを前に疾病サーベイランスを強化
triage.triage_reason: 季節性のモンスーン前予防対策に関する定型的な行政広報であり、異常発生や急増を示す情報はなく、通常の予防啓発活動に留まる。
triage.notes: 記事は具体的な症例数・発生規模を示しておらず、モンスーン前の定例的な予防対策・啓発活動の報道である。デング・チクングニアは流行しやすい疾患だが、本記事から異常な増加や重症化の情報は読み取れない。

article.articleHeadline: From sea barriers to TB elimination: Lakshadweep's #endTB blueprint for India
article.articleSummary: Lakshadweep, India's remote archipelago in the Arabian Sea, has achieved TB elimination levels, becoming the first Indian state/UT to reach this milestone. The territory credits a person-centred, rights-based approach—prevention, find, treat—delivered through sustained community engagement, intensified door‑to‑door screening, and regular treatment follow‑up, backed by strong administrative support. Geographic isolation is framed as a surveillance advantage. Since December 2024, Lakshadweep reported only 35 TB cases. In January 2026, 14 TB cases were notified (including transfers from Kerala); six have completed treatment, eight remain in care. All current cases are drug-sensitive; no multidrug-resistant TB is recorded; three are extra-pulmonary. The findings were shared by Dr MP Nezeeda at the End TB Dialogues ahead of the Union World Conference on Lung Health 2026, highlighting the potential to end TB with inclusive strategies.

triage.headline_ja: 海の障壁から結核制圧へ:ラクシャディープ州のインドにおける#endTB青写真
triage.triage_reason: 結核排除の成功を報告するポジティブな内容であり、公衆衛生上の緊急性や異常性、国際的拡大リスクは認められない。
triage.notes: 結核排除の成功事例を報告する内容であり、危機事象ではない。全症例は薬剤感受性で多剤耐性結核の報告もなし。
