article.articleHeadline: Dinkes Jabar Deteksi 65 Kasus Influenza A H1N1 di Kota Bandung
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: West Java Health Office Detects 65 Cases of Influenza A (H1N1) in Bandung City
article.articleSummary: West Java's Bandung City has at least 65 laboratory-confirmed Influenza A (H1N1) cases, per the West Java Health Office (Dinkes Jabar). The figure comes from swab tests and Whole Genome Sequencing (WGS) at Labkes Jawa Barat; officials note the real number is likely higher due to limited district testing capacity and reluctance to pay for private tests. Influenza A, known as swine flu, spreads rapidly and presents more severe symptoms than seasonal flu, including severe headaches, high fever, body aches, and fatigue. There are no deaths reported in West Java as of 25 September 2026. Vulnerable groups—children, those with comorbidities (heart disease, diabetes), TB, and HIV—are prioritized for vigilance. A three-day duration of symptoms without improvement should prompt medical care. Preventive PHBS measures are urged, similar to pandemic-era COVID-19 precautions.

triage.headline_ja: 西ジャワ州保健局、バンドン市でインフルエンザA(H1N1)65例を検出
triage.triage_reason: バンドン市でH1N1確認65例が報告されているが死亡例はなく、地域内で限定的に管理されているため、続報を注視する段階と判断。
triage.notes: 検査能力の限界や自費検査への抵抗感から実際の症例数はより多い可能性があると当局が言及。死亡例なし、重症化リスクのある基礎疾患保有者・小児への注意喚起がなされている。

article.articleHeadline: Dugaan Keracunan Puluhan Siswa SMAN 20 Konawe Terkuak, Sampel Makanan Positif Mengandung Bakteri E-Coli
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Suspected poisoning of dozens of SMAN 20 Konawe students revealed; food samples tested positive for E. coli.
article.articleSummary: Dozens of students at SMAN 20 Konawe in Konawe Regency, Indonesia, are suspected of foodborne illness after meals. Local health authorities (Konawe Health Office/Labkesda) confirmed Escherichia coli and coliform bacteria in school meals, with results on Sep 24, 2026. Two samples were tested: one from the SPPG Tongauna-Asao kitchen showed no bacteria, while samples from SMAN 20 Konawe contained contamination. Kuah bakso (meatball broth) had 3,500 coliform and 150 E. coli; pentol bakso (meatball) had 3,000 coliform and 140 E. coli. The findings suggest contamination occurred during distribution or storage, not during cooking at the supplier kitchen. Health official Yones noted that contaminated food can trigger health complaints, especially in vulnerable individuals. The information was released by Dinkes Konawe on Sep 25, 2026.

triage.headline_ja: コナウェ第20高校の生徒数十人の食中毒疑い判明、食品サンプルからE.coli検出
triage.triage_reason: 学校給食による限定的な食中毒事案であり、国際的拡大や渡航・貿易制限のリスクは低く、地域の公衆衛生対応で管理可能と考えられる。
triage.notes: 学校の給食を原因とする食中毒事案であり、感染症の地域的・国際的拡大の懸念は認められない。地元保健当局（Dinkes Konawe）が調査・対応を実施している。

article.articleHeadline: RedeTV! ES: Vitória realiza última etapa da vacinação contra a raiva neste sábado (26) - 2026
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: RedeTV! ES: Vitória carries out the final stage of rabies vaccination this Saturday (26) - 2026.
article.articleSummary: Rabies vaccination campaign ends with the final stage in Vitória, Brazil, on Saturday, September 26, 2026. The Center for Environmental Health Surveillance (CVSA) will operate at 37 vaccination points citywide from 8:00 to 16:30. In the first two stages (Sept 12 and 19), 16,930 animals were vaccinated: 12,362 dogs and 4,568 cats. The municipality aims to vaccinate about 23,000 dogs and cats overall. A second round will cover the Continental and Maruípe regions, with teams returning to the neighborhoods Maria Ortiz, Jabour, Consolação, Da Penha and Itararé. Vaccination is for dogs and cats aged three months or older; pregnant or nursing females may be vaccinated. Animals undergoing antibiotic or anti-inflammatory treatment should not be vaccinated. A full list of vaccination sites is available on the Prefeitura de Vitória website: www.vitoria.es.gov.br.

triage.headline_ja: RedeTV! ES:ヴィトーリア市、今週土曜日(26日)に狂犬病ワクチン接種の最終段階を実施 - 2026年
triage.triage_reason: 定例の動物向け狂犬病予防接種キャンペーンの実施報告であり、異常な感染事例や公衆衛生上の緊急性を示す情報は含まれていない。
triage.notes: 記事は狂犬病発生ではなく、ブラジル・ヴィトーリア市の予防的なペットワクチン接種キャンペーンの進捗報告のため、対象国リストの感染症イベントには該当しない。

article.articleHeadline: Campo Grande terá vacinação contra a raiva neste sábado e domingo - Boca do Povo News
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Campo Grande to have rabies vaccination this Saturday and Sunday - Boca do Povo News
article.articleSummary: Rabies vaccination campaign planned in Campo Grande, Brazil, for dogs and cats on the weekend of Sept 26–27, 2026. The Municipal Health Secretariat (Sesau) via the Center for Zoonosis Control (CCZ) administers shots from 8:00 to 12:00 at fixed sites: Saturday at Praça do Bairro Otávio Pécora (Rua Araçari, corner with Galo da Serra) and USF Dr. Nasri Siufi (Rua Maria Flauzina, 45, Jardim Presidente); Sunday at Praça do Coophasul (Rua Cotegipe, in front of the Community Center). Home vaccination teams will also visit Nova Campo Grande to reach residents not at home during prior visits. The objective is to boost access to immunization and prevent rabies, a disease highly fatal after symptom onset. Maria Aparecida Conche, CCZ head of Rabies and Other Zoonoses, stresses that protecting animals safeguards families. Schedule may be altered by heavy rain.

triage.headline_ja: カンポグランデで今週土日に狂犬病ワクチン接種を実施
triage.triage_reason: 定例的な動物向け狂犬病予防接種キャンペーンの告知であり、実際の症例発生や公衆衛生上の異常事態を示すものではない。
triage.notes: 記事は予防的なワクチン接種キャンペーンの案内であり、狂犬病の発生や症例報告ではない。ブラジルは対象国リストに含まれるが、本件は通常の予防活動であるためverified_locationsには含めない。

article.articleHeadline: Gripe mata 50 em Santa Catarina e só um município atinge meta vacinal - Florianópolis | Portal do Holanda
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Influenza kills 50 in Santa Catarina and only one municipality reaches the vaccination target - Florianópolis | Portal do Holanda
article.articleSummary: Influenza deaths reach 50 in Santa Catarina in 2026, with the state vaccination campaign ending May 24, 2026, per SES and Dive. Vaccination coverage for priority groups remained well below target: 41% among the elderly and 25% among children; only São Miguel da Boa Vista reached the target with 93% coverage. Of 137 municipalities, most had coverage under 40% of the target population. The state logged 600 hospitalizations and 125 ICU admissions related to influenza through the period. A new batch of 328,000 doses was received to reinforce vaccination among the elderly, children, pregnant women, and people with comorbidities. Secretary Diogo Demarchi warned that low uptake increases the risk of severe respiratory complications in vulnerable groups. Dive urged individuals with persistent flu symptoms, high fever, or breathing difficulties to seek care; vaccines remain available at health units as new shipments arrive from the Ministry of Health.

triage.headline_ja: サンタカタリーナ州でインフルエンザにより50人死亡、ワクチン接種目標を達成した自治体はわずか1つ
triage.triage_reason: 季節性インフルエンザによる死亡・入院例が報告されているが、ヒト-ヒト感染の異常性や国際的拡大の兆候はなく、通常の季節性流行として経過観察が妥当。
triage.notes: 季節性インフルエンザによる州レベルの被害報告。ワクチン接種率の低さが問題視されているが、パンデミック性の異常株や国際的懸念は記載なし。

article.articleHeadline: Le CDC Afrique salue l'engagement de 2,9 milliards de dollars pris lors de la réunion du G20+ sur Ebola
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Africa CDC welcomes the $2.9 billion pledge made at the G20+ meeting on Ebola.
article.articleSummary: Addis-Ababa, 25 September — Africa CDC welcomed a $2.9 billion pledge mobilized at the G20+ foreign ministers meeting in New York, on the margins of the UN General Assembly, to bolster Africa’s fight against Ebola. The Africa CDC called the mobilization historic and stressed rapid disbursements, concrete actions, and measurable results in affected communities. As the continent’s public health body, it urged coordinated efforts by political leaders, affected countries, and international partners to halt transmission and save lives. Latest health data from the Democratic Republic of the Congo show 7,773 confirmed Ebola cases and 3,759 deaths as of Monday, while the World Health Organization warned the outbreak remains out of control despite signs of improvement in some areas.

triage.headline_ja: アフリカCDC、Ebola対策に関するG20+会合で表明された29億ドルの拠出を歓迎
triage.triage_reason: コンゴ民主共和国（DRC）で進行中のエボラ出血熱アウトブレイクが7,773症例・3,759死亡に達し、WHOが「制御不能」と警告しており、国際的な資金拠出が行われるなど公衆衛生上・国際的関心が極めて高い。
triage.notes: 記事はG20+会合での資金拠出表明が主題だが、DRCにおける進行中のエボラアウトブレイクの深刻な状況（症例数・死亡数・WHOの「制御不能」評価）が明記されており、既存のアウトブレイクに関する重要な続報として評価。エチオピア（会合開催地）・米国（会合開催地）は発生地域ではないため除外。

article.articleHeadline: Kasus Pneumonia di Jakarta Barat Naik Drastis pada Triwulan III 2026
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Pneumonia Cases in West Jakarta Rise Drastically in the Third Quarter of 2026.
article.articleSummary: West Jakarta reports a sharp rise in pneumonia cases in Q3 2026, with 15,998 cases, up from 9,688 in Q2, according to Sudinkes Jakarta Barat via the New All Record system. The surge signals an acute respiratory infection uptick; factors cited include climate/environmental changes and air pollution, weaker immunity, pathogen evolution, vulnerabilities in children, and exposure to tobacco smoke. Authorities are conducting routine surveillance and sending samples to the Balai Besar Laboratorium Kesehatan Masyarakat to assess whether cases align with Influenza-Like Illness (ILI). Cross-sector coordination is being strengthened; residents are advised to reinforce PHBS, wear masks in high-risk areas, and practice proper cough etiquette to curb transmission. The article does not provide death counts or details on imported/exported cases.

triage.headline_ja: ジャカルタ西部、2026年第3四半期に肺炎症例が急増
triage.triage_reason: 肺炎症例数が四半期比で約65%増加し当局が調査中だが、死亡数や病原体確定情報が不明であり、現時点では季節性・環境要因による増加の可能性も残るため、続報を注視する。
triage.notes: 症例増加はインフルエンザ様疾患(ILI)との関連を調査中であり、原因病原体や重症度（死亡数・入院数）に関する情報が不足している。続報でILI/インフルエンザ確定情報が出た場合は再評価が必要。

article.articleHeadline: Dinkes Jabar mendeteksi 65 kasus influenza A
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: West Java Health Office detects 65 cases of influenza A.
article.articleSummary: West Java Health Office confirms at least 65 laboratory-confirmed influenza A (H1N1) cases in Bandung City, based on systematic Whole Genome Sequencing at Labkes Jabar. The figure reflects individuals who underwent swab testing; the true burden is likely higher due to limited testing facilities in districts and reluctance to test in private clinics because of cost. Influenza A in Bandung is highly contagious and often more severe than seasonal flu, with symptoms including headache, high fever, myalgia, and weakness, fueling hospital demand. No deaths reported in West Java to date, but vulnerable groups such as children and those with comorbidities like heart disease, diabetes, tuberculosis, and HIV remain at risk of serious complications. A three-day persistence of dizziness, high fever, cough, runny nose, or shortness of breath should prompt rapid clinical assessment. Public health measures include strict PHBS protocols: masking in crowds, hand hygiene, home isolation, and influenza vaccination, as with COVID-19.

triage.headline_ja: 西ジャワ保健局、インフルエンザA型65例を検出
triage.triage_reason: 季節性インフルエンザA(H1N1)の集団発生で死亡例はないが、感染力が強く重症化リスクのある基礎疾患保有者が存在するため、続報を注視する必要がある。
triage.notes: 季節性インフルエンザA(H1N1)としての通常の流行と考えられ、死亡例なし。検査体制の限界により実際の感染者数は過小評価の可能性がある。基礎疾患保有者・小児の重症化リスクに注意。

article.articleHeadline: 刚果（金）埃博拉疫情持续蔓延 医疗中心压力大-国际在线
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Ebola outbreak in the Democratic Republic of the Congo continues to spread; healthcare centers under heavy pressure - International Online.
article.articleSummary: As of September 22, 2026, the Democratic Republic of the Congo reports 7,820 laboratory-confirmed Ebola virus disease cases and 3,779 deaths. Ituri Province remains the most affected, but North Kivu has seen a sharp rise in new cases with a case fatality rate above 60%, higher than the national average. Doctors Without Borders (MSF) warns the outbreak is hard to control because it began in densely populated urban areas such as Butembo (about 2 million residents) and also Beni and Bunia, with early community engagement weak. Fear and distrust of Ebola treatment centers delay care. Ongoing eastern DRC conflict disrupts movement and contact tracing. In Butembo the Kita-Tumba treatment center is at capacity, with beds repurposed for confirmed cases and transfer centers now handling confirmed cases.

triage.headline_ja: 刚果（金）埃博拉疫情持续蔓延　医療センターに大きな圧力（国際在線）／コンゴ民主共和国でエボラ流行が拡大継続、医療センターに大きな負担
triage.triage_reason: 致死率60%超・7820例確認・3779人死亡と規模が大きく、都市部での拡大と紛争による対応困難があり、IHR基準・WPRO基準ともに複数該当するためフルRRAへ進めるべき。
triage.notes: MSFが対応困難を警告し、紛争による接触者追跡の妨げ、都市部での拡大、治療センターの受け入れ限界など、複数の悪化要因が確認されている。

article.articleHeadline: Ituri : renforcement des capacités des journalistes sur la couverture de riposte contre Ebola - ACP
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Ituri: strengthening the capacity of journalists to cover the Ebola response - ACP
article.articleSummary: A capacity-building workshop for journalists on protection measures to support the Ebola response in Ituri, North-East Democratic Republic of Congo, was held in Bunia on 25 September 2026. Organized by the Media Network for Development (Remed) with UNICEF, the training aims to equip reporters to produce radio programs and reports that raise community awareness and bolster the Ebola response, while also teaching self-protection during the outbreak. Facilitator Josué Musole highlighted the media’s role in disseminating prevention messages and reaching affected communities. The project focuses on journalistic writing and safety, urging professionals to listen to community concerns and to help the public understand and practice barrier measures. By strengthening media capacity, the initiative intends to improve coverage and public understanding of Ebola prevention throughout Ituri's response.

triage.headline_ja: イトゥリ：エボラ対応報道に関するジャーナリストの能力強化 - ACP
triage.triage_reason: コンゴ民主共和国イトゥリ州で進行中のエボラ対応に関するジャーナリスト研修についての記事であり、新規症例数や死亡者数などの疫学的情報は含まれていないが、エボラという重篤な疾患の継続的な対応が示唆されるため経過観察とする。
triage.notes: 記事はUNICEFとRemedによるジャーナリスト向け能力強化研修に関する内容であり、エボラ対応活動の継続を示すが、新規感染者数や死亡者数などの具体的な疫学データは記載されていない。既存のエボラ流行への対応状況の一環と考えられる。

article.articleHeadline: Gibran Ingatkan Nakes Antisipasi Penyakit Pascabanjir Bandang di Solok
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Gibran reminds healthcare workers to anticipate diseases after flash floods in Solok.
article.articleSummary: On a visit to Solok after flash floods, Vice President Gibran urged healthcare workers to anticipate post-disaster disease. The effort aims to ensure injured victims receive medical treatment until recovery and that the health needs of affected communities are met during the emergency phase. The response prioritizes coordinated, rapid on-site emergency management, safety, search for missing people, basic needs, and restoring access to health services. Gibran called for stockpiling medicines and providing vitamins at evacuation posts to bolster immunity, while expanding services beyond hospitals to reach those still at shelters or self-settled camps. He highlighted diseases to anticipate after floods: diarrhea, skin infections, dengue fever (DBD), wound infections, and other conditions. Special attention should go to pregnant women, the elderly, people with disabilities, and children. A wrist fracture patient received repositioning treatment.

triage.headline_ja: ギブラン副大統領、ソロクの鉄砲水後の疾病警戒を保健従事者に呼びかけ
triage.triage_reason: 洪水後の疾病（デング熱含む）への一般的な警戒呼びかけであり、具体的な感染拡大や症例数の報告はないため、続報を注視する段階。
triage.notes: 記事は洪水後の疾病予防に関する副大統領の呼びかけであり、デング熱を含む複数の疾病リスクへの一般的注意喚起。具体的な感染者数や流行状況の記載はなく、災害対応の一環としての予防措置に焦点。

article.articleHeadline: Ituri : le nouveau chef de la santé appelle à anticiper la phase post-Ebola - ACP
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Ituri: the new health chief urges preparation for the post-Ebola phase - ACP.
article.articleSummary: Ituri, Democratic Republic of the Congo – During a handover ceremony in Bunia on 25 September 2026, Dr. Alex Kalume, newly appointed head of the provincial health division for Ituri, urged partners to prepare for the post-Ebola phase. He stressed that ending an outbreak means more than halting transmission; it requires restoring essential health services, strengthening local capacities, and ensuring continuity of care after the response. Kalume called for concrete mechanisms to help districts affected by Ebola gradually return to normal functioning and to bolster local health system resilience. He acknowledged the efforts of authorities, technical teams, partners, and other stakeholders mobilized against Ebola. The remarks underscore post-outbreak reconstruction and sustained health service delivery in Ituri.

article.articleHeadline: Britain sends team to South Sudan as country braces for Ebola
article.articleSummary: Britain has deployed three Ebola specialists from the UKHSA Public Health Rapid Support Team to Juba, South Sudan, to guard against imported Bundibugyo Ebola from the DRC. The Bundibugyo strain has driven a DRC outbreak with more than 7,800 cases and 3,700 deaths since May. The team will train border authorities, test arrivals, and run community awareness campaigns. The outbreak is the fastest-growing ever and could become the largest in history, surpassing the 2014-16 West Africa outbreak (~30,000 cases; ~one-third deaths). South Sudan shares a 500-mile border with the DRC; thousands cross daily. UK has provided £78 million for the response and is facilitating a multi-country information-sharing MOU, including between DRC and South Sudan; Uganda reports 20 Bundibugyo cases, at least 15 from cross-border patients. WHO notes Ituri down 26% in 21 days; North Kivu up 73%. Bundibugyo has no treatment or vaccine; MSF is testing ERVEBO against Bundibugyo.

triage.headline_ja: 英国、エボラに備える南スーダンへ専門チームを派遣
triage.triage_reason: DRCでのブンディブギョ型エボラ流行が史上最速の拡大を見せ、致死率が高く、南スーダン・ウガンダへの越境事例も確認されているためIHR基準・WPRO基準ともに複数該当する。
triage.notes: 記事の主題はDRCで発生中のブンディブギョ型エボラ流行であり、南スーダン・ウガンダ・英国は対応国として言及されているが、対象国リストに含まれないため verified_locations には含めない。

article.articleHeadline: Measles outbreak confirmed in Tizit Block
article.articleSummary: Laboratory-confirmed measles cases detected in Tizit Block, Mon district, prompting intensified surveillance, vaccination and public awareness. A block-level meeting on September 21 at CHC Tizit, led by CMO Dr Supongmenla Walling and DPM Moie Bonnie Konyak, revised the immunisation micro-plan and coordinated with the WHO regional team. A WHO field visit by Dr M A Hazhar and Dr Jayaseelan Vedamuthu supported outbreak assessment and surveillance with district authorities, with ADC Mon Pakon Phom facilitating awareness dissemination. The containment plan launches a vaccination drive on October 12, vaccinating 5–10-year-olds in schools and under-fives via Anganwadi centers and home visits; updated school enrolment data and unvaccinated lists are being compiled. Schools must report fever/rash; individuals with infection should stay at home or in isolation and avoid gatherings until cleared. Public urged to seek prompt medical care and cooperate with health workers.

article.articleHeadline: "Гонконгский" грипп в России: спасет ли вакцина и как распознать опасный штамм
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Hong Kong flu in Russia: will the vaccine help, and how to recognize a dangerous strain
article.articleSummary: Russia faces renewed concern over a mutated Hong Kong flu strain, influenza A(H3N2). Rospotrebnadzor reports a nationwide rise in respiratory infections, but the trend is forecasted and mainly driven by other seasonal viruses rather than the H3N2 variant. Vaccination remains protective: experts from the Gamaleya Center say current domestic vaccines already contain antigens to the circulating H3N2 and are effective against it. Therapist Nadezhda Chernyshova notes that September–October is an ideal vaccination window; while the shot does not guarantee infection prevention, it reduces the risk of severe complications such as viral pneumonia, bronchitis, and myocarditis. Lab tests cannot reliably distinguish this strain from ordinary ARVI. Immunologist Georgiy Vikulov says today’s H3N2 is a seasonally adapted descendant of the 1968 pandemic virus. Protective measures stay the same: stay home when ill, wash hands, avoid touching the face, and replace masks in public every two hours.

triage.headline_ja: 「香港型」インフルエンザがロシアで流行：ワクチンは効くか、危険な株の見分け方

article.articleHeadline: Estado de SP chega a 37 casos de sarampo - 25/09/2026
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: State of São Paulo reaches 37 measles cases - 25/09/2026
article.articleSummary: Measles outbreaks in the State of São Paulo, Brazil: as of September 25, 2026, 37 cases have been reported in 2026, including a new 42-year-old unvaccinated man in São Paulo capital; 2025 had two cases. Measles is a highly contagious airborne viral disease; symptoms include high fever, cough, coryza, conjunctivitis, and a red maculopapular rash typically appearing 7–14 days after exposure. Of the 37 cases this year, 27 patients had no vaccination or incomplete immunization. Vaccination is via the trivalent MMR vaccine at all Basic Health Units. In the City of São Paulo, vaccination eligibility for 6 months–59 years covers districts Vila Maria, Vila Medeiros, and Vila Guilherme. Dose zero (6–11 months) is indicated for residents of São Paulo, São Bernardo do Campo, Guarulhos, and Santo André. Immunization schedule: first dose at 12 months, second at 15 months (tetraviral including varicella); ages 1–29 should have two doses, adults 30–59 at least one, healthcare workers two doses.

triage.headline_ja: サンパウロ州で麻疹症例が37件に到達 - 2026年9月25日
triage.triage_reason: ブラジル・サンパウロ州での麻疹症例数が前年から大幅増加（2件→37件）しており、未接種者中心の流行拡大傾向が見られるが、重症例・死亡や国際的拡大の情報はなく、社会的関心の高まりも明確でないため経過観察とする。
triage.notes: 症例の73%（27/37）が未接種または不完全接種であり、地域の予防接種率低下が流行拡大の要因と考えられる。今後の症例増加や重症化の有無を注視する必要がある。

article.articleHeadline: Primera muerte por sarampión en décadas expone el rezago en vacunación en Perú: ''Es inaceptable''
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: First measles death in decades exposes the vaccination gap in Peru: "It's unacceptable"
article.articleSummary: Measles outbreak in Peru deepens as a 16-year-old in Loreto dies from pneumonia after lacking a measles vaccination—first death in decades. The country has over 2,000 confirmed cases and an emergency extended to November across 14 jurisdictions due to vaccination gaps not meeting the 95% safety threshold. Nationally, second SPR dose is 46.7% (206,318 of 442,061) and first dose 56.1%; Loreto second dose 37.4%, Ucayali 36.2%, Madre de Dios 38.4%. April alert by MCLCP; May emergency; August extension; September 23 alert detailing obstacles: low vaccination priority, institutional fragmentation, slow immunizations, budget issues, weak community outreach. In Alto Monte, Ramón Castilla, families initially refused transport; three cross-border Tabatinga, Brazil cases. Minsa deployed more brigades; over 23,000 vaccinated in Loreto; El Niño 2026-2027 adds pressure.

triage.headline_ja: ペルーで数十年ぶりの麻疹による死亡例、ワクチン接種の遅れが露呈：「容認できない」
triage.triage_reason: IHR基準を3つ満たし（重大な公衆衛生影響、異常性、国際的拡大の可能性）、ブラジルへの越境症例も確認されているためフルリスク評価が必要。
triage.notes: 主な発生国はペルー（対象国リスト外）だが、ブラジルのタバチンガで越境症例3例が確認されているためBrazilを含めた。ペルー国内では2,000例超の確定例、数十年ぶりの死亡例、14管轄区域での緊急事態延長、ワクチン接種率が安全閾値95%を大幅に下回る状況（全国2回目接種46.7%）が報告されている。エルニーニョの影響も懸念材料。

article.articleHeadline: Jales sedia capacitação regional para reforçar diagnóstico e tratamento da hanseníase na rede pública
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Jales hosts regional training to strengthen diagnosis and treatment of Hansen's disease in the public health system.
article.articleSummary: Hansen's disease (leprosy) training in Jales, Brazil, on Sept 23–24, titled “Juntos contra a Hanseníase,” gathered doctors and nurses from Jales and neighboring municipalities at Fatec de Jales and local Family Health Units to strengthen early diagnosis and patient follow-up. The event, organized by CONSIRJ, SAE/CTA, the Municipal Health Secretariat, and Health Surveillance, opened with infectious disease specialists Márcio Gaggini and Maurício Favaleça detailing clinical and epidemiological aspects. Nursing teams conducted intradermal scraping for lab tests and dermatoneurological assessments to identify skin lesions and sensory changes, while physicians performed thorough exams of tactile, thermal, and pain sensation, peripheral nerve palpation, and skin biopsies on patients and contacts. Broad primary care participation signals a public health advance within SUS to enable faster diagnosis and more effective treatment, aiming to interrupt transmission in the region.

triage.headline_ja: ジャレスで公共医療システムにおけるハンセン病の診断と治療を強化するための地域研修が開催
triage.triage_reason: ハンセン病診断・治療能力強化のための研修イベントであり、アウトブレイクや異常事態の報告ではないため、シグナルとしての基準に該当しない。
triage.notes: 記事はブラジル・ジャレスで実施されたハンセン病の診断・治療能力強化研修に関する内容であり、感染拡大や異常事態の報告ではない。ハンセン病は既知の風土病であり、公衆衛生上の緊急対応を要する事案ではないため、対象国リストに該当する国があってもverified_locationsには含めない。

article.articleHeadline: Rede de unidades sentinelas reforça monitoramento da dengue e outras arboviroses no Estado
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Network of Sentinel Units Strengthens Dengue and Other Arbovirus Surveillance in the State
article.articleSummary: São Paulo state health department operates 73 sentinel units across regions to monitor arbovirus circulation in Brazil. Located in Primary Health Units, urgent care facilities, and hospitals, the network acts as a real-time epidemiological barometer for dengue, Zika, chikungunya, yellow fever, Oropouche fever, Mayaro, and West Nile virus. Weekly blood sampling from symptomatic patients—typically two to five dengue cases in the initial phase—are sent to Instituto Adolfo Lutz for analysis. Cross-referencing laboratory data with clinical surveillance allows municipal-level outbreak tracking and targeted prevention actions. The system has previously detected events such as dengue serotype 3 reemergence and Oropouche virus cases. The approach relies on population sampling and complements existing notification and surveillance protocols.

triage.headline_ja: 州内のセンチネルユニットネットワーク、デング熱および他のアルボウイルス監視を強化

article.articleHeadline: Gene Networks Point to Interferon Decline as Driver of Severe Dengue in
article.articleSummary: New Delhi, India-based study analyzes whole-blood transcriptomes from 112 dengue-positive patients at their first hospital visit (mean fever 3.7 days). Dengue globally affects about 390 million annually, with ~96 million symptomatic cases; India accounts for roughly 30% of infections, and Delhi saw DENV-2 as the dominant serotype during the study. Of participants, 21 with warning signs plus thrombocytopenia were flagged as high risk for severe outcomes. Clinically, leukocytes, platelets, and lymphocyte-to-neutrophil patterns differed; hematocrit remained non-elevated, suggesting no capillary leak yet. Using RNA-seq (>2 billion reads total), severe dengue vs mild showed 215 up and 92 down genes; severe vs moderate showed 142 up and 2 down. Pathways up in severe involve glycosylation and nervous system; downregulation seen in immune/inflammatory signaling, GPCR pathways, and platelet activation. Notably, B cell receptor genes were upregulated, while innate pathways may trend toward inflammation resolution via KIR3DL3, LILRB5, IRAK1BP1.

triage.headline_ja: 遺伝子ネットワーク解析、インドの重症デング熱におけるインターフェロン低下の関与を指摘
triage.triage_reason: 既知の流行病であるデング熱に関する基礎研究（トランスクリプトーム解析）の学術報告であり、新規の公衆衛生上の脅威や異常な流行は報告されていない。
triage.notes: 本記事は疾病発生report ではなく、デング熱重症化メカニズムに関する遺伝子発現の基礎研究論文の紹介であり、感染症サーベイランスのシグナルとしての性質を持たない。SFTSウイルスへの言及は疾患名タグにあるが、記事内容には含まれていない。

article.articleHeadline: Puppy That Bit Mother and Two Children in Jembrana Tests Positive for Rabies
article.articleSummary: Rabies confirmed in a puppy from Anyar Sari, Baler Bale Agung Village, Negara District, Jembrana Regency, Bali, after it bit a mother and two children; the four-month-old male dog died on Sept 14, 2026. Denpasar's BBVet laboratory confirmed the dog tested positive for rabies on Sept 21, 2026. Three dogs in the same household are the focus of authorities, who vaccinated all three yesterday and are conducting area-wide sweeps. Rabies vaccination coverage in Baler Bale Agung Village reached 99% of dogs as of Sept 18, 2026. The bitten victims are Ni Komang Ayu Suarini, 42, bitten on the right thumb while bathing the dog on Sept 8; Conradus Febatan Tri Sandy, 15, bitten on the left thumb while removing fleas on Sept 12; and Dominika Sayyo Bayu, 23, bitten on the left elbow moving the dog on Sept 13. The dog showed no classic rabies signs before death and had never been vaccinated.

triage.headline_ja: ジェンバラナで母親と子供2人を噛んだ子犬が狂犬病陽性と判明
triage.triage_reason: バリ島では狂犬病は既知の風土病であり、本事例は個別の咬傷事例に対し当局が迅速にワクチン接種・調査を実施済みで、異常性や国際的拡大リスクは認められない。

article.articleHeadline: Estado de SP confirma 347 casos de leptospirose em 2026 e Saúde alerta para riscos em enchentes
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: State of São Paulo confirms 347 cases of leptospirosis in 2026 and Health warns of flood risks.
article.articleSummary: Leptospirosis in São Paulo State reached 347 confirmed cases from January to August 2026, according to the State Health Secretariat, compared with 451 cases in all of 2025. The Metropolitan Region of São Paulo accounts for most cases (93), followed by Mogi das Cruzes and Campinas (34 each), and Baixada Santista in Santos (33). Leptospirosis is a bacterial infection contracted through skin or mucous membranes in contact with water, mud, or sewage contaminated with urine from infected animals, especially urban rats. Transmission rises during storms and floods when rainwater overflows manholes. Early symptoms include sudden high fever, headache, nausea, loss of appetite, and severe calf pain; severe disease can cause jaundice, bleeding, kidney impairment, and respiratory distress. Seek prompt care after flooding; prevention includes avoiding floodwater, wearing gloves and waterproof boots, proper trash disposal, food storage, and sealing water tanks to deter rats.

triage.headline_ja: サンパウロ州、2026年のレプトスピラ症347例を確認、洪水リスクに保健当局が警告
triage.triage_reason: 季節性・地域性のレプトスピラ症の症例報告であり、既知の風土病的パターンで前年より減少傾向にあるが、洪水期の継続的な公衆衛生リスクとして経過観察が妥当。
triage.notes: レプトスピラ症はブラジルで洪水期に毎年発生する風土病的疾患。2026年の症例数（347例）は2025年通年（451例）より少なく、異常な増加は見られない。州保健当局による定期的な注意喚起の一環と考えられる。

article.articleHeadline: Xếp hạng: 10 loại virus nguy hiểm nhất thế giới theo tỷ lệ tử vong
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Ranking: The 10 most dangerous viruses in the world by fatality rate.
article.articleSummary: Rabies ranks first among the world’s most dangerous viruses by fatality rate, with near-100% mortality after symptom onset and about 59,000 deaths annually, mainly in Africa and Southeast Asia. Transmission occurs via infected animal saliva, especially from dogs; vaccines exist but limited access to post-exposure prophylaxis drives fatalities. Ebola and Marburg are viral hemorrhagic fevers with around 50% fatality; Crimean-Congo hemorrhagic fever (CCHF) 10–40% fatality. West and Central African Ebola outbreaks (notably 2014–2016 with >11,000 deaths) and Eurasia/Africa CCHF are discussed, with 1,000–2,000 CCHF deaths yearly. Many agents originate from animals: bats link to Nipah and Marburg; Lujo ties to rodents; camels harbor MERS-CoV (first identified in Saudi Arabia in 2012). H5N1 avian influenza transmits from birds, about 50% fatality among confirmed human cases, warranting ongoing global monitoring.

triage.headline_ja: ランキング:致死率別、世界で最も危険なウイルス10種

triage.notes: 記事は特定の国・地域での実際の発生報告ではなく、致死率に基づく危険ウイルスの一般的なランキング解説であるため、具体的な発生国は特定できない。発生地域フィールドのThailand等は記事本文の主題と直接関連しない。

article.articleHeadline: मुजफ्फरपुर में लंपी वायरस का कहर, 7600 पशुओं के टीकाकरण का लक्ष्य निर्धारित - muzaffarpur lumpy virus confirmed vaccination drive begins
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Lumpy skin disease ravages Muzaffarpur; vaccination target for 7,600 animals set.
article.articleSummary: Muzaffarpur, Bihar, reports laboratory-confirmed Lumpy Skin Disease (LSD) in cattle. Eleven samples were sent to NIHSAD, Bhopal, with eight testing positive for LSD. In response, authorities launched a ring vaccination campaign within a 5-km radius of affected areas, starting Friday, targeting 7,600 cattle across seven affected blocks. Vaccine allocations include 2,500 doses to Bochahan’s Jhupahan Panchayat; 1,000 doses each to Saraiya, Sahebganj, Meenapur, and Paru Panchayats; 500 doses each to Bariarpur (Motipur) and Shahi Jiwar (Aurai) Panchayats; and 100 doses for the municipal/urban area. LSD primarily spreads via biting insects such as mosquitoes, flies, and ticks; it is non-zoonotic, not transmissible to humans, though farmers are advised to take precautions.

triage.headline_ja: ムザファルプルでランピースキン病が猛威、7600頭のワクチン接種目標を設定
triage.triage_reason: ランピースキン病は非人獣共通感染症であり、人への感染性はなく、既に地域でリング・ワクチン接種による対応が進行中であるため、公衆衛生上のシグナルとしての重要性は低い。
triage.notes: 本疾患は牛の家畜伝染病であり、人への感染性はない（非人獣共通感染症）。地方自治体によるワクチン接種対応が既に開始されており、公衆衛生上のリスクは限定的。

article.articleHeadline: مدير منظمة الصحة العالمية: فيروس إيبولا لن يتحول إلى جائحة - اليوم السابع
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: WHO Director-General: The Ebola virus will not become a pandemic - The Seventh Day.
article.articleSummary: As of 25 September 2026, WHO Director-General Tedros Adhanom Ghebreyesus says Ebola will not become a pandemic, even as an ongoing Ebola outbreak persists in the Democratic Republic of the Congo. He warns the next pandemic is a matter of when, not if, and highlights progress since COVID-19 in strengthening outbreak preparedness while urging urgent action to close gaps. He notes amendments to the International Health Regulations took effect last September and references negotiations on a Pandemic Accord and the Pathogens Access and Benefit-Sharing (PABS) framework, stressing they do not undermine national sovereignty. The Ebola situation underscores persistent epidemic threats and the need for rapid, measurable commitments—strengthening local and national health systems, public trust, community engagement, and equitable access to tools and resources.

triage.headline_ja: WHO事務局長：エボラウイルスはパンデミックにはならない - The Seventh Day紙
triage.triage_reason: 記事はWHO事務局長のパンデミック備え・IHR改正等の政策的発言が主題で、DRCのエボラ流行については既知の継続事例として言及されるのみで具体的な症例数・死亡者数・地域拡大状況等の新規情報が乏しいため、続報の確認が必要。
triage.notes: 記事はWHO事務局長のパンデミック協定・IHR改正等に関する発言が中心であり、DRCで継続中のエボラ流行は既知の背景情報として言及されているのみ。新規の疫学的詳細（症例数、死亡者数、発生地域の拡大等）は記載がなく、多くの項目が不明であるためWATCH判定とした。

article.articleHeadline: Dengue prevention measures put in place in Tiruppur district
article.articleSummary: Dengue prevention measures in Tiruppur district aim to curb Aedes breeding. District Collector Manish Narnaware urged schools to remove waste tyres, broken cement tanks, flower pots, and other containers, scrub water storage vessels, and keep them covered to eliminate stagnant-water breeding sites. Dengue symptoms—fatigue, headache, body pains, vomiting, and bone pain—were highlighted, with Primary Health Centres and government hospitals prepared to handle cases. Tiruppur Corporation deployed 400 field workers for daily larva eradication, with an additional 100 workers to be added; fumigation uses four fogging-mounted vehicles in residential areas, streets, school campuses, bus stands, and public places. Ward-level coordinators are educating students on prevention. The corporation has levied ₹55,000 in fines on 49 establishments for mosquito breeding. Daily mobile medical camps are operating, plus 104 helpline support and industry guidelines to prevent stagnation, cover tanks, and install nets. Reports with photographs should be uploaded to dciftpr@gmail.com.

triage.headline_ja: ティルプル県でデング熱予防対策を実施
triage.triage_reason: デング熱は当該地域で流行性の疾患であり、記事内容は行政による通常の予防・対策活動を報じるもので、異常な流行拡大や重症例急増を示す情報はない。
triage.notes: 地方自治体による通常のデング熱予防・媒介蚊対策の記事であり、症例数の急増や異常な流行を示す具体的データはない。

article.articleHeadline: Dinkes Cianjur belum menemukan kasus influensa A di Cianjur
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Cianjur Health Office Has Not Yet Found Any Cases of Influenza A in Cianjur
article.articleSummary: Influenza A has not been detected in Cianjur, West Java, as of 25 September 2026. The Cianjur Health Office reports no confirmed Influenza A cases; health centers only note common flu symptoms, attributed to weather changes, requiring thorough testing to confirm whether patients have influenza A or seasonal flu. Four influenza types exist (A, B, C, D), with A and B most often causing human outbreaks; Influenza A can present with fever, cough, headache, muscle and joint pains, sore throat, and runny nose, with incubation of 1–4 days (avg ~2) and a cough that may last up to two weeks. Most patients recover in about a week without special treatment, but high-risk groups include pregnant women, children under five, adults 65+, and those with chronic conditions such as asthma, heart or lung disease, diabetes, or HIV/AIDS. Authorities are intensifying health-hygiene messaging, protocols, and public education to prevent transmission.

triage.headline_ja: Cianjur保健局、CianjurでインフルエンザAの症例は未確認と発表
triage.triage_reason: インフルエンザA症例は確認されておらず、通常の季節性インフルエンザに関する啓発情報にとどまるため、シグナルとしての基準を満たさない。
triage.notes: 記事は症例なしの確認情報であり、実際の感染事例は報告されていない。

article.articleHeadline: Saúde realiza pulverização contra dengue no Centro de Tubarão
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Health department carries out spraying to combat dengue in downtown Tubarão.
article.articleSummary: Dengue outbreak response in Tubarão, Brazil: health department conducted fumigation spray (fumacê) in downtown Tubarão after confirmation of a dengue case in a local resident. The operation covered about 150 meters around the patient’s home, spanning roughly 12 blocks identified as vector-infested. The initiative targets adult Aedes aegypti to interrupt virus transmission, following the Ministry of Health's arbovirus control protocols for urban settings. The patient presented classic dengue symptoms—fever, myalgia, headache, nausea, and retro-orbital pain—and diagnosis confirmation prompted immediate vector control. The city plans two additional fumigation applications on separate days over the next three weeks. Health officials urge community participation to eliminate water-collecting containers and adopt preventive measures to reduce mosquito breeding and prevent further cases.

triage.headline_ja: 保健当局、トゥバラン中心部でデング熱対策の消毒作業を実施
triage.triage_reason: 単一のデング熱症例に対する通常の媒介蚊対策活動であり、異常性・重大性・国際的拡大リスクは認められない。
triage.notes: デング熱はブラジルで地域流行性の疾患であり、本記事は通常の公衆衛生対応（単発症例への消毒作業）を報じたもので、規模拡大や異常事態を示す情報はない。

article.articleHeadline: Semarang bersiap cegah penyakit dampak musim hujan
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Semarang Prepares to Prevent Diseases Affected by the Rainy Season.
article.articleSummary: As of 25 September 2026, Semarang City Health Office in Indonesia is preparing to prevent dengue fever (DBD), tuberculosis (TB), and leptospirosis ahead of the rainy season starting in early October 2026. Health officials have developed risk maps to identify districts most vulnerable—specifically northern, southern, and Tembalang areas—and will use community health centers (puskesmas) to disseminate information and drive public awareness. Preventive actions emphasize proactive community engagement and maintaining the ABJ (larva-free index) above 95% to reduce mosquito-borne risk. BMKG forecasts hot, dry conditions through October 2026, with rainfall likely beginning in November in Central Java. The article does not report any case counts, focusing instead on preparedness and timely communication to residents.

triage.headline_ja: スマラン市、雨季による疾病影響を予防する準備
triage.triage_reason: 実際の症例報告ではなく、雨季を前にした季節性感染症（デング熱・結核・レプトスピラ症）への予防的準備に関する行政発表であり、異常性や重大な公衆衛生インパクトは確認されない。
triage.notes: 症例数の報告はなく、季節前の予防的な行政準備活動についての記事。実際の発生状況を示す情報がないため見送りと判断。

article.articleHeadline: झारखंड में मलेरिया मरीजों को मिलेंगी मच्छरदानियां, सहियाओं को टैब; NHM कर्मियों को ईपीएफ का लाभ - jharkhand malaria patients get mosquito nets sahiyas to receive tabs
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: In Jharkhand, malaria patients will receive mosquito nets; Sahiyas to receive tablets; NHM staff to receive EPF benefits.
article.articleSummary: Jharkhand will provide mosquito nets to malaria patients treated in government hospitals. The move, announced by Health Minister Irfan Ansari during a departmental review in Namkum, aims to strengthen malaria control and prevention at the ground level. Sahiyas (community health workers) will receive tablets and must be paid timely; the government will route incentive payments directly from the state headquarters to avoid delays and keep the system simple and transparent. Sahiyas will also be issued tablets promptly to support their work. The review stressed stricter monitoring of schemes with low expenditure and proper, time-bound execution, ensuring budget provisions are properly used. The government also instructed that contract health workers’ stipends be paid through HRMS from the state HQ to prevent delays, and that EPF benefits be extended to all NHM contract staff. Vacant physician posts should be filled promptly to ensure adequate healthcare delivery.

triage.headline_ja: ジャールカンド州、マラリア患者に蚊帳を配布へ；サヒヤ(地域保健員)にタブレット支給、NHM職員にEPF給付
triage.triage_reason: マラリア対策強化に関する行政施策の発表であり、異常な発生や重症化・アウトブレイクの兆候は報告されていない。
triage.notes: 記事はマラリア流行そのものではなく、州保健省の予防・管理施策（蚊帳配布、医療従事者への手当支給等）に関する行政ニュース。

article.articleHeadline: Fidžin HIV-tartunnat 16-kertaistuivat - maa julisti kansallisen hätätilan
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Fiji's HIV infections rose sixteenfold - the country declared a national emergency.
article.articleSummary: Fiji declared a national emergency in September 2026 due to rapidly spreading HIV infections. Last year the 800,000-person island nation reported about 2,000 new HIV infections, some 16 times the 2019 level. Officials attribute the surge in part to increased injection drug use. Globally, HIV infections have fallen more than 40% over 35 years, yet increases are seen in Sub-Saharan Africa, Eastern Europe, Central Asia, Latin America, and Pacific islands. Risk groups include women and girls, sex workers, injection drug users, and unprotected sex among men who have sex with men. UN AIDS notes about 30 countries with >20% increases since 2010, from Afghanistan to Brazil, Egypt, and the Philippines. Pharmaceuticals have advanced HIV treatment, with Gilead Sciences' Q2 growth driven by HIV medicines, while revenue from COVID-19 therapies fell 81% as infections declined.

triage.headline_ja: フィジーのHIV感染者数が16倍に増加 - 同国は国家非常事態を宣言
triage.triage_reason: フィジーがHIV感染急増を理由に国家非常事態を宣言しており、感染者数が2019年比16倍という異常な増加と重大な公衆衛生上の影響が認められるため、IHR基準を2つ以上満たす。
triage.notes: 記事の主題はフィジー（対象国リスト外）における国家非常事態宣言。フィリピン・ブラジル・エジプト・アフガニスタンはUNAIDSが指摘する『2010年以降20%以上増加した約30カ国』の例として言及されているのみで、記事の主題的な発生国ではないため verified_locations には含めていない。

article.articleHeadline: DRC Ebola outbreak remains active as death toll reaches 3,779 - Africa CDC
article.articleSummary: Ebola outbreak in the Democratic Republic of the Congo (DRC) remains active with 7,820 cases and 3,779 deaths across 63 health zones in seven provinces. About 49 zones stay in active phase; eight have entered sustained controlled phase and six in controlled phase after reporting no cases. The outbreak has plateaued over five weeks, aided by declines in Ituri, epicentre, where cases fell about 25% and deaths 31% in the latest three weeks, while North Kivu shows a 56% rise in cases and 19% more deaths, with a case-fatality ratio around 60.5% versus the national ~48%. Insecurity and limited access hinder active case finding and contact tracing; about 65% of cases are community-transmitted. Children under five are particularly affected; UNICEF is helping strengthen paediatric management. Contact listing improved to ~20 contacts per case (target 60). Lab capacity includes 24 labs doing 3,400+ tests daily and 100,000+ test kits provided.

triage.headline_ja: コンゴ民主共和国のエボラ出血熱流行は依然活発、死者数3,779人に達する - アフリカCDC
triage.triage_reason: コンゴ民主共和国で活動性のエボラ出血熱流行が継続しており、致死率約48-60%、community transmissionが65%を占め、地域拡大リスクと管理困難性が高いためフルRRAが必要。
triage.notes: 北キブ州で症例56%増加、死者19%増加と悪化傾向。治安不安・アクセス制限が接触者追跡を阻害しており、5歳未満児が特に影響を受けている。UNICEF・Africa CDCが支援中。

article.articleHeadline: Actualité | Nord-Kivu : plusieurs carcasses d'hippopotames découvertes dans la rivière Semuliki, l'ICCN appelle à la vigilance | mediacongo.net
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: News | North Kivu: several hippopotamus carcasses discovered in the Semuliki River, ICCN calls for vigilance
article.articleSummary: As of 25 September 2026, in North Kivu's Virunga National Park, authorities reported several hippopotamus carcasses along the Semuliki River. The Congolese Institute for Nature Conservation (ICCN), in collaboration with health authorities, cautions residents to remain vigilant while laboratory analyses determine the mortality cause; this follows a prior anthrax episode in April 2025 near Lake Edward. The exact cause of hippo deaths is not yet established. People are urged not to touch, move, cut up, open, bury, or burn carcasses, and not to consume, buy, sell, or transport meat from dead or sick animals, even if processed. Keep children and livestock away and avoid using water near carcasses; rely on safe or treated water. Report unusual carcasses immediately to local authorities, veterinary services, community leaders, or ICCN; seek health care if symptoms arise after exposure. Measures remain until further notice.

triage.headline_ja: ニュース｜北キブ州：セムリキ川でカバの死骸が複数発見、ICCNが警戒を呼びかけ
triage.triage_reason: カバの大量死が確認され、2025年4月に同地域で炭疽の発生歴があることから懸念されるが、死因は未確定であり人への感染例は報告されていないため、続報を注視する段階と判断した。
triage.notes: 発生地域に含まれる'State of South Australia'および'Commonwealth of Australia'は記事内容と無関係な誤タグと判断し除外した。死因（炭疽の可能性）はまだ検査結果待ちであり、確定情報ではない点に留意。

article.articleHeadline: Hallan en China el primer caso humano grave del virus Oya
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: First severe human case of the Oya virus found in China.
article.articleSummary: As of 25 September 2026, China reports the first severe human case of Oya virus, an insect-borne pathogen transmitted by mosquitoes and midges. A 54-year-old woman on a goose farm in Qingyuan, Guangdong Province, developed sepsis with 40°C fever, chills, malaise, and poor appetite, progressing to severe vomiting and diarrhea (>10 episodes/day). She exhibited ocular hemorrhages and petechiae; labs showed leukocytosis, thrombocytopenia, severe liver injury, and disseminated intravascular coagulation; tests for other pathogens were negative. On day 8, blood testing detected Oya virus, with the strain resembling prior regional insect isolates. In a lab setting, the virus damaged a lab-grown mini-liver; in immunocompromised mice it caused hepatitis, intestinal inflammation, thrombocytopenia, and coagulopathy. She recovered with supportive care, fever resolved by day 4, diarrhea ceased, and discharge occurred after 19 days with recovery confirmed on day 31. The case confirms that an insect-associated virus can provoke severe human disease.

triage.headline_ja: 中国で新種ウイルス「Oya virus」による初の重症人体感染例が確認される
triage.triage_reason: 昆虫媒介性の新規ウイルスによる初の重症ヒト感染例であり、DIC・肝障害等重篤な臨床像を呈した点で異常性・重症度の両面からフルリスク評価が必要と判断した。
triage.notes: 新規に同定された昆虫媒介性ウイルス（Oya virus）による初の重症ヒト感染例であり、単一症例だが病原体としての新規性・重症度から続報を含むフルリスク評価が望まれる。ヒト-ヒト感染の有無や地理的拡大状況は記事からは不明。

article.articleHeadline: Inundaciones elevan el riesgo de infecciones en la piel por aguas contaminadas
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Floods increase the risk of skin infections from contaminated water.
article.articleSummary: Floodwaters increase the risk of skin infections from contaminated water. CDC warns floodwater may contain human and animal waste, sewage, chemicals, and microorganisms; avoid contact and protect exposed wounds. Studies link inundation to dermatologic problems: a Netherlands study found floodwater contact associated with more skin conditions, especially with direct exposure. A six-year Cambodian study across 11 districts observed small rises in skin infection consultations during floods and afterward, though some links were uncertain. A 2026 multicenter analysis of 27 million hospitalizations in Australia, Brazil, Canada, Chile, New Zealand, and Thailand found flood exposure linked to higher risk of hospitalization for skin and mucous membrane infections in the weeks after events. Open wounds require care: clean with water and soap, keep covered; monitor for redness, swelling, pain, discharge, or fever and seek care if symptoms appear. Emphasize hygiene and surveillance during and after floods.

triage.headline_ja: 洪水により汚染水からの皮膚感染症リスクが上昇
triage.triage_reason: 特定の感染症アウトブレイクではなく、洪水後の皮膚感染症リスクに関する複数国の研究をまとめた一般啓発記事であり、緊急対応を要する具体的イベントではない。
triage.notes: 本記事は特定の感染症アウトブレイクの発生報告ではなく、洪水と皮膚感染症の関連性を扱った複数国（オランダ、カンボジア、豪州、ブラジル、チリ、NZ、タイ）の学術研究レビュー記事。特定国での進行中の感染症イベントではないため、verified_locationsは空とした。

article.articleHeadline: ICT Weekly Rounds for September 25, 2026: Ebola, Lyme testing, Sterile Processing Burnout, and More | Infection Control Today
article.articleSummary: DRC reports 2026 Ebola outbreak with 7,614 confirmed cases and 48% fatality in 18 weeks, outpacing response. Contact follow-up appears strong on paper (87%) but field estimates suggest only ~27% of actual contacts are monitored, amid PPE shortages, overcrowded treatment centers, and thin health worker infrastructure in fast-growing urban clusters. Lyme testing data from Quest Diagnostics on 193,260 patients show ~30% of those with Borrelia burgdorferi antibodies also have antibodies to other tick-borne pathogens, vs 5.5% in seronegative individuals; coseropositivity does not prove active coinfection, and doxycycline does not treat Babesia microti, underscoring reliance on exposure history and clinical context, especially in the Northeast. Sterile processing burnout is driven by cognitive overload and inconsistent use instructions; calls for standardized IFU formatting, protected work zones, and sustained training. OR turnover pressures correlate with skipped disinfection steps, though repeated competency training raised cleaning-to-standard rates from 20% to 82% over three sessions.

triage.headline_ja: ICTウィークリーラウンドアップ 2026年9月25日号：エボラ出血熱、ライム病検査、滅菌処理担当者のバーンアウトなど
triage.triage_reason: DRCで2026年エボラ流行が7,614例・致死率48%と深刻化し、接触者追跡の実効率が約27%と極めて低いことから、対応能力を超えた深刻な公衆衛生上の脅威と判断される。
triage.notes: 記事は複数トピックを扱う週刊まとめ記事だが、DRCのエボラ流行は致死率・症例数・接触者追跡の破綻から重大なシグナルと判断。米国のライム病検査データは対象国外（米国）のためverified_locationsに含めない。

article.articleHeadline: Macaé tem queda de 88% nos casos de dengue, mas mantém alerta com as chuvas
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Macaé records an 88% drop in dengue cases, but remains on alert with the rains.
article.articleSummary: Dengue in Macaé fell 88% from 579 cases (January–August last year) to 70 in the same period this year, but officials remain vigilant during the rainy season. Aedes aegypti, the dengue vector also linked to Zika and chikungunya, thrives with standing water. About 120 surveillance agents carried out 225,548 property inspections and organized 80 mutirões in high-risk areas from January to August. More than 90% of breeding hotspots are inside homes; common sources include backyards, plant pots, water tanks, tires, and bottles. Ovitrampas (ovitraps) are used to detect eggs and confirm local presence. The public health campaign Ten Minutes Save Lives urges residents to spend a few minutes inspecting for breeding sites and eliminating standing water to curb transmission during the rainy season.

triage.headline_ja: マカエ、デング熱症例が88%減少するも、雨季に伴い警戒を継続
triage.triage_reason: デング熱症例は前年比88%減少しており、公衆衛生上の深刻な悪化や異常事態は認められない。通常の季節的な予防啓発活動の一環である。
triage.notes: 記事は症例数の大幅減少と地域の予防活動（ovitrampas、mutirões等）を報じるもので、感染拡大の兆候はない。ブラジルは対象国リストに含まれるが、記事内容がポジティブなトレンドを示しているためシグナルとしては見送り。

article.articleHeadline: Gates-Backed Pro-Vax Outlet Appears To Say Quiet Part Of The Measles Outbreak Out Loud |
article.articleSummary: Measles outbreaks surge in the Americas, led by the United States, with 95% of 2026 cases in the U.S., Guatemala, Mexico and Peru, per PAHO data cited by VaccinesWork. The U.S. hosted 78 World Cup games in 11 cities, drawing foreign nationals; the State Department forecast five to seven million international travelers. In Pennsylvania, 850 measles cases were recorded by the CDC as of Thursday, with Lancaster County reporting the highest infection rate; Philadelphia hosted six World Cup matches and more than 500,000 attendees. Five teams from Ecuador, Brazil, Haiti, Costa Rica and Paraguay competed in Philadelphia. The VaccinesWork piece urges greater vaccination; Bianca de Oliveira Cata Preta (Gavi/WHO) says high mobility fuels spread. Investigations into deaths and links to PAHO data—reported broken—are ongoing.

triage.headline_ja: ゲイツ財団支援のワクチン推進系メディアが麻疹アウトブレイクの『不都合な真実』を図らずも露呈
triage.triage_reason: 記事は米国・グアテマラ・メキシコ・ペルーを中心とした麻疹流行とワールドカップによる人的移動の関連を扱っており、対象国（Zambia, Philippines, Thailand, Ghana, DRC, Brazil, Indonesia, China, Myanmar, Vietnam, India）における実際の発生は確認できないため対象外。
triage.notes: ブラジル・ハイチ・コスタリカ・エクアドル・パラグアイは麻疹発生国としてではなく、フィラデルフィアでのワールドカップ出場チームの出身国として言及されているのみであり、対象国リスト上のBrazilも実際の発生地としては確認できないため除外した。

article.articleHeadline: Changhua couple hospitalized with dengue fever: CDC
article.articleSummary: Dengue fever case in Taiwan valued as an imported family cluster: a Changhua County couple were hospitalized after returning from Phu Quoc Island, Vietnam, with 19 tour members from Taichung, Tainan, Hsinchu and Nantou monitored. Symptoms emerged over the weekend after their return; the couple tested positive on dengue NS1 rapid tests and were later confirmed, with samples sent to the CDC for retesting and gene sequencing. Epidemiology points to Vietnam as the infection source; the couple’s Changhua residence shows no local transmission, though nearby townships have imported cases. Local authorities inspected 75 surrounding households, finding 38 water-filled containers and 13 breeding vector mosquitoes, triggering chemical fumigation to prevent spread. Taiwan reported 163 imported dengue cases this year; prior years (2022–2025) recorded 38, 164, 216 and 177 cases, respectively. Public urged anti-mosquito precautions and prompt medical care for symptoms such as fever, headache, retro-orbital pain, muscle/joint pain, or rash within two weeks of travel.

triage.headline_ja: 彰化の夫婦がデング熱で入院：疾病管理署
triage.triage_reason: 台湾における輸入デング熱の家族内クラスターであり、現地伝播は確認されておらず、既存のサーベイランス・対応体制内で管理されている散発事例。
triage.notes: 感染源はベトナム（フーコック島）とされているが、記事の主題は台湾での輸入症例対応。台湾は対象国リストに含まれないため、ベトナムのみverified_locationsに記載。現地当局により通常のベクター対策（消毒・調査）が実施されており、地域内感染の証拠はない。

article.articleHeadline: Muere una joven en la RDC durante incidentes por el entierro de una víctima de ébola
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: A young woman dies in the DRC during incidents surrounding the burial of an Ebola victim.
article.articleSummary: Ebola virus disease outbreak in eastern Democratic Republic of the Congo (DRC) persists. As of 25 September 2026, confirmed cases are 7,820 with 3,779 deaths, 1,951 recoveries, and 885 patients still hospitalized or in isolation. Healthcare workers infected total 239, with 50 deaths. The epidemic spans 63 health zones across seven provinces: Ituri, Tshopo, Bas-Uélé, Haut-Uélé, North Kivu, South Kivu, and South Ubangi. A fatal incident occurred during a dignified burial in Katula cemetery, Beni, North Kivu, when a young woman was shot after security forces fired to disperse a crowd whose relatives sought to seize the Ebola victim’s body; the corpse had been removed from the family and later buried by specialized teams. The outbreak is the second deadliest and most contagious in global history, behind the 2014–2016 West Africa outbreak (≈11,000 deaths, 28,000 cases).

triage.headline_ja: コンゴ民主共和国で、エボラ犠牲者の埋葬をめぐる騒動の最中に若い女性が死亡
triage.triage_reason: 大規模かつ拡大継続中のエボラ流行（7,820症例、3,779死亡）で医療従事者感染や埋葬をめぐる暴力的衝突も発生しており、公衆衛生上深刻かつ国際的懸念が高い事案。
triage.notes: 史上2番目に致死率・感染力が高いエボラ流行とされ、7州63保健地区に拡大。埋葬をめぐる住民と治安部隊の衝突など社会的混乱も発生しており、既にWHO等による継続的な国際対応が行われている案件と推測される。

article.articleHeadline: Mpox case confirmed in northeastern Congolese city at center of Ebola outbreak
article.articleSummary: In Bunia, the northeastern Congolese city at the center of the country’s Ebola outbreak, a laboratory-confirmed mpox case has been identified. A 21-year-old woman was admitted Thursday with lesions and tested positive on Friday; a 32-year-old woman is a suspected mpox case awaiting lab results. Investigations are underway to trace contacts and identify the infection source, with five suspected mpox cases in Bunia under investigation. Both patients are isolated and receiving care from a dedicated medical team. Mpox is a viral disease causing fever and skin lesions and spreads through close contact. Congo had declared an end to mpox as a national public health emergency in April after a three-year outbreak with more than 34,000 confirmed cases, but officials warned resurgence remains possible. The Ebola outbreak in Ituri province, declared May 15, has infected 7,890 and killed 3,799, according to government data published on Thursday.

triage.headline_ja: エボラ流行の中心地である北東部コンゴの都市でMpox症例確認
triage.triage_reason: IHR基準（深刻性・異常性）が2つ該当し、既存の大規模エボラ流行地域でMpoxの再燃事例が確認されたため、フルリスク評価が必要と判断。
triage.notes: 同一都市（ブニア）でエボラ流行（7890感染・3799死亡）とMpox再燃（国家公衆衛生緊急事態終息宣言後の再発）が同時進行しており、二重の公衆衛生負荷が懸念される。国際的拡大の明示的記載はないが、地域の脆弱な保健システム下での複合流行としてWATCH以上の注視が必要。

article.articleHeadline: Mpox Case Confirmed in Northeastern Congolese City at Center of Ebola Outbreak
article.articleSummary: On 25 Sept 2026, a laboratory-confirmed mpox case was identified in Bunia, a northeastern Congolese city in Ituri province, amid Congo's ongoing Ebola outbreak. The Ebola epidemic, declared May 15 in Ituri, has infected 7,890 people and killed 3,799. Mpox is a viral disease causing fever and skin lesions and spreads through close contact, prompting renewed vigilance after Congo ended mpox as a national public health emergency in April following a three-year outbreak with over 34,000 confirmed cases nationwide. The latest mpox case involves a 21-year-old woman admitted Thursday with widespread lesions and testing positive on Friday; a second woman, 32, is a suspected mpox case awaiting lab results. Both are isolated and cared for by a dedicated medical team. Investigations trace contacts and sources; five suspected mpox cases in Bunia are under investigation. Health officials report rising mpox activity as Ebola strains health systems.

triage.headline_ja: エボラ発生の中心地である北東部コンゴの都市でエムポックス感染確認
triage.triage_reason: IHR基準3項目該当（深刻な公衆衛生影響、異常性、国際拡大リスク）に加え、エボラ流行下でのmpox再燃という複合的リスクが認められるためフルリスク評価に進むべき。
triage.notes: コンゴ民主共和国イトゥリ州で進行中のエボラ流行（感染7890人、死亡3799人）に加え、同州ブニアでmpox症例が確認された。国内で今年4月にmpoxの公衆衛生緊急事態が解除されたばかりであり、再燃の可能性と医療システムの逼迫が懸念される。

article.articleHeadline: مرضى الإيدز يدفعون الثمن.. إيبولا يثير مخاوف مزدوجة في إفريقيا
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: AIDS patients pay the price... Ebola raises dual fears in Africa.
article.articleSummary: Ebola outbreak in the Democratic Republic of Congo (DRC) caused by the Bundibugyo strain has expanded to 63 health zones, with 7,733 confirmed cases and 3,732 deaths reported as of 20 September, driven by ongoing transmission in Ituri and spread toward new areas, including Dongo in Haut-Uele near the South Sudan border and Sud-Ubangi near the Central African Republic. Nigeria has raised preparedness, tightening traveller screening and health declarations for travellers from countries with active transmission. The WHO warns cross-border spread remains a risk amid movement of people and trade, weak health access, insecurity, and displacement. The crisis is straining essential health services, notably HIV/AIDS care: fear of Ebola in health facilities is causing people living with HIV to miss clinic visits and antiretroviral therapy, risking treatment interruptions. UN AIDS and Africa CDC stress maintaining HIV services during the outbreak.

triage.headline_ja: AIDS患者が代償を払う…エボラ出血熱がアフリカで二重の恐怖を引き起こす
triage.triage_reason: コンゴ民主共和国でエボラ出血熱（ブンディブギョ株）が63保健区に拡大し、7,733症例・3,732死亡と甚大な公衆衛生被害が生じており、南スーダン・中央アフリカ共和国国境地域への拡大やナイジェリアの渡航スクリーニング強化など国際的拡大・貿易渡航制限のリスクも顕在化しているため。
triage.notes: 記事はDRCにおけるエボラ流行拡大とHIV/AIDS診療への波及影響を主題としている。ナイジェリア・スーダン・中央アフリカ共和国は感染拡大への警戒・準備措置の文脈で言及されているが、実際の症例発生地ではないためverified_locationsから除外。イタリア・ロンバルディア等は関連性不明のため除外。

article.articleHeadline: Congo-Kinshasa: Inquiétude dans une école primaire de Mambasa après le décès d'un élève atteint d'Ebola
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: DR Congo: Concern at a primary school in Mambasa after the death of a student infected with Ebola.
article.articleSummary: Ebola concerns rise in DR Congo's Ituri province as a student dies from Ebola at Lalia Primary School near Biakato-Centre in Mambasa Territory. Following the death (last Wednesday), panic has led some pupils to abandon classes and some parents to keep children at home. Local authorities urge strict adherence to infection prevention measures to reduce school-based transmission. In Mandima Health Zone, where Biakato lies, the outbreak is progressing with 74 confirmed Ebola cases reported. The New Civil Society of Mambasa has called for a temporary suspension of primary classes in the affected area, and requests rapid disinfection of Lalia Primary School plus thorough contact tracing of individuals who had contact with the deceased student to limit further spread within the school and wider community.

triage.headline_ja: コンゴ民主共和国:マンバサの小学校でエボラ感染の生徒死亡後、動揺広がる
triage.triage_reason: エボラ出血熱の進行中のアウトブレイク（マンディマ保健区で74例確認）に関連し、学校での感染死亡例が発生し地域社会に動揺が広がっているため、IHR基準・WPRO基準ともに複数該当しフルRRAが必要。
triage.notes: 既存のエボラアウトブレイク（イトゥリ州マンディマ保健区、74例確認）の一環として学校内感染死亡例が報告され、地域住民の不安・登校拒否・地元団体による対応要請が発生している。続報でのアウトブレイク規模拡大や封じ込め状況の確認が必要。

article.articleHeadline: Febre maculosa acende alerta no Noroeste Fluminense; Itaperuna registra duas mortes
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Spotted fever raises an alert in the Fluminense Northwest; Itaperuna records two deaths.
article.articleSummary: Spotted fever, caused by Rickettsia bacteria and transmitted by tick bites, is advancing in Rio de Janeiro state, Brazil. As of August 9, 2026, the state records 14 confirmed cases and four deaths in 2026, with fatalities in Itaperuna (two deaths) and in Campos dos Goytacazes and São Fidélis; in São Fidélis, the victim was a 30-year-old veterinarian whose diagnosis was laboratory-confirmed. Most risk is in rural, wooded, pasture areas where animals carry ticks, with July–November identified as higher-transmission months. Early symptoms include high fever, severe headache, myalgias, nausea, and vomiting; rash may appear. Symptoms can resemble dengue, underscoring need for exposure history to ticks and outdoor areas. Treatment with antibiotics is most effective when begun promptly; transmission occurs via ticks, not person-to-person. Authorities emphasize prevention and rapid medical evaluation for those exposed.

triage.headline_ja: フルミネンセ北西部で斑点熱の警戒強まる。イタペルーナで2名死亡
triage.triage_reason: ブラジル・リオデジャネイロ州でダニ媒介性リケッチア症（斑点熱）による死亡例が複数報告されているが、既知の風土病で人-人感染はなく、国際的拡大リスクは低い。地域内の季節性動向として継続監視が妥当。
triage.notes: 疾患タグは'Dengue'となっているが、記事内容はダニ媒介性のRickettsia感染症（斑点熱）であり誤分類の可能性が高い。ヒト-ヒト感染はなく、地域の風土病としての季節的増加と考えられる。国際的な関心の高まりを示す情報はなく、地元メディアの報道にとどまる。

article.articleHeadline: El ébola sigue sin remitir y se extiende por la República Democrática del Congo
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Ebola continues to show no signs of abating and is spreading across the Democratic Republic of the Congo.
article.articleSummary: Ebola in the Democratic Republic of the Congo (DRC) continues to spread, with 7,700+ laboratory-confirmed cases and about 3,700 deaths as of September 21, across more than 60 health zones in seven provinces amid conflict, displacement, and weak services. The International Organization for Migration (IOM) warns that population movements drive transmission and calls for surveillance beyond hospitals and borders. IOM is assisting Congo, Uganda, and nine at-risk neighbors by strengthening surveillance at entry points, transport corridors, markets, river routes, and displacement sites, and by mapping mobility along informal routes. The Congo River corridor, including Kinshasa (over 10 million residents), is a key focus. IDP camps show an 81% case fatality rate; over 280 displacement sites lie outside current surveillance. Financial needs for DRC rose to $69M, with regional appeals at $110M; about $29.6M has been mobilized. Swift alerting and outreach to mobile communities are essential.

triage.headline_ja: エボラ出血熱は収束の兆しを見せず、コンゴ民主共和国全土に拡大している
triage.triage_reason: エボラの症例数・死者数が多く、複数州に拡大し国境を越える波及リスクもあることからIHR基準を複数満たす。
triage.notes: IOMはウガンダ及び近隣9カ国での監視強化を実施しているが、記事はDRCでの流行拡大が主題であり、ウガンダ自体での症例発生は言及されていないため、verified_locationsにはDRCのみを含めた。

article.articleHeadline: Muere una joven en la RDC durante incidentes por el entierro de una víctima de ébola
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: A young woman dies in the DRC during clashes over the burial of an Ebola victim.
article.articleSummary: Ebola virus disease (EVD) outbreak in the Democratic Republic of the Congo persists, with 7,820 confirmed cases and 3,779 deaths since the outbreak began in eastern DRC on May 15. In North Kivu, during a dignified burial operation at Katula cemetery, a young woman linked to the deceased died as security forces dispersed a crowd with gunfire; the body had already been handled by relatives. Officials warn that handling Ebola cadavers poses high transmission risk and burials must be conducted only by trained personnel. The outbreak affects 63 health zones across seven provinces: Ituri, Tshopo, Bas-Uélé, Haut-Uélé, North Kivu, South Kivu, and Ubangi del Sur. Recoveries: 1,951; hospitalizations/isolation: 885. Healthcare workers infected: 239, including 50 deaths. This is the second deadliest and most contagious Ebola outbreak globally, behind the 2014–2016 West Africa epidemic.

triage.headline_ja: コンゴ民主共和国でエボラ犠牲者の埋葬を巡る衝突中に若い女性が死亡
triage.triage_reason: コンゴ民主共和国で継続中の大規模エボラ流行（7,820例確認、3,779人死亡、7州63保健区に拡大）であり、公衆衛生上の深刻な影響と国際的拡大リスクが認められるためフルRRAへ移行すべき。
triage.notes: 史上2番目に致死的かつ感染力の強いエボラ流行とされ、医療従事者感染（239名、うち50名死亡）や遺体取扱いによる感染リスク、治安部隊との衝突など社会的緊張も高い。継続的なモニタリングとフルリスク評価が必要。

article.articleHeadline: Caso de viruela símica detectado en una ciudad del noreste del Congo, epicentro del brote de ébola
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Case of monkeypox detected in a city in northeastern Democratic Republic of the Congo, epicenter of the Ebola outbreak.
article.articleSummary: Monkeypox (mpox) case detected in Bunia, northeastern Democratic Republic of the Congo, raising concerns of resurgence as the country grapples with its worst Ebola outbreak. The Ituri province epicenter outbreak began May 15, with 7,890 infections and 3,799 deaths reported by government data published on Sep 25, 2026. A 21-year-old woman arrived with widespread body lesions and fever; she tested positive and is isolated with specialized care. A second woman, 32, is a suspected mpox case awaiting lab results; investigations to trace contacts and infection source are under way. Five additional suspected mpox cases are being studied in Bunia. Authorities warn of rising mpox nationwide over the past month, while Ebola-related strain on health systems complicates control. In April, Congo ended mpox as a national public health emergency after a three-year outbreak with over 34,000 confirmed cases nationwide.

triage.headline_ja: コンゴ北東部の都市でエムポックス感染例を検出、エボラ流行の震源地
triage.triage_reason: エボラ流行下のDRCでmpox感染例・疑い例が複数確認され、医療システム逼迫と国内拡大の懸念があり、WPRO基準複数該当かつ社会的関心も高い。
triage.notes: エボラとmpoxの同時流行によりDRCの医療システムが逼迫している状況。mpoxは4月に国家公衆衛生緊急事態を終了したばかりであり、再拡大の兆候が懸念される。感染経路・接触者調査は進行中で詳細情報待ち。

article.articleHeadline: Flavonoid-rich Albizia niopoides leaf extract shows anti-Trypanosoma cruzi activity against benznidazole-resistant parasites
article.articleSummary: Chagas disease (Trypanosoma cruzi) affects an estimated 6–7 million people globally. This in vitro study tests ethanolic extracts from stems and leaves of three Brazilian Cerrado species—Curatella americana, Nectandra nitidula, and Albizia niopoides—against benznidazole-resistant T. cruzi Y strain (DTU II). Cytotoxicity in Vero cells showed most extracts were toxic, with Albizia niopoides leaves providing the only favorable therapeutic window (CC >1600 µg/mL). Against epimastigotes, A. niopoides leaf extract had the strongest activity (IC50 ≈ 150.72 µg/mL). In intracellular amastigotes within H9c2 cardiomyocytes, the extract achieved 85.9% inhibition at 400 µg/mL (IC50 ≈ 150.72 µg/mL). Selectivity indices were >10.61 in Vero cells and ~1.6 in H9c2 cells, below the ≥50 benchmark for drug development. UHPLC-MS identified flavonoids—rutin, isoquercitrin, luteolin-7-O-rutinoside, and 7-O-methyl-quercetin—as potential markers (MSI Level 2/3). While promising for targets in benznidazole-resistant parasites, modest selectivity and lack of isolated compounds limit therapeutic conclusions.

triage.headline_ja: フラボノイド豊富なAlbizia niopoides葉抽出物がベンズニダゾール耐性寄生虫に対する抗トリパノソーマ・クルージ活性を示す
triage.triage_reason: 本記事は植物抽出物を用いた基礎研究（in vitro実験）であり、公衆衛生上の緊急イベントや発生報告ではないため、トリアージ対象外。
triage.notes: 本研究はシャーガス病治療薬候補となる植物由来化合物の実験室内薬理学的研究であり、実際の感染症発生・アウトブレイクに関する報告ではない。ブラジルは研究実施国だが、疾病発生地域として言及されているものではないためverified_locationsから除外。

article.articleHeadline: தனியாா் கட்டடத்தில் டெங்கு கொசுப்புழுக்கள்: உரிமையாளருக்கு ரூ.10 ஆயிரம் அபராதம்
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Dengue mosquito larvae in a private building: Owner fined Rs 10,000.
article.articleSummary: In Krishnagiri, three dengue-control squads under Municipal Commissioner Sekar and led by Sanitary Officer Pandiyarajan conducted inspections and vector-control operations. A private building was fined Rs 10,000 after dengue mosquito larvae were found in stagnant water. Across the municipality, teams cleaned offices (Forest, Livestock, and Local Development Offices), removing debris, tires, and water-holding items to prevent stagnation. In Ward 24, authorities conducted house-to-house dengue-awareness visits. At Laxmanarav Street, a newly constructed private building harbored abundant Aedes larvae due to standing water; the owner had been informed but did not remedy the situation, prompting the Rs 10,000 fine. Municipal workers drained standing water and performed larvicidal measures, while public education emphasized preventing water stagnation around homes and surroundings.

triage.headline_ja: 私有建物内でデング熱を媒介する蚊の幼虫を発見：所有者に1万ルピーの罰金
triage.triage_reason: 地方自治体による日常的なデング熱媒介蚊対策・啓発活動の報道であり、症例急増や異常な流行を示す情報はない。
triage.notes: 記事はデング熱媒介蚊のボウフラ駆除活動と罰金措置に関する地域ニュースであり、症例数や感染拡大についての言及はない。

article.articleHeadline: Itatiaiuçu realiza ações de prevenção e controle da raiva com equipes da UVZ e do IMA
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Itatiaiuçu carries out rabies prevention and control actions with UVZ and IMA teams.
article.articleSummary: Rabies prevention and control actions were carried out in Itatiaiuçu, Brazil, by UVZ and IMA field teams. The activities focused on field identification of sites with bat presence and monitoring two properties with an espoliation index above 5% attributed to hematophagous bats, as part of ongoing surveillance and disease prevention. The effort aims to guide field work and reinforce preventive measures against rabies, tying into the One Health approach that integrates human, animal, and environmental health. Emphasis is placed on keeping pets’ rabies vaccination up to date, with owners urged to monitor vaccination status to safeguard both animals and the community. The initiative highlights ongoing rabies risk reduction in Itatiaiuçu and the importance of integrated health protections.

triage.headline_ja: イタチアユスー市、UVZおよびIMAチームによる狂犬病予防・対策活動を実施
triage.triage_reason: 定例の狂犬病予防・監視活動に関する報道であり、異常な発生や症例報告はなく、社会的関心や公衆衛生上の緊急性を示す情報もない。
triage.notes: 記事は吸血コウモリによる狂犬病媒介リスクへの予防的監視活動を報じるもので、実際の感染症例やアウトブレイクの報告ではない。

article.articleHeadline: Ekiti Steps Up Disease Surveillance To Prevent Ebola, Diphtheria Spread
article.articleSummary: Ekiti State has stepped up disease surveillance and rapid response across 16 Local Government Areas to prevent the spread of Ebola Virus Disease (EVD) and diphtheria. Dr Charles Doherty, General Manager of the Ekiti State Health Insurance Scheme and Pillar Lead for Ebola Risk Communication, urged residents to report suspected cases to the nearest health facility. State Epidemiologist Dr Bosede Alowooye said the sensitisation aimed to strengthen prevention, early detection and prompt reporting, noting the state is on alert after Ebola outbreaks in several countries. Stakeholders, including community and religious leaders, media practitioners, road transport union members and health promotion officers, were engaged to raise awareness. Ebola symptoms cited include muscle pain, headache, stomach ache, vomiting, sudden high fever, difficulty in breathing and skin rash. Residents with travel history to outbreak countries—Uganda, the Democratic Republic of Congo and Rwanda—were advised to report and seek medical care as needed.

triage.headline_ja: エキティ州、エボラ・ジフテリアの流行を防ぐため疾病サーベイランスを強化
triage.triage_reason: 本記事はナイジェリア・エキティ州における予防的サーベイランス強化に関する内容であり、対象国（DRC等）における新規の感染症発生を報じるものではないため、シグナルとしての新規性は低い。
triage.notes: 記事の主題はナイジェリア（対象国外）における予防的サーベイランス体制強化であり、DRC・ルワンダ・ウガンダは過去のエボラ流行国として言及されているのみで、これらの国における具体的な新規発生情報は含まれていない。

article.articleHeadline: Fumacê reforça combate ao Aedes no Jardim Centenário - Boca do Povo News
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Fogging Reinforces the Fight Against Aedes in Jardim Centenário - Boca do Povo News
article.articleSummary: On Sept 25, 2026, Jardim Centenário neighborhood in Campo Grande will undergo intensified Aedes aegypti control with Ultra Low Volume fogging (fumacê) by the Municipal Health Department's Vector Endemics Control Coordination (CCEV/Sesau). Operations run from 16:00 to 22:00, weather permitting. Residents are asked to open doors and windows to allow the insecticide to reach mosquito habitats. Fogging targets adult mosquitoes, preferentially females, which transmit Dengue, Zika, and Chikungunya; other species may also be affected. Applications may be postponed or canceled in case of rain, winds, or fog that impede spraying. The article emphasizes careful administration of the insecticide to minimize non-target effects and maximize impact on the adult population.

triage.headline_ja: ジャルジン・センテナリオ地区でアエデス蚊対策の燻蒸を強化 - Boca do Povo News
triage.triage_reason: 通常の蚊対策（燻蒸消毒）実施を伝える行政広報記事であり、具体的な症例数や異常な流行拡大の報告はない。
triage.notes: 記事はブラジル・カンポグランデ市における定例の蚊媒介性感染症（デング熱・ジカ熱・チクングニア熱）予防のための燻蒸活動を報じるもので、実際の感染事例や流行状況の記載はない。

article.articleHeadline: Миру может грозить новая опасная пандемия, схожая с COVID-19
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: A new dangerous pandemic similar to COVID-19 could threaten the world.
article.articleSummary: WHO Director-General Tedros Adhanom Ghebreyesus warns that the emergence of a new respiratory pathogen could ignite a pandemic with consequences similar to COVID-19. Speaking at a United Nations General Assembly press conference in New York, he said the question is not if but when a novel respiratory threat will emerge. He emphasized that global outbreaks can arise anywhere and threaten the world, citing the ongoing risk of severe respiratory disease. The article recalls that COVID-19 began in December 2019 in Wuhan, China, transmitted by airborne droplets, leading to millions of infections and deaths, and triggering lockdowns, border closures, and an economic crisis. Although the WHO terminated the COVID-19 public health emergency of international concern in May 2023, the virus continues to circulate, mutates, and cause seasonal respiratory illnesses.

triage.headline_ja: COVID-19に類似した新たな危険なパンデミックが世界を脅かす可能性
triage.triage_reason: 実際の新規感染症発生事例ではなく、WHO事務局長による将来的なパンデミックリスクに関する一般的・予測的な発言を報じた記事であるため、具体的なシグナルとして扱う根拠が乏しい。
triage.notes: 記事はWHO事務局長による将来のパンデミックリスクへの警鐘であり、具体的な新規感染事例や発生地域の報告はない。武漢・中国は過去のCOVID-19起源の説明としてのみ言及されており、現在進行中のイベントではない。ニューヨークは記者会見の開催地であり発生地域ではない。

article.articleHeadline: Após caso de raiva em cão, RJ promove vacinação antirrábica neste sábado
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: After a rabies case in a dog, Rio de Janeiro promotes rabies vaccination this Saturday.
article.articleSummary: Rio de Janeiro state health department (SES-RJ) launches a rabies vaccination campaign for dogs and cats this Saturday, 26 September 2026, in partnership with municipalities, with vaccines and antirabic sera available at 25 state vaccination hubs and 24-hour support for health professionals. Although no recent human rabies cases have been confirmed, the alert follows a dog that had contact with a bat diagnosed with rabies in Santa Cruz, Western Zone of Rio, underscoring the importance of keeping domestic animals vaccinated and avoiding wildlife contact. From January to August this year, the public health system logged 38,517 animal-related injuries, mainly involving dogs and cats, with some incidents after contact with bats and saguis (squirrel monkeys). Rabies transmits via bites, scratches, or saliva, and is almost always fatal after symptoms. Exposed individuals should wash wounds and seek care promptly; observe dogs/cats for 10 days if possible. Do not kill or abandon animals; avoid wildlife. Monitora RJ panel lists vaccination hubs; 24-hour guidance.

triage.headline_ja: 犬の狂犬病発症を受け、リオデジャネイロ州が今週土曜日に狂犬病予防接種を実施
triage.triage_reason: 動物（犬）への狂犬病感染事例に対する通常の予防接種キャンペーンであり、人への感染例は確認されておらず、公衆衛生上の深刻な影響や異常性は認められない。ブラジルは対象国だが特段の懸念材料はない。
triage.notes: 狂犬病は動物由来の風土病的事象であり、州保健当局による通常の予防接種キャンペーンの一環。人への感染例は確認されていない。

article.articleHeadline: Mutirão contra a dengue em Limeira será realizado na região do Lagoa Nova | Rápido no Ar
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Dengue control campaign in Limeira will be held in the Lagoa Nova region | Rápido no Ar.
article.articleSummary: Dengue control campaign in Limeira, São Paulo, Brazil, will occur Saturday, Sept 26, 2026, from 7:30 to 12:00, targeting Jardim Lagoa Nova, Jardim Residencial Luiz Regitano, Residencial Las Palmas, Residencial São Miguel, and Residencial Alto do Lago. Ninety-five uniformed agents with ID badges will visit homes to educate residents about dengue prevention and inspect containers that can collect water.
