triage.headline_ja: リメイラでのデング熱対策キャンペーンがラゴア・ノヴァ地域で実施へ | Rápido no Ar
triage.triage_reason: 通常の予防的デング対策活動（家庭訪問・繁殖地点検査）に関する地域広報記事であり、異常な流行や重症例の報告はない。
triage.notes: 記事はブラジル・サンパウロ州リメイラ市における通常の蚊対策（環境衛生）キャンペーンの告知であり、感染拡大や症例数の異常な増加を示す情報はない。

article.articleHeadline: Qualificaves aborda papel dos colaboradores na prevenção da influenza aviária
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Qualificaves addresses the role of staff in preventing avian influenza.
article.articleSummary: Avian influenza concerns in Espírito Santo, Brazil, underscore a non-outbreak-focused biosafety initiative. The Espírito Santo Aviculture Association (AVES) held Module 3 of Qualificaves, a Commercial Posture training, on 17 September 2026 at Granja Matriz da Ovos Santa Maria in Santa Maria de Jetibá, ES. The session, themed 'Avian Influenza and the role of workers in biosafety,' gathered maintenance, electrical, and construction teams and partner professionals. Bruno Oliveira, State Agricultural Inspector at the Espírito Santo Institute of Agricultural and Forestry Defense (Idaf), stressed that successful biosecurity hinges on everyone with access to production areas, not just veterinary services. Emphasizing daily protocols, he highlighted access controls, vehicle disinfection, and flow of personnel as essential to protecting flocks and the Espírito Santo poultry industry. AVES aims to tailor biosafety training to members, delivering on-site content directly within farms and associated groups.

triage.headline_ja: Qualificavesが鳥インフルエンザ予防における従業員の役割について取り組む
triage.triage_reason: 実際の発生事例ではなく、養鶏業界における予防的なバイオセキュリティ研修に関する記事であり、公衆衛生上の懸念やアウトブレイクの報告はない。
triage.notes: 記事は鳥インフルエンザの実際の発生ではなく、予防的なトレーニングセッションに関するものであるため、感染症イベントとしてのシグナルには該当しない。

article.articleHeadline: Influenza aviaria, vaccino a mRNA auto-replicante passa primo test sull'uomo negli Usa, ma siero non testato per prevenire infezione e malattia
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Avian influenza, self-amplifying mRNA vaccine passes first-in-human trial in the United States, but the serum has not been tested to prevent infection and disease.
article.articleSummary: Avian influenza self-amplifying mRNA vaccine ARCT-2304 achieved first-in-human testing in the United States: in 212 healthy adults it elicited measurable immune responses with no new safety signals reported, but the serum was not tested for protection against infection, disease, or hospitalization. European detections were at seasonal minimum, with 110 virus detections across 12 countries (7 in domestic birds, 103 in wild birds). Between June 5 and August 31, 2026, human infections totaled 15 across Bangladesh (1), Cambodia (1), and China (13); no deaths were reported. The vaccine uses proteins from the A/Indonesia/5/2005 strain, while avian viruses continue to evolve. The trial was funded by BARDA; nine of ten authors are Arcturus Therapeutics employees with stock options, and a clinician received compensation. Safety concerns regarding self-amplifying RNA diffusion via extracellular vesicles are noted, warranting caution and further data.

triage.headline_ja: 鳥インフルエンザ、自己増幅型mRNAワクチンが米国で初のヒト試験を通過するも、血清は感染・発症予防効果は未検証
triage.triage_reason: 記事の主題はmRNAワクチンの臨床試験結果であり、鳥インフルエンザの人間感染事例は季節的に低水準（6月〜8月で15例、死亡なし）だが、ウイルスの継続的変異とH5N1の潜在的リスクから経過観察が妥当。
triage.notes: 記事の主眼はワクチン開発（BARDA資金、Arcturus Therapeutics社の利益相反あり）。人間感染事例（バングラデシュ1、カンボジア1、中国13）は対象国リスト外のバングラデシュ・カンボジアを除き、中国のみ抽出。欧州の鳥類検出は季節最小水準で、大きな懸念材料ではない。

article.articleHeadline: Глава ВОЗ предупредил о неизбежности новой пандемии
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: WHO chief warned of the inevitability of a new pandemic.
article.articleSummary: As of 25 September 2026, the WHO Director-General Tedros Adhanom Ghebreyesus warned at a press conference during the United Nations General Assembly in New York that the emergence of a new respiratory pathogen could trigger a pandemic with consequences comparable to COVID-19. He stressed that a future pandemic is inevitable—the question is when, not if. Ghebreyesus cited the ongoing Ebola outbreak in the Democratic Republic of Congo as a reminder that epidemics can begin anywhere and pose threats not only to local communities but also to neighboring countries and global health security.

triage.headline_ja: WHO事務局長、新たなパンデミックの不可避性について警告
triage.triage_reason: 具体的な新規発生事象ではなくWHO事務局長の一般的な将来リスクに関する発言であり、DRCのエボラ流行への言及も既知情報の引用にとどまるため、フルRRAの対象とはせず継続監視とする。
triage.notes: 記事の主題はWHO事務局長の将来的パンデミックに関する一般的警告であり、具体的な新規感染症イベントの発生を報じるものではない。DRCのエボラ流行は引用として言及されているが詳細情報はなし。米国・ニューヨークはWHO総会開催地であり感染症発生地ではないため除外。

article.articleHeadline: Coronavírus continua sendo ameaça para futuras epidemias, alerta revisão científica
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Coronavirus continues to be a threat to future epidemics, scientific review warns.
article.articleSummary: Coronaviruses remain a grave global threat with potential to spark new epidemics, according to a Lancet Respiratory Medicine review. Human coronaviruses include SARS-CoV, MERS-CoV, and SARS-CoV-2, which continue to be WHO priority pathogens due to mutations and animal-to-human transmission. The viruses can cause a spectrum from asymptomatic infection to severe pneumonia and multi-organ complications, with ongoing spillovers maintaining circulation. The study highlights lessons from the COVID-19 pandemic, notably the need for robust surveillance capable of rapid detection of emerging coronaviruses, especially in resource-limited regions. Experts call for sustained investments in research, vaccine and antiviral development, international monitoring networks, and stronger integration of human, animal, and environmental health. Only permanent preparedness will enable faster, more effective responses to future coronavirus emergencies.

triage.headline_ja: コロナウイルスは今後も流行の脅威であり続ける、科学的レビューが警告
triage.triage_reason: 特定の国・地域での実際の発生事例ではなく、コロナウイルス全般に関する科学的レビュー・総説記事であるため、シグナルトリアージの対象とならない。
triage.notes: 記事は特定の発生イベントではなく、Lancet Respiratory Medicine誌のレビュー論文に基づく一般的な啓発記事。ブラジルは発信元メディアの所在地に過ぎず、記事内容とは無関係のため verified_locations には含めない。

article.articleHeadline: La OMS afirma que el brote de ébola en el Congo se ha extendido a dos nuevas zonas sanitarias
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: The World Health Organization says that the Ebola outbreak in Congo has spread to two new health zones
article.articleSummary: On September 25, 2026, the World Health Organization said the Ebola outbreak in the Democratic Republic of the Congo, caused by the Bundibugyo virus, has spread to two additional health zones, bringing the total to 63 zones across seven provinces. The newly affected zones are Bulu in Sud-Ubangi Province and Dungu in Haut-Uele Province, which borders South Sudan. The outbreak remains centered in Butembo, North Kivu, as aid agencies intensify their containment efforts and MSF operates Ebola treatment facilities such as the center in Kitatumba. The report underscores ongoing transmission and expanding geographic reach within the DRC, signaling a substantial scale-up in response to the Bundibugyo-linked outbreak.

triage.headline_ja: WHO、コンゴのエボラ出血熱の流行が新たに2つの保健地域に拡大したと発表
triage.triage_reason: エボラ出血熱（ブンディブギョ株）の流行が7州63地域に拡大し、国境地域（南スーダン国境）にも及ぶなど、国際的拡大リスクと公衆衛生への深刻な影響が認められるためフルRRAへ進む。
triage.notes: 新規拡大地域はDungu（Haut-Uele州、南スーダン国境）とBulu（Sud-Ubangi州）。南スーダンでの発生は言及されておらず、国境近接のみのため南スーダンはverified_locationsに含めない。

article.articleHeadline: 剛果伊波拉疫情蔓延 WHO證實再增2個衛生區淪陷 - 民視新聞網
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Ebola outbreak in the Democratic Republic of the Congo spreads; WHO confirms two more health zones have fallen - Minshi News Network
article.articleSummary: As of 26 September 2026, the World Health Organization reports that the Ebola outbreak in the Democratic Republic of the Congo, caused by Bundibugyo virus, has spread to two additional health zones, bringing the total to 63 affected health zones across seven provinces. The newly affected zones are Bulu in Sud Ubangi province and Dungu in Haut-Uele province, near the South Sudan border. The report does not provide updated case or death counts or laboratory confirmation details, and no infection source beyond the Bundibugyo virus is specified. The expansion underscores ongoing transmission within the country across multiple provinces, highlighting continued surveillance and response needs in border regions.

triage.headline_ja: コンゴ・エボラ疫情拡大 WHOが新たに2つの衛生区での感染確認を発表 - 民視新聞網
triage.triage_reason: エボラ出血熱がコンゴ民主共和国内で7州63衛生区に拡大しており、国際的拡大リスクや公衆衛生への深刻な影響が認められるためフルRRAへ進める。
triage.notes: 南スーダン国境付近への拡大が言及されているが、南スーダンでの感染発生は明記されておらず、対象国リストにも含まれないため verified_locations には含めない。症例数・死亡者数の更新情報は不明。

article.articleHeadline: WHO says Congo Ebola outbreak spreads to two new health zones
article.articleSummary: As of 25 September 2026, the World Health Organization said the Bundibugyo virus Ebola outbreak in the Democratic Republic of the Congo has spread to two additional health zones, bringing the total affected to 63 across seven provinces. The newly affected zones are Bulu in Sud Ubangi province and Dungu in Haut-Uele province, which borders South Sudan. This expansion demonstrates the outbreak's continued geographic reach within the DRC. The article does not provide per-zone case counts beyond the overall total, nor does it include further details on laboratory confirmation, onset dates, or infection sources. Reuters coverage of the update is cited.

triage.headline_ja: WHO、コンゴのエボラ出血熱流行が新たに2つの保健地域に拡大と発表
triage.triage_reason: エボラ出血熱の流行が国境地域を含む複数州へ拡大しており、国際的拡大リスクと公衆衛生上の深刻さからIHR基準・WPRO基準ともに複数該当する。

article.articleHeadline: Surto de ebola na África reforça alerta para novas emergências sanitárias
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Ebola outbreak in Africa heightens alert for new health emergencies.
article.articleSummary: Bundibugyo Ebola outbreak in the Democratic Republic of Congo and Uganda declared a public health emergency by the World Health Organization and Africa CDC. As of May 27, 2026, 129 laboratory-confirmed cases, over 1,000 suspected cases, and 246 suspected deaths across the two countries. Transmission centers in mining regions, major trade corridors, and conflict-affected areas where rapid movement and limited health access complicate control. No vaccines, therapies, or validated tests are available specifically for Bundibugyo virus; containment relies on rapid case identification, isolation, contact tracing, protection of health workers, and safe burial practices. Community engagement is essential to counter fear, stigma, and misinformation that impede care-seeking and transmission interruption. The outbreak highlights the need for sustained investments in surveillance, laboratories, vaccine and drug research, and a strengthened African capacity to respond to health emergencies.

triage.headline_ja: アフリカでのエボラ出血熱流行が新たな健康危機への警戒を強化
triage.triage_reason: WHOとアフリカCDCが公衆衛生上の緊急事態を宣言し、129例の確定症例・246人の死亡が報告されている。ワクチンや治療法が存在せず、鉱山地帯や交易路での感染拡大リスクが高いため、フルリスク評価が必要と判断した。
triage.notes: ウガンダも発生地域として記載されているが、対象国リストに含まれないため verified_locations には含めていない。Bundibugyoウイルス型で承認済みワクチン・治療薬が存在しない点が特に重大。

article.articleHeadline: 【联大高级别周特别报道】联大高级别会议聚焦"下一场"可能出现的大流行病威胁
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Special Report on UN General Assembly High-Level Week: The High-Level Meeting Focuses on the Next Potential Pandemic Threat.
article.articleSummary: On 25 September 2026, during the UN General Assembly High-Level Meeting on Pandemic Prevention, Preparedness and Response, UN officials, WHO Director-General Tedros Adhanom Ghebreyesus, and health experts warned that the next pandemic could arrive at any time and that preparedness remains insufficient. The Democratic Republic of the Congo's Ebola outbreak and hantavirus cases highlight persistent risks. COVID-19 killed over 20 million people and caused more than $10 trillion in economic losses, yet countries have built new security mechanisms, including the World Bank's Pandemic Emergency Financing Facility, a Berlin-based Global Pandemic Intelligence Center, the COVID-19 Vaccines Global Access mechanism, and strengthened International Health Regulations. The remaining gap is the Pathogen Access and Benefit-Sharing Mechanism; the Pandemic Agreement, adopted May 20, 2025, is not yet in force. Tedros insists the agreement will not infringe sovereignty. Helen Clark warns that $15 billion per year is still needed to close gaps and ensure equity.

triage.headline_ja: 【国連総会ハイレベル週間特別報道】国連総会ハイレベル会合、次に起こりうるパンデミックの脅威に焦点
triage.triage_reason: 本記事は国連総会でのパンデミック予防に関する政策会合の報道であり、DRCのエボラ流行やハンタウイルス症例は既知の事例として言及されているに過ぎず、新規の具体的な発生情報や数値データは含まれていないため、シグナルとしての追加評価は不要と判断した。
triage.notes: 記事は国連総会ハイレベル会合に関する政策報道であり、DRCのエボラ流行やハンタウイルス症例は既存の事例紹介として触れられているのみで、新規の疫学的詳細（症例数・期間・地域など）は記載されていない。ドイツ（ベルリン所在のGlobal Pandemic Intelligence Center）は政策インフラの紹介であり対象国リストにも該当しないため除外。

article.articleHeadline: DBD Mengintai Lebak, 793 Kasus Tercatat dan 3 Nyawa Melayang
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Dengue Fever Looms in Lebak, 793 Cases Recorded and 3 Lives Lost
article.articleSummary: A Dengue fever (DBD) outbreak in Lebak Regency, Banten Province, Indonesia reports 793 cases as of August 2026, with 3 deaths. This marks a rise from 602 cases in January–August 2025. Rangkasbitung District records the highest burden with 148 cases (≈18.6% of Lebak’s total). Contributing factors include variable climate and warm temperatures accelerating Aedes aegypti breeding in standing water. Authorities urge preemptive prevention, urging community participation to curb mosquito proliferation. The Health Office’s 3M Plus campaign recommends draining and covering water containers, and disposing of items that collect water; additional measures include wearing long sleeves/pants, using insect repellent, and installing screens. Regular larval checks at least weekly are advised, with immediate cleaning if larvae are found. Travelers away for more than a week should keep water storage closed or emptied to prevent egg-laying.

triage.headline_ja: デング熱がルバッを脅かす、793症例記録・3人死亡
triage.triage_reason: デング熱の地域的な症例増加・死亡例があるが、インドネシアでは季節的に頻発する疾患であり国際的拡大や渡航制限のリスクは低い。地域保健当局が対応中であり、続報を注視するレベル。
triage.notes: 季節性デング熱の地域的増加報告。前年同期比で症例増加(602→793)、死亡3例。地方自治体レベルで防疫活動が行われており、国際的な懸念や渡航制限には至っていない。

article.articleHeadline: WHO says Congo Ebola outbreak spreads to two new health zones
article.articleSummary: As of Sept 25, 2026, the World Health Organization reports the Ebola outbreak in the Democratic Republic of the Congo, caused by Bundibugyo virus, has spread to two new health zones—Bulu in Sud Ubangi province and Dungu in Haut-Uele province (which borders South Sudan). The expansion brings the total number of affected zones to seven provinces and 63 people affected across the country. The report notes ongoing transmission within the DRC but provides no zone-specific case counts or deaths, laboratory confirmation details, infection sources, or information on imported/exported cases. Haut-Uele’s border with South Sudan is highlighted. No further details on symptoms or interventions are included in the article.

triage.headline_ja: WHO、コンゴのエボラ出血熱流行が2つの新たな保健地域に拡大したと発表
triage.triage_reason: WHOが報告するエボラ(ブンディブギョウイルス)アウトブレイクがDRC国内で拡大し、南スーダン国境地域にも及んでいるため、国際的拡大リスクと公衆衛生上の深刻性からフルRRAが必要。
triage.notes: 南スーダンは対象国リストに含まれないため verified_locations には含めていないが、国境地域(Haut-Uele)での越境リスクとして記載されている点に留意。具体的な症例数・死亡者数、検査確認、感染源等の詳細情報は不明。

article.articleHeadline: RDC : vacciner les soignants contre Ebola
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: DRC: Vaccinate healthcare workers against Ebola.
article.articleSummary: Ebola outbreak in the Democratic Republic of Congo (DRC) now affects Sud-Ubangi, the seventh province, as Ebola exposure continues in Kisangani (Tshopo) where a doctor, Victor Kingombe, died. The outbreak has claimed about 3,800 lives, with 12 health workers infected in Tshopo to date. The government intensifies the response, prioritizing vaccination of frontline healthcare workers. A vaccination campaign began on 19 September to protect clinicians and to evaluate the Ervebo vaccine against Bundibugyo virus linked to the current outbreak. Prime Minister Judith Suminwa told the UN General Assembly in New York that the DRC has mobilized $50 million for the Ebola fight, including $3 million for research, with additional funding from international partners. The campaign seeks to mitigate healthcare worker risks from contact with blood/fluids and PPE use, amid fatigue, stigma, and potential community resistance."

triage.headline_ja: コンゴ民主共和国：医療従事者にエボラワクチン接種
triage.triage_reason: エボラ流行が7州目に拡大し死者約3800人、医療従事者感染も継続しており、公衆衛生への深刻な影響・国際的拡大リスクからIHR基準複数該当かつ社会的関心も高い。
triage.notes: 死者数約3800人という大規模な流行で、新たにSud-Ubangi州に拡大。国際的な資金支援・ワクチン接種キャンペーンが進行中であり、フルリスク評価が必要と判断。

article.articleHeadline: Congo Struggles With Health Worker Shortage Amid Rising Ebola Cases
article.articleSummary: Ebola outbreak in the Democratic Republic of Congo (DRC) continues under a severe health‑worker shortage, straining treatment centers. North Kivu records a 73% rise in cases over three weeks, while Ituri—the outbreak’s origin—registered a 26% drop from Aug 31 to Sep 20; Haut-Uele fell 15%. Ebola has reached seven provinces, with 7,773 confirmed cases and 3,759 deaths. Transmission patterns vary by area, and the outbreak remains uncontrolled across a wide geographic area. Contributing factors include ongoing insecurity, displacement, large population movements, and a strike by healthcare workers. WHO regional emergency director for Africa, Marie Roseline Belizaire, warned the outbreak could overtake the 2014–2016 West Africa epidemic, the deadliest on record. Children under five face the greatest risk, with more than 60% of infected children dying versus about 40% of adults.

triage.headline_ja: コンゴ、エボラ症例増加の中で医療従事者不足に苦慮
triage.triage_reason: DRCで7,773人の確定症例・3,759人の死亡、7州に拡大し制御不能な状態が続いており、WHOが2014-2016年西アフリカ流行を超える可能性を警告するなど深刻な公衆衛生上の脅威であるため。
triage.notes: Angolaは発生地域に含まれるが記事本文では言及されておらず、対象国リストにも該当しないため除外。北キブ・イトゥリ・オートウエレ等の州レベル情報は国レベルでDRCに集約。

article.articleHeadline: Ebola à la Tshopo : quatre élus nationaux tirent la sonnette d'alarme sur les failles de la riposte - ACP
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Ebola in Tshopo: Four national MPs sound the alarm over gaps in the outbreak response - ACP
article.articleSummary: Four Kisangani-based MPs warn of gaps in the Ebola virus disease response in Tshopo, DRC, citing PPE shortages for field teams, inadequate training, and delays in paying hazard bonuses. As of Sept 23, Tshopo logged 43 laboratory-confirmed EVD cases and 17 deaths, with Kisangani’s De Smet Hospital Center identified as the new epicenter. Dr. Victor Kingombe, a physician at the Kisangani Ebola Treatment Center, died on Sept 24, marking the first health worker fatality in the province since the outbreak began. The four deputies—Fontaine Mangala, Lady Yangotikala, Theoveul Lotika, and Jean-Pierre Maowa—also pulled out of meetings on a $50,000-per-province awareness envelope, urging that funds be redirected to response equipment. They urged adherence to hygiene measures and called on the Health Ministry to urgently address field shortcomings, citing lessons from Ituri.

triage.headline_ja: チョポ州のエボラ出血熱：国会議員4名が対応の不備について警鐘を鳴らす - ACP
triage.triage_reason: コンゴ民主共和国チョポ州でエボラ出血熱の確認症例43件・死亡17件、医療従事者の死亡も発生し、PPE不足など対応の欠陥が国会議員から指摘されており、IHR基準・WPRO基準ともに複数該当する。
triage.notes: 既知のアウトブレイクの継続だが、医療従事者の初死亡例、PPE不足、訓練不足など対応の重大な欠陥が国会議員から公式に指摘されており、状況悪化のシグナルとして注視が必要。イツリ州への波及にも言及あり。

article.articleHeadline: Prayagraj health department launches seven-zone dengue prevention drive
article.articleSummary: Prayagraj, Sept 25, 2026: dengue prevention drive expanded with seven city zones—Teliyarganj, Allahapur, Dhoomanganj, Mundera, Naini, Jhunsi and Phaphamau. Twenty-one Quick Response Teams (QRTs) include one malaria inspector, one supervisor, two spray members; each QRT is paired with Domestic Breeder Checkers (DBC) to curb Aedes breeding. Following newly detected dengue cases in Salori and Govindpur, officials focus on water stagnation elimination and breeding source removal in residential and commercial spaces. DBCs inspect indoor and outdoor spots weekly, including refrigerators, tanks, flowerpots, coconut shells, and old vehicles, and perform fogging twice daily in hotspots. Anti-larva spray in low-lying and affected areas is being intensified. So far, 39 dengue cases reported Jan 1–Sept 22. If a house case is found, teams scan at least 50 surrounding houses. Authorities urge sanitation and resident cooperation; ward surveys identify persistent breeding grounds.

triage.headline_ja: プラヤーグラージ保健局、7地区でデング熱予防対策を開始
triage.triage_reason: 季節性デング熱に対する通常の予防活動（防除・薬剤散布・点検）の報告であり、症例数（39例、1月-9月）も突出しておらず、異常性・国際的拡大リスクは認められない。
triage.notes: 地方保健当局による定例的なベクター対策（デング熱・マラリア）の実施報告。症例数は限定的で、地域内で管理可能な状況とみられる。

article.articleHeadline: டெங்கு கொசு ஒழிப்பு பணி தீவிரம்
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Intensification of dengue mosquito eradication drive.
article.articleSummary: Intensified dengue vector control was carried out in Ambur Municipality, under the directive of Municipal Commissioner Muthusami, in Ward 35. On Friday, dengue mosquito eradication and prevention operations targeted homes and surrounding areas, with teams identifying and removing standing water, waste items, and other mosquito-breeding sites. Residents were advised to ensure water does not stagnate in houses, streets, or public spaces, and to keep environments free of conditions conducive to mosquito breeding. The drive forms part of ongoing dengue prevention efforts by the municipal authorities to curb the local transmission risk. No case counts or laboratory confirmations are noted in the report; the focus remains on environmental management and community compliance to reduce vector density.

triage.headline_ja: デング熱媒介蚊駆除活動の強化
triage.triage_reason: デング熱の日常的な予防・防除活動を報じる内容であり、症例数や異常な流行状況の報告はなく、通常の公衆衛生対応の範囲内である。
triage.notes: 地方自治体による定例的な蚊駆除・環境衛生活動の報道であり、症例数やアウトブレイクの兆候は記載されていない。インドのタミル・ナードゥ州が対象地域だが、対象国リストにインドは含まれるものの、記事内容は通常の予防活動でシグナルとしての緊急性は低い。

article.articleHeadline: Tshopo : le personnel d'un hôpital appelé à appliquer les mesures préventives contre Ebola - ACP
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Tshopo: hospital staff urged to implement preventive measures against Ebola - ACP
article.articleSummary: On 25 September 2026, in Kisangani, Tshopo Medical Center was urged to enforce Ebola virus disease (EVD) preventive measures after the death of Dr Victor Kingombe at Kisangani’s Ebola Treatment Center following a week of hospitalization. Dr Mateus Kanga Londimo, president of the Tshopo Provincial Assembly and founder of the hospital, warned that if an Ebola case is recorded, the facility could be closed and all staff quarantined for 21 days. He stressed universal PPE use and temperature screening for every entrant, regardless of status, and urged vigilance when admitting new patients since their health condition may be unknown. Dr Trésor Kasolua, the medical director, endorsed the guidelines and pledged adherence. The press note followed an announcement by SYNAMED/Tshopo provincial executives. The patient’s death occurred at the CTE after treatment there.

triage.headline_ja: チョポ州：病院職員にエボラ対策の徹底を要請 - ACP
triage.triage_reason: エボラ治療センターで入院していた医師が死亡し、病院職員に予防措置強化が要請されている。エボラは公衆衛生上重大かつ異常な事象であり、フルリスク評価が必要。
triage.notes: エボラ治療センターで治療を受けていた医師が死亡し、地元当局が病院職員に対しPPE着用・体温スクリーニングの徹底を求めている。確定患者数や新規感染者の情報は記事に含まれておらず、続報の確認が必要。

article.articleHeadline: Congo Struggles With Health Worker Shortage Amid Rising Ebola Cases
article.articleSummary: Ebola outbreak in the Democratic Republic of Congo (DRC) persists, with 7,773 confirmed cases and 3,759 deaths reported across seven provinces as of 25 September 2026. North Kivu shows a 73% rise in cases over three weeks, while Ituri—the outbreak's origin—records a 26% drop from Aug 31 to Sep 20 and Haut-Uele a 15% decline. Transmission patterns differ by province, and the outbreak remains uncontrolled and geographically wide. Factors hampering response include ongoing insecurity, population displacement, large movements of people, and a strike by healthcare workers. The World Health Organization warns the current outbreak could eventually surpass the 2014–2016 West Africa epidemic as the deadliest. Children under five face particularly high risk, with more than 60% of under-fives who contract Ebola dying, versus about 40% of adults.

triage.headline_ja: コンゴ、エボラ症例増加の中で医療従事者不足に苦慮
triage.triage_reason: DRCで7,773人の確定症例、3,759人の死亡が報告され、WHOが2014-2016年の西アフリカ流行を上回る可能性を警告するなど、深刻かつ拡大傾向にあるエボラ流行であるためフルRRAへ進める。
triage.notes: 記事はアンゴラを発生地域として挙げているが、サマリー本文ではDRCの流行状況のみが記述されており、アンゴラでの発生は確認できないため対象外とした。

article.articleHeadline: Nord-Kivu : l'engagement des leaders communautaires recommandé pour arrêter la propagation d'Ebola - ACP
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: North Kivu: Involvement of community leaders recommended to stop the spread of Ebola.
article.articleSummary: North Kivu, Democratic Republic of Congo—In Beni, a social dialogue on Ebola virus disease urged broader community engagement to halt transmission. Community leaders and provincial deputies were urged by Nord-Kivu vice-governor Louis Second Karawa to mobilize populations, relay accurate messages, reduce rumors and stigma, and build trust with response teams. The event, supported by partners including WHO, reviewed actions by the four pillars of the technical coordination of the response since the first laboratory-confirmed Ebola case in Nord-Kivu on 18 May 2026. At closure, Nord-Kivu Provincial Assembly Speaker Robert Seninga read a collective pledge to intensify prevention, awareness, and response, including information dissemination, combating misinformation, protecting affected people and families, and strengthening dialogue and collaboration among communities, authorities, health professionals, and responders.

triage.headline_ja: 北キブ州：エボラの感染拡大を阻止するため地域社会指導者の関与が推奨される
triage.triage_reason: 進行中のエボラ出血熱アウトブレイク（2026年5月18日に北キブ州で最初の検査確認例）への対応強化に関する報道であり、重症度・持続的曝露・流行の可能性・国際支援の必要性などWPRO基準に複数該当し、行政・WHOの関与も見られるため社会的関心も高い。
triage.notes: 本記事は2026年5月18日に確認された北キブ州のエボラアウトブレイクへの継続的対応（コミュニティ関与強化）に関するもので、新規発生ではなく既存アウトブレイクの経過報告。フルRRAでの詳細な感染者数・致死率等の確認が必要。

article.articleHeadline: Lung disease admissions at city hospitals rise 10%, doctors point at infection severity
article.articleSummary: Kolkata city hospitals report a sustained rise in lung-disease admissions this year, about 6%-10% higher than last year, with CMRI recording a 25% increase and Charnock Hospital noting an 8%-10% rise and ICU cases. Influenza outbreaks since June have driven more severe respiratory illness; many patients across ages present persistent cough, wheezing, and acute flare-ups of asthma and COPD, with a substantial portion progressing to severe pneumonia requiring oxygen support or ICU care. At Charnock, around 80% of severe cases have died, a sharp contrast to last year. A significant share of patients have prior Covid or long respiratory illness, suggesting increased airway vulnerability. Experts attribute the trend to more severe post-Covid-era influenza strains and possible immune down-regulation or viral mutations, while some credit influenza vaccination for milder disease in vaccinated patients. Public health measures like masks, hand hygiene, and vaccination are urged, especially for the elderly with lung histories.

triage.headline_ja: コルカタ市内の病院で肺疾患による入院が10%増加、医師らは感染症の重症化を指摘
triage.triage_reason: コルカタでインフルエンザ由来の重症呼吸器疾患が増加し、一部病院では重症例の約80%が死亡と異例の高致死率が報告されているため、IHR基準（深刻性・異常性）を2つ満たしフルRRAへの移行が妥当と判断。
triage.notes: 記事は特定病院（CMRI、Charnock）の入院統計に基づくローカル報道であり、公式サーベイランスデータや原因病原体の確定（新型インフルエンザ株か等）は不明。80%という致死率は特定施設の重症例に限られ、地域全体の実態把握には続報確認が必要。

article.articleHeadline: Two-year-old dies with suspected rabies symptoms in Andhra Pradesh's Palnadu
article.articleSummary: Two-year-old Sohan Rudransh from Boggaram village, Ipuru mandal, Palnadu district, Andhra Pradesh, died at Guntur Government General Hospital after presenting with symptoms clinically suspected to be rabies. His parents reported a stray dog had licked a wound. He was admitted to a private hospital on Sept 22 for unusual behavior, then shifted to Guntur GGH as his condition deteriorated. Palnadu DMHO Dr Chukka Rathna Manmohan noted there is no laboratory evidence to confirm rabies; it remains a clinical diagnosis, with encephalitis suspected as a possible contributor to death. Without lab-based confirmation by an authorised microbiologist/pathologist, the death cannot be conclusively linked to rabies. A local medical officer conducted a house-to-house survey in Boggaram for recent stray-dog attacks; no such cases were reported during the survey.

triage.headline_ja: アンドラプラデシュ州パルナドゥで2歳児が狂犬病疑いの症状で死亡
triage.triage_reason: 単一症例で臨床診断のみ（検査未確認）、インドでは狂犬病は風土病的に発生しており異常性は低く、周辺調査でも他の咬傷例は報告されていないため拡大リスクは低い。
triage.notes: 狂犬病は検査による確定診断がなされておらず、地域調査でも野良犬による咬傷の追加事例は確認されていない。単発の個別症例であり、公衆衛生上の緊急性は低いと判断。

article.articleHeadline: Industries directed to prevent water stagnation, mosquito breeding
article.articleSummary: As of 2026-09-26, dengue prevention directives issued by the Department of Industrial Safety and Health require industrial units to eliminate mosquito-breeding sources on their premises to curb dengue. Joint Director S. Anitha Rosaline Mary urged units to prevent water stagnation in tyres, drums, tins and other materials, and to keep water storage containers tightly closed. Units should regularly clean water tanks and sumps and ensure their premises are clean. They should identify mosquito-breeding sources and take immediate measures to eliminate them. Awareness programs for workers on dengue prevention should be spread, and any worker who develops fever or related symptoms should be taken to the nearest hospital without delay.

triage.headline_ja: 工場に対し、水の滞留と蚊の発生防止を指示
triage.triage_reason: デング熱の日常的な予防啓発・行政指導に関する記事であり、異常な発生や重症化、拡大の兆候は報告されていない。
triage.notes: デング熱の蚊媒介対策に関する予防的行政指導であり、具体的な患者数や流行状況の記載はない。

article.articleHeadline: Mutirão de combate à dengue mobiliza equipes de Saúde em Água Comprida
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Dengue control campaign mobilizes health teams in Água Comprida
article.articleSummary: Dengue control campaign mobilizes health teams in Água Comprida. A municipal health department-led Mutirão de Combate à Dengue conducted a dengue-control task force across Água Comprida on September 16, 17, 18, 21 and 22, 2026. Teams carried out inspections, eliminated containers that could collect standing water, provided resident guidance, and collected materials that might serve as Aedes aegypti breeding sites. The effort aims to reduce conditions favorable to the Aedes aegypti mosquito, the vector for dengue and other arboviruses. Ongoing prevention depends on community participation, including weekly backyard inspections, putting sand in plant saucers, keeping water tanks, cisterns, and drums sealed, and proper disposal of trash and debris. The article notes no case counts or laboratory confirmations; the report is from Jornal Panorama with information from the Prefeitura de Água Comprida. Location: Água Comprida, Brazil.

triage.headline_ja: デング熱対策キャンペーン、アグア・コンプリーダで保健チームを動員
triage.triage_reason: 症例数や検査確認情報がなく、通常の蚊対策・予防活動を報じる内容であり、異常性・重篤性・社会的関心の高まりは確認できない。
triage.notes: 症例数・検査確認なし。定例的な地域保健活動の報告であり、シグナルとしての緊急性は低い。

article.articleHeadline: Toddler Dies of Suspected Rabies in Palnadu Village
article.articleSummary: As of 26 September 2026, a two-year-old boy from Boggaram village, Ipur mandal, Palnadu district, Andhra Pradesh, died from suspected rabies after a stray dog licked his face on 2 September. He developed hydrophobia and encephalitis, was treated at Narasaraopeta and then at a government hospital in Guntur, dying in the early hours of 23 September. Diagnosis was clinical; no dog bite marks were observed. A door-to-door survey of about 130 residents found no other suspected rabies cases in the two days after the death. There have been no recent reports of dog attacks in the village. Samples could not be tested locally and were sent to IPM Pune for laboratory confirmation. The infection source is described as dog exposure; no additional imported or exported case details were provided.

triage.headline_ja: パルナドゥ村で幼児が狂犬病の疑いで死亡
triage.triage_reason: インドで狂犬病は風土病であり、本件は単発の死亡例で近隣調査でも追加症例は確認されておらず、国際的拡大や渡航制限のリスクも認められない。
triage.notes: 単発の死亡例であり、地域住民130名の戸別調査でも追加の疑い症例は確認されていない。狂犬病はインドで風土病的に発生しており、本件単独では公衆衛生上の重大な影響や国際的懸念には該当しないと判断。

article.articleHeadline: Chuvas aumentam risco de leptospirose na Baixada Santista; saiba como se proteger
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Rainfall increases leptospirosis risk in the Santos Metropolitan Area; learn how to protect yourself.
article.articleSummary: Leptospirosis risk rises in the Santos Metropolitan Area, Brazil, with heavy rains and floods elevating exposure. From January–August 2026, Santos regional health surveillance registered 33 cases; São Paulo state confirmed 347; regional São Paulo 93; Mogi das Cruzes and Campinas 34 each. In 2025, São Paulo state had 451 cases. Symptoms include fever, headache, muscle pain (calves), loss of appetite, nausea, vomiting; about 15% may progress to severe disease with jaundice, bleeding, kidney failure, or respiratory distress. Transmission mainly via water or mud contaminated with urine from infected animals, especially rodents; entry through wounds, mucous membranes, or prolonged skin contact. Protection: avoid floodwater contact; wear waterproof boots and gloves when needed; keep wounds covered; store food properly; secure water tanks to deter rodents; disinfect and clean contaminated areas; children should avoid floodwaters, and items touched by floodwater should be discarded.

triage.headline_ja: 雨量増加によりサントス都市圏でレプトスピラ症のリスク上昇；予防方法を紹介
triage.triage_reason: ブラジル・サンパウロ州で例年規模のレプトスピラ症発生が続いているが、突発的増加や国際的拡大の兆候はなく、季節性の注意喚起記事に留まる。
triage.notes: レプトスピラ症は毎年雨季に発生する季節性疾患で、ヒト-ヒト感染はなく、症例数は例年並み（2025年451件、2026年1-8月で347件超）。公衆衛生上の重大なインパクトや異常性は認められない。

article.articleHeadline: "إيبولا" يتمدد في الكونغو الديمقراطية.. 7890 إصابة و3799 وفاة - الأسبوع
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Ebola is spreading in the Democratic Republic of the Congo... 7,890 cases and 3,799 deaths - The Week
article.articleSummary: Ebola, caused by Bundibugyo ebolavirus, is spreading in the Democratic Republic of Congo. As of 23 September 2026, the outbreak has 7,890 confirmed cases and 3,799 deaths (case fatality rate 48.1%). A 25 September 2026 WHO report notes expansion to two more health zones: Bolu in Sud-Ubangi Province and Dungu in Haut-Uele Province, raising total affected health zones to 63 across seven of the country’s 26 provinces. Daily new cases remain high with transmission varying by province and health zone. The rising fatalities, including many deaths in communities, reflect challenges in early detection and timely access to care, potentially sustaining transmission within households and healthcare facilities. There is ongoing risk of cross-border spread to neighboring countries, prompting calls for intensified response, surveillance, and improved healthcare access to curb transmission.

triage.headline_ja: 「エボラ」がコンゴ民主共和国で拡大…感染7,890例、死亡3,799例 - The Week
triage.triage_reason: コンゴ民主共和国で大規模なエボラ出血熱アウトブレイクが継続・拡大しており、致死率約48%、7州63保健地域に拡大、国境を越えた拡大リスクも指摘されているためフルRRAが必要。
triage.notes: WHO報告に基づく大規模アウトブレイクで、7州63保健地域に拡大中。致死率が高く、家庭内・医療機関内での感染継続の懸念があり、越境拡大リスクも指摘されている。

article.articleHeadline: Врач Чернышова: симптомы гонконгского гриппа не отличаются от обычного
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Dr. Chernysheva: Hong Kong flu symptoms do not differ from ordinary influenza.
article.articleSummary: Hong Kong flu symptoms are indistinguishable from ordinary influenza, according to Dr. Nadezhda Chernysheva, making strain identification impossible without laboratory testing. Core manifestations include abrupt fever rising to 38–40°C, malaise, weakness, headache, and eye and muscle pains. At onset she recommends staying home and obtaining sick leave to prevent transmission, along with bed rest and ample warm fluids. For high fever, fever-reducing medications should be used only under medical guidance. Earlier, Sergey Voznesensky, Candidate of Medical Sciences and associate professor at the Infectious Diseases Department at RUDN University, noted that with symptoms of acute respiratory viral infection it is best to remain home. The article highlights the difficulty of distinguishing Hong Kong flu from other influenza strains without tests.

triage.headline_ja: 医師チェルヌイシェワ:香港風邪の症状は通常のインフルエンザと変わらない
triage.triage_reason: 香港インフルエンザの症状に関する一般的な医療情報提供の記事であり、公衆衛生上の異常事態や国際的拡大リスクを示す内容はない。
triage.notes: 記事は季節性インフルエンザ（通称『香港風邪』）に関する一般的な症状説明・医療アドバイスであり、香港や中国での具体的な発生・流行状況を報じたものではないため、対象国での実際の発生イベントとしては扱わない。

article.articleHeadline: Criança de 2 anos morre por suspeita de febre maculosa - Brazil Urgente
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: 2-year-old child dies from suspected Rocky Mountain spotted fever - Brazil Urgente
article.articleSummary: On September 16, 2026, in Juiz de Fora, Minas Gerais, Brazil, a 2-year-old child died after a convulsion and subsequent hospital care, with a tick bite hypothesized as the infection source. Suspected Rocky Mountain spotted fever (RMSF) emerged as the leading consideration. The patient was admitted to a health facility and then to the Intensive Care Unit, but succumbed to the illness. Laboratory confirmation of RMSF remains pending, with results expected in 15–30 days, depending on the laboratory and whether repeat samples are required. The report does not indicate any confirmed cases or an ongoing outbreak beyond this suspected fatal RMSF case. No additional clinical details or exposure data are provided.

triage.headline_ja: 2歳児がブラジルで紅斑熱（ロッキー山紅斑熱）疑いで死亡 - Brazil Urgente
triage.triage_reason: 単一の疑い死亡例であり、検査確定は保留中。アウトブレイクの拡大は確認されていないが、致死性の可能性がある疾患のため経過観察が必要。
triage.notes: ロッキー山紅斑熱（紅斑熱）はマダニ媒介性で人-人感染はしない。単発の疑い症例であり、検査結果待ちのため確定情報が不足している。続報を注視する必要あり。

article.articleHeadline: Genomic study tracks massive chikungunya epidemic on Réunion Island
article.articleSummary: Chikungunya on Réunion Island surged Aug 2024–Jun 2025, with more than 54,000 confirmed cases and 43 deaths, the island’s second major outbreak after 2005–2006 (which affected about a third of the population). Chikungunya is a mosquito-borne virus transmitted by Aedes; while rarely fatal, it causes severe joint pain that can persist for months or years. In 2025, the epidemic lineage spread to other Indian Ocean islands and, during summer, fueled unprecedented case numbers in Europe and China. The Arbovirus National Reference Center on Réunion sequenced over 3,000 near-complete genomes, enabling phylodynamic and phylogeographic analyses. Results indicate a single introduction with highly intermixed spread driven by human mobility and density, especially at the peak. End of transmission correlated with climate effects plus population immunity (about 66% immune), predicting low resurgence risk. The study advocates integrated genomic, demographic, environmental, and immunity data and continuous seroprevalence monitoring for vector control.

triage.headline_ja: ゲノム研究がレユニオン島における大規模チクングニア熱流行の経過を解明
triage.triage_reason: レユニオン島での大規模流行（2024-2025年）はすでに終息し、免疫獲得率約66%で再燃リスクは低いと予測される学術的な後方視的研究記事であるため緊急性は低いが、同系統ウイルスの中国・欧州への拡大に言及があり今後の動向を注視する必要がある。
triage.notes: 記事の主題はレユニオン島（フランス領、対象国リスト外）における2024-2025年の大規模チクングニア流行のゲノム疫学研究。同系統ウイルスが2025年夏に中国・欧州へ拡大し前例のない症例数を記録したと言及されており、中国のみ対象国として抽出した。ただし既に収束した過去のイベントの分析であり、現在進行中の緊急事態ではない点に留意。

article.articleHeadline: 剛果伊波拉疫情擴散至兩新衛生區　累計奪走近3800命 - 民視新聞網
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Ebola outbreak in the Democratic Republic of the Congo has spread to two new health zones, with nearly 3,800 deaths.
article.articleSummary: Ebola outbreak in the Democratic Republic of the Congo, caused by the Bundibugyo strain, has expanded to two new health zones: Bulu (Sud Ubangi) and Dungu (Haut-Uele, near South Sudan). Total reach now spans seven provinces and 63 health zones. As of September 23, there are 7,890 confirmed cases and 3,799 deaths. Ongoing transmission is hampered by armed conflict and displacement, which hinder health workers’ access and contact tracing. There is no licensed vaccine or approved therapy specifically for the Bundibugyo strain, contributing to reluctance to seek care; the WHO is accelerating clinical trials for vaccines and drugs. Although overall cases are reportedly decreasing and improvements in tracing, safe burials, and community engagement are noted, transmission remains uneven. WHO Director-General Tedros urged stronger global pandemic preparedness and addressed misinformation about the Pandemic Agreement.

triage.headline_ja: コンゴのエボラ疫情、新たに2つの保健区域に拡大　累計死者数近く3800人
triage.triage_reason: エボラ出血熱がDRC国内で7州63保健区域に拡大し、死者数約3800人と深刻な公衆衛生への影響があり、国際的拡大リスクや管理可能性の懸念も認められるためフルRRAへ進めるべき。
triage.notes: 南スーダン近郊への拡大が言及されているが、記事の主題はDRC国内の流行拡大であり、南スーダンは対象国リストに含まれないため除外。Bundibugyo株に対するワクチン・治療薬未承認が管理可能性の懸念を高めている。

article.articleHeadline: ВОЗ сообщила о расширении эпидемии Эболы в Конго
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: WHO reports expansion of the Ebola outbreak in the Congo.
article.articleSummary: World Health Organization (WHO) reports Bundibugyo ebolavirus outbreak in the Democratic Republic of Congo expanding to two additional medical zones: Bulu in the newly created South Ubangi province and Dungu in Upper Uele province, which borders South Sudan. The expansion brings the total number of affected medical zones to 63 across seven of the country’s 26 provinces, increasing the risk of cross-border transmission. As of 23 September 2026, there are 7,890 confirmed Ebola cases and 3,799 deaths, for a case fatality rate of 48.1%. The report notes geographic spread within the DRC; the article does not provide infection sources or whether cases are imported or exported. Information is based on a World Health Organization press release.

triage.headline_ja: WHO、コンゴでのエボラ出血熱流行拡大を報告
triage.triage_reason: WHOが公式にエボラ流行の医療圏拡大（63圏・7州）と致死率48.1%を報告しており、IHR基準・WPRO基準ともに複数該当するためフルRRAへ進むべき。
triage.notes: 南スーダン国境地域への拡大が報告されているが、南スーダンは対象国リストに含まれないため verified_locations には含めない。渡航・貿易制限の有無は記事に明記なし。

article.articleHeadline: Глава ВОЗ заявил о риске новой пандемии
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: WHO Director-General warned of the risk of a new pandemic.
article.articleSummary: On 2026-09-25, WHO Director-General Tedros Adhanom Ghebreyesus warned that the emergence of a new respiratory pathogen could trigger a pandemic with consequences like COVID-19, and said such a pandemic is inevitable and only a matter of time. He cited the ongoing Ebola outbreak in the Democratic Republic of the Congo (DRC) to illustrate that outbreaks can start anywhere at any time and pose threats not only to local communities but also to neighboring countries and the wider world. The warning emphasizes global vigilance, preparedness, and the need for robust surveillance and response capacity to detect and contain novel pathogens and prevent spillover that could become an international concern.

triage.notes: 記事の主題はWHO事務局長による一般的なパンデミック警戒発言であり、DRCのエボラ流行は既知の継続中の事例として例示的に触れられているのみで、新規の発生情報や具体的な感染拡大データは含まれない。

article.articleHeadline: Doença de Ébola pelo vírus Bundibugyo continua a expandir-se na República Democrática do Congo
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Ebola disease caused by Bundibugyo virus continues to spread in the Democratic Republic of the Congo.
article.articleSummary: Ebola disease caused by Bundibugyo virus continues to spread in the Democratic Republic of the Congo (DRC). As of 23 September 2026, the DRC reported 7,890 confirmed cases and 3,799 deaths (case fatality rate 48.1%), with 1,966 recoveries. Since 11 September, 1,133 new confirmed cases and 532 deaths were reported, with a seven-day moving average indicating a resurgence in early September followed by a recent decline. Transmission intensity varies substantially across provinces and health zones. On 23 September, 83.4% of identified contacts were monitored in the last 24 hours, involving 26,980 contacts followed out of 32,342 needing follow-up. The response is hampered by conflict, insecurity, displacement, and limited access to basic services, challenging surveillance, case identification, contact tracing, infection prevention and control, and timely care, limiting overall outbreak control.

triage.headline_ja: コンゴ民主共和国でブンディブギョウイルスによるエボラ出血熱が拡大を続ける
triage.triage_reason: 致死率48.1%、確認症例7,890人・死亡3,799人という大規模アウトブレイクが継続しており、紛争や不安定な治安により対応が困難な状況で、IHR基準・WPRO基準の複数に該当するためフルリスク評価が必要。
triage.notes: 致死率が高く、7日移動平均で再燃と最近の減少が示されているが、接触者追跡率は83.4%と部分的なコントロール下にある。紛争・治安不安・アクセス制限が対応を阻害しており、国際支援の必要性が高い。

article.articleHeadline: WHO says Congo Ebola outbreak spreads to two new health zones
article.articleSummary: Bundibugyo Ebola outbreak in the Democratic Republic of the Congo has spread to two new health zones, Bulu in Sud Ubangi and Dungu in Haut-Uele, raising the total affected to 63 across seven provinces. As of Sept 23, 7,890 confirmed cases and 3,799 deaths have been reported. Ongoing conflict and population displacement hinder access for health workers, complicating contact tracing and safe burials and increasing transmission risk. There are no approved vaccines or treatments for the Bundibugyo strain; the WHO is accelerating clinical trials of vaccines and therapies. Overall cases are declining, but transmission remains uneven. WHO Director-General Tedros warned that Ebola could be followed by a respiratory pathogen triggering a future pandemic, urging strengthened preparedness and citing the May 2025 Pandemic Agreement adopted by the World Health Assembly.

triage.triage_reason: DRCにおけるエボラ（ブンディブギョ株）流行が新規健康圏に拡大し、承認ワクチン・治療薬が存在しない中、紛争・避難民により対応が困難化している。IHR基準複数該当かつ国際的関心が高い。
triage.notes: ブンディブギョ株には承認されたワクチン・治療薬が存在せず、紛争・住民避難により接触者追跡や安全な埋葬が困難。WHOは臨床試験を加速中。全体的な症例数は減少傾向だが、伝播は不均一に継続。

article.articleHeadline: ВОЗ: новый респираторный патоген может вызвать пандемию уровня COVID-19
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: WHO: a new respiratory pathogen could trigger a COVID-19-level pandemic.
article.articleSummary: As of 25 September 2026, WHO Director-General Tedros Adhanom Ghebreyesus warned that the emergence of an unknown respiratory pathogen could ignite a pandemic at COVID-19 scale. He called such an outbreak one of the most alarming global health threats and said a new pandemic is inevitable, with timing uncertain. The warning underscores the need for proactive health-system preparedness worldwide, including stronger surveillance, diagnostics, and surge capacity. Ghebreyesus cited the ongoing Ebola outbreak in the Democratic Republic of Congo as a stark reminder that dangerous infections can emerge anywhere and threaten neighboring regions and other countries. The article emphasizes preparedness should precede an outbreak, not follow it. No laboratory-confirmed details are provided about the hypothetical pathogen, and no countries are singled out beyond the Congo context.

article.articleHeadline: Surto de Ebola no Congo se espalha para duas novas zonas de saúde, diz OMS
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Ebola outbreak in the Democratic Republic of the Congo spreads to two new health zones, WHO says.
article.articleSummary: An Ebola outbreak in the Democratic Republic of the Congo, caused by Bundibugyo ebolavirus, has spread to two new health zones, bringing the total to 63 across seven provinces. As of 23 September, the DRC reports 7,890 cases and 3,799 deaths. The new zones are Bulu in Sud Ubangi and Dungu in Haut-Uele, which borders South Sudan. WHO Director-General Tedros Adhanom Ghebreyesus said conflict and population displacement hinder access and case finding, with restricted access delaying contact tracing. Although overall cases are decreasing and contact tracing, safe burials, and community engagement have improved, transmission remains uneven. The lack of vaccines and treatments approved for Bundibugyo Ebola complicates the response, though WHO is accelerating vaccine and treatment trials. Tedros urged stronger pandemic preparedness for future health emergencies, noting misinformation about the Pandemic Accord adopted by the WHA in May 2025.

triage.triage_reason: エボラ出血熱がコンゴ民主共和国で7つの州63保健区域に拡大し、死者数も多数（3,799名）に上っており、IHR基準・WPRO基準ともに複数該当するため。

article.articleHeadline: 剛果伊波拉疫情擴散　接觸者追蹤缺口高達數十萬人 - 民視新聞網
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Ebola outbreak in the Democratic Republic of the Congo spreads; gaps in contact tracing reach up to hundreds of thousands of people - Minshi News Network
article.articleSummary: Ebola virus disease outbreak in the Democratic Republic of the Congo continues to spread, with public health authorities tracing about 30,000 contacts—far below the estimated 400,000—indicating ongoing community transmission as of September 26, 2026. More than 80% of new confirmed cases are outside existing contact lists. WHO reports spread to seven provinces, including new health zones Bulu in Sud Ubangi and Dungu in Haut-Uele near the South Sudan border, bringing the total to 63 affected health zones. The outbreak, which began in May, is the second-largest on record after 2014–2016 West Africa. Prime Minister Judith Suminwa Tuluka says response measures are yielding tangible results, including slowed transmission in parts of Ituri province. International donors pledged nearly $2.9 billion for Ebola response, with the United States contributing about $886 million.

triage.headline_ja: コンゴ民主共和国でエボラ出血熱が拡大　接触者追跡のギャップは数十万人規模に
triage.triage_reason: IHR基準3項目該当（深刻な公衆衛生影響、異常事態、国際拡大リスク）およびWPRO基準5項目すべて該当し、2014-16年に次ぐ規模の深刻な流行として国際的関心も高いためフルRRAへ進めるべき。

article.articleHeadline: Congo Ebola contact tracing falls far short as outbreak spreads, Africa CDC chief says
article.articleSummary: Democratic Republic of Congo’s Ebola outbreak persists with about 7,000 confirmed cases, yet contact tracing remains woefully underdelivered: roughly 30,000 identified contacts versus an expected ~420,000 (60 contacts per case). Over 80% of new confirmed cases are detected among people not on contact lists, signaling ongoing transmission beyond surveillance. The outbreak, detected in May, has spread to two more health zones—Bulu (Sud Ubangi) and Dungu (Haut-Uele)—bringing the total to 63 zones across seven provinces and marking it the second-largest on record after West Africa’s 2014–2016 epidemic. Africa CDC Director-General Dr. Jean Kaseya warned that control is unattainable without substantially better surveillance; he did not set a timetable, though forecasting could occur if new cases align with monitored contacts, no deaths occur among them, and healthcare worker infections cease. About $2.9 billion has been pledged for the response, including $886 million from the United States.

triage.headline_ja: コンゴのエボラ、感染追跡が大幅に不足、アフリカCDC所長が発生拡大を警告
triage.triage_reason: DRCで進行中のエボラ流行が過去2番目の規模に拡大し、接触者追跡が著しく不足していることから、IHR基準・WPRO基準ともに複数該当し、国際的関心・支援の必要性も高い。

article.articleHeadline: ▷ Alerta sanitaria en el Alto Ventuari: reportan más de 165 indígenas afectados y tres niños fallecidos #25Sep
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Public health alert in Alto Ventuari: more than 165 indigenous people affected and three children have died #25Sep
article.articleSummary: In Alto Ventuari, Amazonas, Venezuela, a health emergency affects more than 165 Ye'kwana and Sanema indigenous people across multiple communities (Cacurí, Joroimeña, Curaguaña, Yajatacuweña, Cujeriña, Macunaima, Tencua, Wachamo, Puerto Unión, San Martín, Caño Negro and surrounding areas). An unidentified febrile illness has produced symptoms including high fever, vomiting, diarrhea, bronchopneumonia, cough, headache, and malaise, with children disproportionately affected. Three children have died: a 1-year-old girl (Wasaraña), a 3-day-old newborn (Cacurí), and a 6-year-old girl (Isla Tití). A Ye'kwana girl and a Sanema infant are gravely ill and require air evacuation to Puerto Ayacucho hospital; local clinics in Tencua and Cacurí report shortages of medicines and supplies. Wayamoutheri and Kuyunu request urgent national and regional response: aerial transport for gravest cases, delivery of medications and supplies, and a medical team to investigate origin and containment. Background notes cite ongoing indigenous vulnerabilities linked to resource shortages and mining-related water contamination.

triage.notes: 発生地はベネズエラ・アマゾナス州アルト・ベントゥアリ地域であり、対象国リスト（Zambia, Philippines, Thailand, Ghana, DRC, Brazil, Indonesia, China, Myanmar, Vietnam, India）には該当しないためverified_locationsは空配列とした。原因病原体は未特定で、鉱山関連の水質汚染や医療資源不足など背景要因が指摘されている。続報で病原体特定や感染拡大状況の確認が必要。

article.articleHeadline: Congo Ebola contact tracing falls far short as outbreak spreads, Africa CDC chief says
article.articleSummary: An Ebola outbreak in the Democratic Republic of Congo remains entrenched, hampered by mistrust and weak contact tracing around Tembo in Ituri. About 7,000 confirmed cases have been reported, but only ~30,000 people have been identified as contacts—far below the ~420,000 expected for complete tracing. More than 80% of new confirmed cases are among people not on contact lists, signaling ongoing community transmission. For each confirmed case, roughly 60 contacts would be expected; the current shortfall underscores uncontrolled spread. The World Health Organization says the outbreak has reached two new health zones, Bulu (Sud Ubangi) and Dungu (Haut-Uele), totaling 63 zones across seven provinces. Ituri remains the epicenter, with some signs of slowing in severe areas. Roughly $2.9 billion has been pledged for the response, including $886 million from the United States.

article.articleHeadline: ΛΔ Κονγκό: Αντιμέτωπη με έλλειψη υγειονομικού προσωπικού ενώ ο ιός Έμπολα παραμένει εκτός ελέγχου
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: DR Congo: Facing a shortage of healthcare workers as the Ebola virus remains out of control.
article.articleSummary: DR Congo is facing the most rapidly evolving Ebola outbreak in its history, with 7,773 confirmed cases and 3,759 deaths across seven provinces, centered in Ituri and the eastern North Kivu. Over three weeks, North Kivu cases surged 73%, though Ituri and Haut-Uele showed declines of 26% and 15% between Aug 31 and Sep 20, 2026, according to WHO. Transmission remains widespread and the outbreak is far from controlled. Response efforts are hampered by insecurity, displacement, health-worker strikes, and mobility. WHO warns the epidemic could surpass West Africa’s 2014–2016 outbreak in deaths (over 11,000). A WHO Ebola case-management official said admissions had begun to fall in North Kivu after weeks of increases, but facilities still lack adequate staff; ETUs require about 300 health professionals, and workers must be paid. In Ituri, frontline staff previously went on strike over unpaid wages. Pediatric fatality under five exceeds 60%, complicating detection.

article.articleSummary: As of 2026-09-25, WHO Director-General Tedros Adhanom Ghebreyesus warned that the emergence of a new respiratory pathogen could spark a pandemic with consequences comparable to COVID-19. He stressed the next pandemic is inevitable, with timing uncertain. He pointed to the ongoing Ebola outbreak in the Democratic Republic of the Congo as a reminder of how quickly infections can spread and threaten populations in neighboring countries and other nations. The message underscores the need for global vigilance, surveillance, and preparedness for novel respiratory agents. The article notes the risk is universal—new pathogens can arise anywhere—calling for strengthened international cooperation to detect, contain, and mitigate future pandemics.

article.articleHeadline: Ebola Outbreak Expands to 63 Health Zones in DR Congo - Diaspora Digital Media (DDM News) - Nigeria Breaking News, Africa and World News and Updates
article.articleSummary: As of 25 September 2026, the Ebola outbreak in the Democratic Republic of Congo has expanded to 63 health zones across 15 of its 26 provinces, with 7,890 laboratory-confirmed cases and 3,799 deaths reported by the World Health Organization. The highest case burdens are in North Kivu, South Kivu, and Ituri in the eastern region. The WHO describes the situation as extremely concerning and warns it could worsen without urgent action. Rapid spread is attributed to ongoing insecurity hindering access, weak health infrastructure, community resistance to response measures, and cross-border movement. The response features deployment of hundreds of health workers and contact tracers, establishment of Ebola treatment centers, and vaccination of high-risk populations with the rVSV-ZEBOV vaccine. This is the 14th outbreak since 1976, declared August 1, 2026, with lingering risk of spread to Uganda, Rwanda, and South Sudan.

article.articleHeadline: Ebola breidt zich verder uit in Congo, aantal sterfgevallen nog hoger
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Ebola continues to spread in Congo, death toll even higher.
article.articleSummary: As of 25 September 2026, the Bundibugyo strain of Ebola continues to spread in the Democratic Republic of Congo (DRC), with two new foci in its northern regions and the total number of districts affected rising to 63. More than 7,890 people have been infected and at least 3,799 have died, with young children especially vulnerable. This year’s outbreak is the deadliest on record for the DRC; there is no vaccine or medicine for Bundibugyo Ebola, hindering containment. Most new cases are in eastern DRC, where armed groups, ethnic violence, and mining interests fuel movement and transmission. Health services are strained, misinformation about Ebola circulates, and poverty drives people to markets and mines despite risk, complicating surveillance. The WHO says the outbreak is not a pandemic, but calls for stronger global readiness for outbreaks akin to COVID-19.

triage.notes: COVID-19が疾患名タグに含まれるが、記事本文はエボラ出血熱の拡大に関するものでCOVID-19は文脈上の比較参照のみ。ワクチン・治療薬が存在しないBundibugyo株であることが封じ込めを困難にしている点、武力紛争が拡大要因である点に注意。

article.articleHeadline: Ebola epidemic update - Cases and deaths
article.articleSummary: 70 new confirmed Ebola Virus Disease (EVD) cases in the Democratic Republic of the Congo over the past 24 hours, including 11 community deaths. Ituri and North Kivu provinces each report 31 new cases; Haut-Uélé 6; Bas-Uélé 1; Tshopo 1. Nine deaths occurred in Ebola Treatment Centers today (6 in Ituri, 3 in North Kivu), bringing daily deaths to 20. Fifteen patients recovered (7 Ituri, 5 North Kivu, 3 Haut-Uélé) after testing negative for EVD twice. Since outbreak onset, 7,890 confirmed cases and 3,799 deaths have been reported, CFR 48.1%. Ituri remains epicenter, accounting for 76.5% of confirmed cases and 44.3% of new cases. No new health zones were affected in the last 24 hours; 63 of 167 health zones (37.7%) across 7 provinces have been affected. Affected zones: Ituri 28/36, North Kivu 16/34, Haut-Uélé 7/13, Tshopo 7/23, Bas-Uélé 3/11, South Kivu 1/34, South Ubangi 1/16.
