triage.triage_reason: DRCで大規模なエボラ流行が継続しており（累計7,890症例、CFR48.1%）、公衆衛生への深刻な影響、国際拡大リスク、渡航・貿易制限のリスクなどIHR基準を複数満たすためフルRRAが必要。
triage.notes: 継続中の大規模エボラ流行。7州63/167保健地区に拡大、CFR48.1%と極めて高い致死率。既存の対応枠組みがあるが規模拡大が継続しており継続的なモニタリングとフルリスク評価が必要。

article.articleHeadline: Shahjahnpur News: दो दिन में मलेरिया के दो और डेंगू के भी दो मरीज मिले
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Shahjahnpur News: In two days, two more malaria patients and two dengue patients were detected.
article.articleSummary: Two days of surveillance in Shahjahnpur district detected four new vector-borne cases: malaria (2) and dengue (2). At the Medical College, fever patients were tested, with two malaria and two dengue confirmations. Dengue patients originated from Bhavalkheda and Jaitpur areas. In the backdrop, viral fever cases persist, prompting intensified monitoring. After rainfall, waterlogging and mosquito breeding have raised concerns for malaria and dengue, leading the district malaria officer, Dr. Rajiv Kumar, to expand investigations and launch village spraying campaigns. Authorities advise ensuring no standing water around homes; if water accumulates in coolers, pots, tires, or roofs, treat it with oil to curb breeding. Patients are urged to seek prompt medical care for malaria and dengue, with continued fever screening at healthcare facilities. As of 25 September 2026, vigilance remains high.

triage.headline_ja: Shahjahnpurニュース：2日間でマラリア患者2人、デング熱患者2人が新たに確認
triage.triage_reason: 地方都市における少数の季節性マラリア・デング熱症例の増加であり、通常の公衆衛生対応の範囲内で国際的懸念や異常性は認められない。
triage.notes: 季節性の雨季後の蚊媒介感染症増加であり、地元当局（マラリア担当官）による通常の対応（噴霧・啓発）が行われている。症例数は少数（各2例）で重篤性の記載なし。

article.articleHeadline: Fat Thieves: How Leishmania infantum Rewires Host Cell Lipids to Fuel
article.articleSummary: Leishmania infantum drives visceral leishmaniasis, a fatal infection of the spleen, liver and bone marrow if untreated, transmitted by sandflies. In a Parasites & Vectors study led by Cínthia Siess-Portugal and Hiro Goto at the Universidade de São Paulo with collaborators in Peru, researchers used untargeted lipidomics on infected human THP-1 macrophages to map lipid remodeling as amastigotes proliferate inside phagolysosomes. They found substantial transfer of host lipids to the parasite, with exogenous fatty acids remodeled into polyunsaturated species, indicating parasite synthesis rather than mere scavenging. Infected macrophages show depletion of mitochondrial lipids, including cardiolipin, and loss of glycosphingolipids, potentially impairing energy production and immune signaling. A biphasic response emerges: early lipid supply supports amastigote biomass; later lipids accumulate as storage for post-proliferation survival. Distinct parasite sterols (ergosterol) mark parasite-specific lipid remodeling.

triage.headline_ja: 脂肪泥棒：リアシュマニア・インファンタムはいかにして宿主細胞の脂質を再配線し感染を促進するか
triage.triage_reason: 本記事はリーシュマニア原虫の脂質代謝メカニズムに関する基礎研究論文であり、実際の症例発生・アウトブレイク情報は含まれていないため、公衆衛生上のシグナルには該当しない。
triage.notes: 本記事はサンパウロ大学とペルーの研究者による基礎研究（細胞レベルでの脂質代謝メカニズム解明）であり、実際の感染症発生・流行報告ではない。地域情報（São Paulo, Peru, Brazil）は研究実施機関の所在地を示すものであり、感染症イベントの発生地ではないため、verified_locationsは空とした。

article.articleHeadline: A Prefeitura de Guaratinguetá, por meio da Secretaria Municipal de Saúde, realizará neste sábado, (26), das 8h às 15h, uma ação de imunização no modelo casa a casa, nas áreas rurais atendidas pela ESF Rocinha com vacinas contra a febre amarela, sarampo e influenza.
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: The Guaratinguetá City Hall, through the Municipal Health Department, will this Saturday, the 26th, from 8 a.m. to 3 p.m., hold a house-to-house immunization campaign in the rural areas served by Rocinha ESF with vaccines against yellow fever, measles, and influenza.
article.articleSummary: Guaratinguetá's Municipal Health Department will conduct a house-to-house immunization campaign on Saturday, September 26, 2026, from 8:00 a.m. to 3:00 p.m., in rural areas served by Rocinha ESF. Vaccines offered include yellow fever, measles, and influenza. The operation will reach residents in Estrada do Rincão, Rodovia João Martins Corrêa, Fogueteiro de Cima, Pedra Branca, and Goiabal, bringing vaccination services directly to homes. Health teams will educate the public on the importance of keeping the vaccination card up to date. The campaign responds to reported cases in nearby municipalities and aims to expand access to immunization in rural communities, reinforcing prevention and care. Residents are encouraged to welcome the health teams and ensure their vaccinations are current.

triage.headline_ja: グアラチングエタ市役所、保健局を通じて今週土曜（26日）8時〜15時に黄熱・麻疹・インフルエンザワクチンの戸別訪問接種キャンペーンを実施
triage.triage_reason: これは通常の予防接種キャンペーンの告知であり、大規模な感染症アウトブレイクの報告ではない。近隣自治体での症例報告に対応した予防的措置であり、緊急性や異常性は認められない。
triage.notes: 記事は予防接種キャンペーンの告知であり、感染症の発生や流行そのものを報告するものではない。「近隣自治体での症例報告」への対応との記載があるが、具体的な症例数や規模は不明。

article.articleHeadline: Nord-Kivu : les carcasses d'hippopotames de la Semuliki ravivent la crainte de l'anthrax
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: North Kivu: Semuliki hippo carcasses rekindle fears of anthrax.
article.articleSummary: Hippo mortalities along the Semuliki River in North Kivu near Virunga National Park trigger heightened concern for anthrax. As of 25 September 2026, several dead hippos have been found in Semuliki; the cause remains unestablished. The Institut Congolais pour la Conservation de la Nature (ICCN) with health authorities urges residents to avoid touching or consuming carcasses, not to move or dispose of remains, and to keep children and livestock away from affected areas; use safe water and report mortalities to veterinary authorities. Previous outbreaks in 2025 linked to Bacillus anthracis killed dozens of wildlife—52 hippos and seven buffaloes around Lake Edward and the Ishasha River—confirmed by analyses. The WHO notes anthrax is a zoonosis with potential human cases in Nord-Kivu in 2025; a confirmed hippo case was reported in August 2026 at Vitshumbi on Lake Edward. Lab results will determine the cause.

triage.headline_ja: 北キブ州：セムリキ川のカバの死骸が炭疽菌への懸念を再燃させる
triage.triage_reason: 野生動物（カバ）の炭疽疑い死が継続しているが、原因は未確定でヒト症例は確認されていない。過去に同地域でヒト感染歴があり人獣共通感染症としてのリスクがあるため、続報を注視する。
triage.notes: 現時点では野生動物（カバ）の死骸の原因は検査待ちで未確定。2025年に同地域でヒト感染例があったとWHOが指摘しており、ヒト-動物感染境界での再燃リスクとして監視継続が妥当。

article.articleHeadline: Mpox case confirmed in northeastern Congolese city at center of Ebola outbreak
article.articleSummary: Mpox case confirmed in Bunia, a northeastern Congolese city at the center of an Ebola outbreak. A 21-year-old woman was admitted on 24 September 2026 with body lesions consistent with mpox and tested positive on 25 September 2026. A second woman, 32, is a suspected mpox case awaiting laboratory results; both are isolated and under care by a dedicated medical team. Investigations are under way to trace contacts and identify the infection source. Five suspected mpox cases in Bunia are under investigation, and officials report a broader uptick in mpox cases across several parts of the country over the past month. Congo had declared an end to mpox as a national public health emergency in April after a three-year outbreak with more than 34,000 confirmed cases, but authorities cautioned the virus could resurge. The Ebola outbreak’s impact on the health system is complicating monitoring.

triage.headline_ja: エボラ流行の中心地である北東部コンゴの都市でMpox感染確認
triage.triage_reason: エボラ流行の中心地であるブニアでMpoxの再燃が確認され、全国的にも症例増加が報告されている。医療システムがエボラ対応で既に負荷を受けている中での複合的な公衆衛生危機であり、フルリスク評価が必要。
triage.notes: DRCは2026年4月にMpoxの国家公衆衛生緊急事態終了を宣言していたが、当局はウイルス再燃の可能性を警告していた。エボラ流行地と同一都市での発生であり、医療システムの監視能力低下が懸念される。国際的拡大リスクや渡航制限の有無については記事内に情報がなく不明。

article.articleHeadline: Surto de Ebola no Congo se espalha para duas novas zonas de saúde, diz OMS - Saúde e Bem-estar | Portal do Holanda
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Ebola outbreak in the Congo spreads to two new health zones, says WHO - Health and Wellness | Netherlands Portal
article.articleSummary: Democratic Republic of Congo reports continued Ebola outbreak caused by Bundibugy o ebolavirus, with two new health zones—Bulu in Sud Ubangi and Dungu in Haut-Uele—raising the total affected zones to 63 across seven provinces and heightening cross-border transmission risk near South Sudan. As of Sept 23, 2026, the country recorded 7,890 laboratory-confirmed cases and 3,799 deaths. WHO Director-General Tedros Adhanom Ghebreyesus cited conflict and population displacement as barriers to health access, complicating contact tracing, safe burials, and case finding, while crowding and displacement may boost transmission. Overall cases are waning, with improvements in tracing, burials, and community engagement, though transmission remains uneven. The Bundibugyo strain lacks approved vaccines or treatments, prompting accelerated clinical trials. Tedros urged strengthened pandemic preparedness; the WHO notes misinformation about the Pandemic Accord approved by the World Health Assembly in May 2025.

triage.headline_ja: コンゴのエボラ流行、2つの新たな保健地域に拡大 ― WHO発表
triage.triage_reason: DRCでのエボラ流行が63保健地域・7province に拡大し、7,890症例・3,799死亡と大規模化。承認ワクチン無き株による越境リスク（南スーダン近接）もありIHR基準・WPRO基準を複数満たすためフルRRAへ移行すべき。
triage.notes: 記事はブラジルのポルトガル語メディアだが、内容はDRC国内のエボラ流行に関するもの。South Sudanは対象国リストに含まれないため verified_locations には含めない。ワクチン未承認のBundibugyo株であり治療・臨床試験の進展を要監視。

article.articleHeadline: 42 dengue patients identified, larvae found in 43 containers in Ludhiana - The Tribune
article.articleSummary: In Ludhiana, 42 dengue patients were identified and larvae found in 43 containers as the district Health Department inspected over 21,000 containers across more than 12,000 houses to curb dengue and other vector-borne diseases. Under the 'Har Shukarvaar, Dengue Te Vaar' initiative, teams surveyed 414 areas, visited 12,682 households and inspected 21,981 containers, including rooftop water tanks, air coolers, flower pot trays and refrigerator drip trays. Special anti-larval teams carried out extensive urban and rural inspections to eliminate mosquito-breeding sites before seasonal transmission. Breeding sites were treated with larvicidal measures and removal of stagnant water. After identifying dengue patients, fever surveillance and intensified vector-control activities were launched in the affected areas. Civil Surgeon Dr Ramandeep Kaur urged residents to participate, stressing that Aedes aegypti can breed in small quantities of standing water and that cooperation is essential.

triage.headline_ja: ルディヤーナーでデング熱患者42人を確認、43個の容器から幼虫を発見
triage.triage_reason: インドの一地域における季節性デング熱の通常の発生・対策活動であり、異常性や重大な公衆衛生上の脅威、社会的関心の高まりを示す情報がない。
triage.notes: デング熱はインドで毎年季節的に発生する疾患であり、本記事は地方保健当局によるルーティンの媒介蚊対策・サーベイランス活動を報じたもの。重症例や死亡、異常な流行規模についての記載はない。

article.articleHeadline: Silk Hydrogels Armored with Silver-Laced Titanium Nanofibers Fight Bacteria
article.articleSummary: Silk fibroin hydrogels decorated with silver-loaded titanium dioxide nanofibers from University of Kashmir demonstrate potent antibacterial activity against Escherichia coli and Staphylococcus aureus, while supporting mouse embryonic fibroblast viability. In a Polymer Bulletin report (published 2026-09-25), the fabrication combines sol-gel electrospinning to embed Ag within TiO2 nanofibers, surfactant-triggered gelation with SDS to yield beta-sheet-rich silk hydrogel quickly; optimal gelation at 0.1 M SDS (20-30 minutes); higher SDS (0.12-0.5 M) slows gelation due to micellar repulsion. Nanofibers are deposited onto the hydrogel via ultrasonication, preserving porosity essential for nutrient diffusion. XRD confirms crystalline TiO2 and silver; FTIR shows beta-sheet silk with no adverse interactions. Compressive strength increases with nanofiber decoration, and coating durability tested in PBS suggests stable integration, indicating potential for wound dressings that resist infection without compromising biocompatibility.

triage.headline_ja: 銀含有酸化チタンナノファイバーで補強したシルクヒドロゲルが細菌に対抗
triage.triage_reason: 本記事は創傷被覆材料の材料科学研究であり、実際の感染症アウトブレイクや公衆衛生イベントを報告するものではない。
triage.notes: 研究は大学（University of Kashmir）による材料科学論文であり、疾病発生地域の情報ではない。E. coliは実験対象菌として言及されているのみ。

article.articleHeadline: Kasus ISPA di Lamongan Meningkat, Jumlah Pasien Capai 2.549 Orang
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Acute Respiratory Infection (ARI) Cases in Lamongan Increase; The Number of Patients Reaches 2,549.
article.articleSummary: Acute Respiratory Infection (ARI) cases in Lamongan, East Java, rose to 2,549 in week 36, up from 2,319 in week 35, according to the Lamongan Health Office (Dinas Kesehatan). Earlier weeks showed a dip: 2,218 (week 31), 2,071 (week 32), 1,970 (week 33), and 2,095 (week 34). The upward trend in week 35–36 follows prolonged dry season and dust exposure, according to health officials. Most complaints remain ARI, and patients receiving care in facilities are still categorized as general (not pneumonia), with no progression to pneumonia observed. Influenza is not reported to advance to a lower respiratory disease. Over the past two weeks ARI cases have been reported across several areas within Lamongan. Data are sourced from health facilities in the district.

triage.headline_ja: ラモンガンでARI（急性呼吸器感染症）症例が増加、患者数2,549人に到達
triage.triage_reason: 季節性の乾燥・埃曝露による一般的なARI増加であり、肺炎への進行や重症化は見られず、公衆衛生上の深刻な影響や異常性は認められない。
triage.notes: 地元保健当局による定例的な症例報告であり、乾季による粉塵曝露が原因とされ、肺炎への進行はないと明記されている。国際的関心や政府の高い注目も見られない。

article.articleHeadline: Ebola cases rise as outbreak expands to 63 health zones in DR Congo: WHO
article.articleSummary: Bundibugyo Ebola virus disease outbreak in the Democratic Republic of the Congo has expanded to 63 health zones across seven of the country’s 26 provinces, with 7,890 confirmed cases and 3,799 deaths (crude CFR 48.1%). Newly affected areas are Bulu health zone in Sud Ubangi and Dungu in Haut-Uélé near South Sudan, raising cross-border transmission risk. The outbreak affects Bas-Uélé, Haut-Uélé, Ituri, North Kivu, South Kivu, Sud Ubangi and Tshopo provinces; transmission levels vary by region but remain high nationally. Delays in diagnosis and limited access to adequate treatment could drive preventable deaths and sustain transmission within households, communities, and healthcare facilities. Situation update notes data as of 23 September. This context comes from WHO, published 2026-09-25.

triage.headline_ja: エボラ出血熱の症例が増加、DRコンゴでの流行が63の保健区域に拡大：WHO
triage.triage_reason: 致死率48.1%の大規模エボラ流行が7州63保健区域に拡大し、南スーダン国境付近にも波及するなど国際的拡大リスクが高く、IHR基準を複数満たす。
triage.notes: 南スーダン国境付近のDungu(Haut-Uélé)への拡大が記載されているが、南スーダン自体での症例は明記されていないため、DRCのみをverified_locationsに含めた。

article.articleHeadline: DR Congo's Ebola outbreak spreads to two new health zones, WHO says
article.articleSummary: DR Congo’s Ebola outbreak, caused by the Bundibugyo strain, has expanded to two health zones—Bulu, South Ubangi near the Central African Republic border, and Dungu, Haut-Uele near South Sudan—bringing affected zones to 63 across seven provinces. As of Sept 23, 2026, the country has 7,890 confirmed cases and 3,799 deaths. Conflict and displacement hinder access and contact tracing, complicating containment. The Bundibugyo strain has no approved vaccines; WHO is accelerating vaccine and treatment trials. Africa CDC notes about 420,000 contacts should exist for 7,000+ confirmed cases, but only around 30,000 are on the contact list. Ituri remains the epicenter with 6,032 cases since May, including 868 new in 21 days; North Kivu reports 1,480 new cases (567 in 21 days), roughly a third of recent cases and deaths, and nearly 60% case fatality there. Community reluctance to seek care and early symptoms mimicking malaria or typhoid hinder response.

triage.headline_ja: コンゴ民主共和国のエボラ出血熱、新たに2つの保健地域に拡大とWHOが発表
triage.triage_reason: DRCで進行中の大規模エボラ流行（7,890症例、3,799死亡、致死率高、承認ワクチンなし）が新たな保健地域に拡大しており、IHR基準・WPRO基準ともに複数該当するためフルRRAが必要。
triage.notes: 中央アフリカ共和国・南スーダン国境付近への拡大が言及されているが、両国は対象国リストに含まれないためverified_locationsから除外。コンタクトトレーシングの不備（想定42万人中約3万人のみ登録）や紛争による対応困難が指摘されており、状況は悪化傾向。

article.articleHeadline: Ministerio de Salud invoca a padres a vacunar a sus hijos contra el sarampión
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Ministry of Health calls on parents to vaccinate their children against measles.
article.articleSummary: Measles vaccination drive in Peru: The Ministry of Health (MINSA) urges parents to vaccinate children against measles. The measles, mumps and rubella (SPR) vaccine is free and part of the National Immunization Schedule; the first dose is given at 12 months and the second at 18 months, with protection exceeding 99%. Amid an outbreak, vaccination is offered to people from 6 months to 29 years in active-transmission zones; in places with a reported case and known source, vaccinations extend to 59-year-olds within 12 surrounding blocks. Director César Munayco emphasizes vaccinating before cases appear. The response includes efforts to close gaps, with 6- to 10-year-olds lacking any doses eligible. In Loreto, 19 vaccination brigades and 4 integrated care brigades are deployed to Alto Monte, Mariscal Ramón Castilla, immunizing about 23,000 people. Nationwide, 1,239,601 doses have been administered since April; stockpiles exceed 2 million doses. Plans will extend to Iquitos, Yurimaguas, Punchana, Belén, San Juan, Caballococha, Datem del Marañón, Santa Rosa, San Pablo and Mazán.

triage.headline_ja: 保健省、親に対し子どもの麻疹予防接種を呼びかけ
triage.triage_reason: ペルー（Loreto地域）における麻疹アウトブレイク対応の予防接種キャンペーン記事だが、ペルーは対象国リストに含まれず、フィリピン等の対象国は主題ではないため、対象国としてのシグナルは該当しない。
triage.notes: 記事の主題はペルー（Loreto地方等）における麻疹アウトブレイクへの予防接種対応。発生地域にフィリピン（Calabarzon等）が含まれるが、記事本文では言及がなく主題ではないため除外。対象国（GeoNames指定11か国）はいずれも該当しないため verified_locations は空配列。

article.articleHeadline: Vigilância Ambiental ministra palestra sobre Wolbachia em Universidade
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Environmental Surveillance gives a talk on Wolbachia at the University.
article.articleSummary: Environmental Surveillance of Rio Preto presented on Sep 24 during Unirp’s Biological Sciences Week, with a talk on Wolbachia as a strategy to combat arboviruses by reducing Aedes aegypti transmission. Forty-two students, organizers, and faculty attended; the speaker emphasized how academic activities disseminate technical information and showcase health surveillance actions. In August, Environmental Surveillance also participated in UNIP with about 80 attendees, discussing arboviruses and Wolbachia-focused control methods. On Sep 26, the team will join ConstruSer 2026 at SESI Rio Preto to educate construction workers and families on dengue vector prevention and other public health vectors. The initiative promotes health education and public‑private collaboration and aligns with SDGs 3, 16, and 17.

triage.headline_ja: 環境監視局、大学でウォルバキアに関する講演を実施
triage.triage_reason: デング熱の実際の症例発生報告ではなく、ウォルバキアを用いた蚊媒介対策に関する教育講演の紹介記事であり、公衆衛生上の緊急性や異常事態を示す情報がない。
triage.notes: 記事は具体的なデング熱症例やアウトブレイクを報じておらず、大学での啓発講演・地域保健活動の紹介に過ぎないため、対象国リストに該当する感染症イベントとしては扱わない。

article.articleHeadline: Sesau realiza treinamento de profissionais da Atenção Básica sobre diagnóstico e tratamento da tuberculose | Roraima em Foco
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Sesau trains primary health care professionals on the diagnosis and treatment of tuberculosis | Roraima in Focus
article.articleSummary: Roraima, Brazil: The Sesau (Health Secretariat) conducted a week-long training for physicians and nurses in Boa Vista’s Primary Health Care to update tuberculosis diagnosis, treatment, notification, and patient follow-up, aiming for earlier case detection and prevention. Topics cover suspected case identification, clinical management, HIV co-infection considerations, treatment, and latent TB infection management. In 2025, Roraima registered 480 new TB cases; by early September 2026, 333 new cases and 9 TB-related deaths were recorded. Infectious disease specialist Nayara Mello stressed standardizing practices across teams amid high incidence and incorporating recently added diagnostic approaches. Dr. Mussadiq Hussain highlighted the ongoing diagnostic advances and the training’s importance for both primary and secondary care to improve outcomes and prevent progression from latent infection to active TB.

triage.headline_ja: セザウ、結核の診断・治療に関する基礎医療専門家研修を実施 | Roraima em Foco
triage.triage_reason: 医療従事者向けの結核診断・治療研修に関する内容であり、突発的な流行や異常事態ではなく、通常の保健医療活動の一環と判断される。
triage.notes: 結核は既知の地域流行病であり、本記事は研修活動の報告。2025年480件、2026年9月時点で333件・死亡9件と高い罹患率が継続している点は留意すべきだが、緊急性を示す新規事象ではない。

article.articleHeadline: Sarampión en Loreto: reportan primer fallecido y casos confirmados superan los 40
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Measles in Loreto: first death reported and confirmed cases exceed 40.
article.articleSummary: As of 25 September 2026, Loreto regional health authorities report the first measles death in an outbreak now exceeding 40 confirmed cases, centered in San Pablo district, Mariscal Ramón Castilla province, Peru. The deceased is a 16-year-old who developed measles followed by severe pneumonia. Another patient evacuated from San Pablo remains in intensive care with a probable measles-associated encephalitis. Measles is extremely contagious and typically begins with cold-like symptoms before the characteristic rash. The outbreak is exacerbated by historically low vaccination coverage in the Amazon, along with malnutrition and anemia in indigenous and rural communities, leaving children highly vulnerable. Officials propose a three-to-five-year integrated program to ensure transport logistics, cold-chain maintenance, sustained funding, and intercultural vaccination strategies to close long-standing gaps in immunization among native populations.

triage.headline_ja: ロレト州の麻疹：初の死亡例を報告、確定症例は40人を超える

triage.notes: 記事の主題はペルー・ロレト州における麻疹アウトブレイクであり、対象国リストに含まれる国（フィリピン等）は発生地域として誤って付与されている可能性が高い。ペルーは対象国リストに含まれないためverified_locationsは空配列とした。

article.articleHeadline: Hepatitis B Deaths Keep Rising in the Western Pacific Even as New
article.articleSummary: Hepatitis B deaths continue rising in the WHO Western Pacific Region even as new chronic infections fall, per a Lancet Regional Health Western Pacific analysis of 2015–2024 Polaris Observatory data across 34 countries and areas. In 19 of 34, chronic HBV incidence declined while HBV-related mortality rose; only Japan and New Zealand saw declines in both. Mortality increased in 31 of 34 areas, with the Marshall Islands the sharpest rise (6.44%/yr) and Tonga and Cambodia each 3.97%. HBV mortality rose from 22.88 to 24.70 per 100,000, about 436,363 to 484,055 deaths annually. Prevalence fell from 5.28% to 4.58%; under‑five prevalence dropped in China (0.08%), Korea (0.03%), Japan (0.01%), Australia (0.06%), New Zealand (0.02%), but Papua New Guinea rose to 2.38%. Birth‑dose vaccination hovered near 80% regionally (Tuvalu 99.65% to PNG 26.20%); three‑dose coverage mostly above 90%. The 2030 targets call for a 90% reduction in new infections and 65% reduction in deaths. Authors caution mortality trends may reflect infections acquired long before recent vaccination gains and limits of ecological inference.

triage.headline_ja: 西太平洋地域でB型肝炎による死亡が増加し続ける、新規感染は減少傾向にもかかわらず
triage.triage_reason: 10年間の疫学統計分析記事であり、急性の公衆衛生イベントではない。IHR基準・WPRO基準のいずれにも該当せず、社会的関心の高まりも確認できない。
triage.notes: 本記事はLancet Regional Health Western Pacific誌に掲載された2015-2024年のPolaris Observatoryデータに基づく地域横断的な疫学統計分析であり、特定国での急性感染症アウトブレイクではない。中国・日本等34か国・地域のデータが含まれるが、いずれも統計値として言及されているのみで、単一国の発生イベントとしての特定はできないため verified_locations は空とした。

article.articleHeadline: Influenza A Ada Sepanjang Tahun, Dokter Ungkap Bedanya dengan Flu Biasa
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Influenza A Is Year-Round, Doctors Reveal How It Differs From Regular Flu.
article.articleSummary: Influenza A remains year-round in Indonesia, with Surabaya and East Java reporting a recent rise in cases as more people are tested. Dr. Dominicus Husada, SpA(K), of RSUD Dr Soetomo, Surabaya, says the virus has circulated continuously and the uptick reflects increased testing, not a new outbreak. In Indonesia, influenza patterns differ from four-season countries where winter peaks are typical; in Indonesia, activity persists year-round with spikes when many people seek care for coughs and colds. Globally, influenza has attracted ongoing attention due to historical pandemics; in the United States last year, influenza cases exceeded 600, predominantly among children. Distinguishing influenza from common cold requires laboratory confirmation, as early symptoms can resemble a cold. Influenza viruses include A, B, C, and D; A and B cause more significant illness, with A carrying the greatest pandemic potential, while C is milder and D occurs in animals.

triage.headline_ja: インフルエンザAは年間を通じて発生、医師が通常のインフルエンザとの違いを解説
triage.triage_reason: 通常の季節性インフルエンザに関する啓発記事であり、新規アウトブレイクではなく検査数増加による症例増加と医師が説明している。異常性や公衆衛生上の深刻な影響は認められない。
triage.notes: 医師によるインフルエンザAに関する一般啓発記事で、新規のアウトブレイクや異常事態を示すものではない。

article.articleHeadline: 九旬翁本地感染大鼠戊型肝炎 何文田廣場食肆現鼠跡遭食環署檢控 - 星島日報
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Nonagenarian locally infected with rat-borne hepatitis E; Ho Man Tin Plaza restaurant found with rodent traces, charged by FEHD - Sing Tao Daily.
article.articleSummary: Third local case of rat-borne hepatitis E in Hong Kong this year. A 91-year-old male resident of a Kowloon City elderly care home developed fever and limb weakness on 16 September and was admitted to Queen Elizabeth Hospital; laboratory tests confirmed rat Hepatitis E. He recovered and was discharged on 21 September. He had no travel during the incubation period and no direct contact with rodents, with no rodent sightings at the elderly home. During the incubation period he frequently dined with family at a restaurant in Ho Man Tin Plaza, where hygiene was found to be poor and rodent traces were observed. FEHD filed charges against the establishment under the Food Business Regulation and issued a pest-control/rodent-elimination notice under the Public Health and Municipal Services Ordinance; further cleaning and pest-control will be conducted near areas the patient visited. Family and staff remain asymptomatic, under medical surveillance.

triage.headline_ja: 90代男性がネズミ由来E型肝炎に地域感染、何文田広場の飲食店にネズミの痕跡確認、食環署が起訴 - 星島日報
triage.triage_reason: 香港で今年3例目のネズミ由来E型肝炎の地域感染事例だが、患者は回復・退院しており、ヒト-ヒト感染の証拠もない単発の食品衛生関連事案であるため、フルRRAには至らないが継続監視の対象とする。
triage.notes: 本事例は香港（中国特別行政区）内の単発症例で、ネズミ由来HEVはヒト-ヒト感染しないとされる。食環署（FEHD）が飲食店を起訴し、害虫駆除命令を発出済み。今年3例目という点で継続的な環境曝露リスクがあるため経過観察が妥当。

article.articleHeadline: Flu or typhoid? AIIMS-Delhi cautions people against misreading fever tests, self-medication - The Tribune
article.articleSummary: Delhi records a seasonal rise in influenza and upper respiratory infections during the post-monsoon period, with fever, cough and runny nose; AIIMS-Delhi physician Dr. Naval says there is no evidence of a new influenza variant and that influenza can be more severe in extremes of age or those with asthma, COPD, diabetes, heart disease, cancer or cancer treatment. Caution: patients with prolonged fever are being tested for typhoid with antibody-based tests (TyphiDot) which can cross-react; a positive antibody test does not confirm typhoid, and even Widal has limitations; blood culture remains the more specific test. Clinicians warn against self-starting antibiotics for viral infections; antibiotics offer no benefit in such cases and may drive resistance; they may be used for suspected secondary bacterial infection only under physician supervision. Persistent cough after influenza can reflect post-infectious airway hyperreactivity; persistent fever requires clinical assessment to rule out other infections. Emphasis is on accurate diagnosis rather than a misconception of a "chest infection turning into typhoid".

triage.headline_ja: インフルエンザか腸チフスか？AIIMS-デリー、発熱検査の誤読と自己判断による服薬に注意喚起
triage.triage_reason: 季節性のインフルエンザ増加についての注意喚起記事であり、新型変異株や異常な流行は確認されておらず、公衆衛生上の重大な懸念や社会的関心の高まりも認められない。
triage.notes: 記事は季節性インフルエンザと腸チフスの診断上の混同（検査の交差反応）に関する医療啓発記事であり、新規株や異常な流行拡大の証拠はないと明記されている。

article.articleHeadline: Không chủ quan, lơ là với dịch bệnh
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Don't be complacent about disease outbreaks.
article.articleSummary: Emergency Ebola vaccine trial underway in the Democratic Republic of the Congo (DRC). WHO has allocated 20,000 Ervebo doses for a trial in Ituri, the epicenter of the Bundibugyo outbreak. About 20,000 participants—primarily healthcare workers and other frontline staff in Ituri—will be followed for one year to assess Ervebo’s effectiveness against Bundibugyo. If successful, vaccination could expand to Ituri and North Kivu, reaching roughly 50,000 frontline workers. Ervebo targets Ebola virus (Zaire ebolavirus); its effectiveness against Bundibugyo remains unconfirmed, though early animal data hint at some protection. A total of 70,000 doses have been delivered to support response and research. Since May, the outbreak has surpassed 7,500 cases and 3,639 deaths, with 1,823 recoveries. MSF warns there is no clear evidence the outbreak is contained; child mortality under five exceeds 60%, while the virus has spread to a seventh province; ten districts report no new cases in 21 days.

triage.headline_ja: 感染症流行に対して油断・軽視は禁物
triage.triage_reason: コンゴ民主共和国でBundibugyo種エボラの大規模流行が継続し、7,500例超・死者3,639人、7州へ拡大、緊急ワクチン治験が実施されるなど公衆衛生上の深刻な影響と国際的懸念が認められる。
triage.notes: Bundibugyo種エボラウイルスに対するErvebo（本来Zaire種対応）ワクチンの緊急治験がイトゥリ州で開始。5歳未満の致死率60%超、10地区で21日間新規症例なしとの情報もあり、状況は流動的。続報でのフルリスク評価が必要。

article.articleHeadline: तेजी से फेल रहा डेंगू, आप भी जरूर जान लें लक्षण व बचाव
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Dengue fever is spreading rapidly; you should also know the symptoms and prevention.
article.articleSummary: As of 26 September 2026, dengue fever is spreading rapidly across several Indian states, with Delhi reporting a concerning rise in cases. Dengue is transmitted by Aedes mosquitoes after biting an infected person; it does not spread person-to-person. Four dengue virus serotypes (DEN-1 to DEN-4) mean a person can be infected by different strains over time. Mosquitoes bite most during midday—about two hours after sunrise and one hour before sunset—and can bite at night in indoor areas with artificial lighting, increasing risk in offices, malls, indoor auditoriums, and stadiums. Symptoms typically appear 4–6 days after infection and last about 10 days: sudden high fever, severe headache, pain behind the eyes, joint and muscle pains, fatigue, nausea, vomiting, red rash, and mild bleeding. Prevention focuses on daytime protection (long sleeves, skin coverage, footwear), eliminating standing water around homes, and using mosquito nets at night.

triage.headline_ja: デング熱が急速に拡大中、症状と予防法を知っておくべき
triage.triage_reason: インドで季節的に見られるデング熱の増加を報じる啓発記事であり、症状・予防法の解説が主目的。異常性や重篤性を示す具体的データがなく、IHR基準・WPRO基準ともに該当しない。
triage.notes: デング熱はインドで毎年季節的に流行する感染症であり、本記事は具体的な症例数や死亡者数のデータを伴わない一般向けの症状・予防啓発記事。ヒト-ヒト感染がなく、媒介蚊対策で管理可能なため、シグナルとしての優先度は低い。

article.articleHeadline: RIPK2 Inhibitor GSK583 Curbss H1N1 Flu Replication and Tames Lung
article.articleSummary: Influenza A/H1N1 PR8 (A/Puerto Rico/8/1934) replication was curtailed by RIPK2 inhibitor GSK583 in vitro and in a mouse infection model conducted by teams at the University of Science and Technology of China and Huazhong University of Science and Technology. In cell culture, GSK583 reduced viral RNA and viral protein, and supernatants yielded far fewer plaque-forming units, indicating suppression of virion release rather than direct inactivation or receptor-blocking. Time-of-addition experiments showed activity only after adsorption, consistent with post-entry effects or host signaling. In mice treated early after infection, disease severity was alleviated, pulmonary viral RNA and nucleoprotein were reduced, and lung inflammation declined, signaling lower replication and tissue damage. Mechanistically, the RIPK2–MKK7–JNK axis underlies the effect: RIPK2–MKK7 interaction and JNK phosphorylation tracked with replication, and genetic or pharmacologic disruption of this axis corroborated the findings. This host-directed approach could broaden influenza therapeutics and reduce severe lung injury.

triage.headline_ja: RIPK2阻害剤GSK583がH1N1インフルエンザの複製を抑制し、マウス実験で肺の炎症を緩和

article.articleHeadline: Mycoplasma Leads Pediatric Respiratory Infections in Post-COVID China,
article.articleSummary: In Ningbo, Zhejiang Province, China, a retrospective analysis of 34,404 pediatric patients with respiratory symptoms (Jan 2023–Dec 2024) found Mycoplasma pneumoniae as the leading positive pathogen at 26.94%, making it the top cause of pediatric respiratory infections. Throat swabs were tested with multiplex PCR for 13 viral and atypical bacterial pathogens, yielding an overall positivity rate of 69.14%. Rhinovirus was second (16.29%), adenovirus third (9.00%). Coinfections occurred in 19.85% of positive samples, with dual infections most common. Seasonal variation was evident over the two-year period, highlighting rebound patterns after COVID-19 restrictions eased. Mycoplasma pneumoniae, an atypical bacterium lacking a cell wall, does not respond to beta-lactams, underscoring implications for treatment decisions. Findings from the Affiliated Women and Children’s Hospital of Ningbo University and published in BMC Infectious Diseases provide an epidemiological reference for post-COVID pediatric respiratory care and testing strategies.

article.articleHeadline: Gejala Super Flu yang Dikira Covid-19, di Sumut Ada 3 Kasus
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Symptoms of Super Flu Mistaken for COVID-19 in North Sumatra: 3 Cases.
article.articleSummary: Three cases of a rapidly spreading influenza A (H3N2) subclade K, described as 'super flu,' are confirmed in North Sumatra, Indonesia, per the Ministry of Health’s Influenza and COVID-19 Case Surveillance Report through 19 September 2026 (week 37). Jawa Timur (East Java) and Kalimantan Selatan (South Kalimantan) report a higher total of 18 cases, indicating broader circulation. Health authorities emphasize that 'super flu' is not an official medical term; it denotes ISPA caused by influenza A H3N2 with mutations that may erode protection from standard vaccines and accelerate transmission. Symptoms include severe cough, sore throat, nasal congestion, muscle aches, headache, and extreme fatigue appearing 3–4 days after exposure, often mistaken for COVID-19. Contextual history cites mid-2025 activity in the UK, Japan, and the US, with New York reaching about 71,000 weekly cases at a mutation-driven peak.

triage.headline_ja: コロナと間違われる『スーパーフル』の症状、北スマトラで3例確認
triage.triage_reason: IHR基準のうち「異常性」「国際的拡大リスク」の2つに該当し、インフルエンザA(H3N2)新変異株（サブクレードK）がインドネシア複数州で拡大しワクチン効果減弱の懸念があるため、フルリスク評価への移行が妥当と判断。
triage.notes: 記事は北スマトラ、東ジャワ、南カリマンタンなどインドネシア国内の複数州での症例増加を報告。英国・日本・米国の言及は2025年中頃の過去の流行に関する背景情報であり、現行イベントの発生地とは異なるため対象国リストには含めない。「スーパーフル」は非公式な通称であり、H3N2サブクレードKによる免疫逃避変異が懸念されている。重症度や死亡例に関する具体的情報はなく、続報の確認が必要。

article.articleHeadline: La OMS afirma que el brote de ébola en el Congo se ha extendido a dos nuevas zonas sanitarias
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: WHO says the Ebola outbreak in the Democratic Republic of the Congo has spread to two new health zones.
article.articleSummary: As of 25 September 2026, the World Health Organization reports that the Ebola outbreak in the Democratic Republic of the Congo, caused by Bundibugyo ebolavirus, has expanded to two additional health zones. The total number of affected zones rises to 63 across seven provinces. The newly affected zones are Bulu in Sud-Ubangi Province and Dungu in Haut-Uele Province, with Haut-Uele bordering South Sudan. The development signals ongoing geographic spread of transmission within the DRC, reinforcing the need for sustained surveillance and cross‑provincial public health response. The report does not provide detailed counts of cases or deaths within these zones, nor information on laboratory confirmation or infection sources in this brief update.

triage.headline_ja: WHOはコンゴのエボラ出血熱の流行が2つの新しい保健区域に拡大したと発表
triage.triage_reason: エボラ出血熱の地理的拡大が続いており、国際的拡大リスク（南スーダンとの国境地域）や公衆衛生への深刻な影響が認められるため、フルリスク評価が必要。
triage.notes: 記事はDRCにおけるエボラ流行（63保健区域、7州に拡大）についてであり、Sudanは隣接国として言及されているのみで対象国リストにも含まれないため除外。症例数・死亡数の詳細は不明。

article.articleHeadline: DR Congo's Ebola Outbreak Spreads to Two New Health Zones, WHO Reports
article.articleSummary: DRC Ebola outbreak expands with 27 new cases, bringing 63 affected health zones across seven provinces. The Bundibugyo strain is confirmed in two new regions: Bulu (South Ubangi, bordering the Central African Republic) and Dungu (Haut-Uele, bordering South Sudan). Ituri remains the epicenter with 6,032 confirmed since May; North Kivu reports 1,480 new cases, including 567 in the last 21 days, about one third of recent cases and deaths. North Kivu’s case fatality approaches 60%, above the national average of 48%. Access remains hampered by conflict and population displacement, complicating case finding and contact tracing; only about 30,000 of an estimated 420,000 contacts are on the list from over 7,000 confirmed cases. The Bundibugyo strain has no approved vaccines; WHO accelerates vaccine and treatment trials and stresses rigorous contact tracing and early identification. Some patients delay seeking care, worsening outbreak control.

triage.headline_ja: コンゴ民主共和国のエボラ出血熱、新たに2つの保健区に拡大 ― WHOが報告
triage.triage_reason: IHR基準3項目該当（重大な公衆衛生影響、異常事態、国際的拡大リスク）に加え、WPRO基準も全て該当するためフルRRAへ進めるべきシグナルと判断。
triage.notes: 感染地域として中央アフリカ共和国・南スーダン国境地域が挙げられているが、これらは対象国リストに含まれないため除外。DRC国内（Ituri, North Kivu, Haut-Uele, South Ubangiなど）が主な発生地。ブンディブギョ株はワクチン未承認であり、致死率が高く、紛争・人口移動により対応が困難な状況が続いている。

article.articleHeadline: Món quà Trung thu đặc biệt cho trẻ em Việt Nam: Vắc xin tay chân miệng đã có tại VNVC, tiêm ngay cho trẻ từ 2 tháng tuổi
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: A Special Mid-Autumn Festival Gift for Vietnamese Children: The Hand, Foot and Mouth Disease Vaccine Now Available at VNVC, Vaccinate Children from 2 Months of Age.
article.articleSummary: EV71-based hand, foot, and mouth disease vaccine launched at VNVC in Vietnam, for children from 2 months to under 6 years, with a 2–3 dose schedule. Leading pediatric infectious disease expert Dr. Trương Hữu Khanh notes EV71-driven HFMD can rapidly progress to severe neurological and cardiopulmonary complications, with CNS injury most likely in the brainstem, hypothalamus, and cerebellum, and some cases turning critical within 6–8 hours. Phase III trials in Vietnam showed 96.8% protection against EV71-related HFMD, with no EV71 cases among vaccinated children and immunity across multiple EV71 genotypes. VNVC has prepared supply chains, cold chain, and trained staff to roll out protection nationwide, across nearly 300 VNVC centers. On 25 September 2026, tens of thousands registered and began vaccination, including at VNVC Cai Lậy, Tiền Giang. This Mid-Autumn Festival gift aims to shield Vietnamese children during the high season.

triage.headline_ja: ベトナムの子供たちへの特別な中秋節の贈り物：手足口病ワクチンがVNVCで登場、生後2ヶ月から接種可能に
triage.triage_reason: 本記事はEV71ワクチンの発売・接種開始という予防施策に関する報道であり、新規アウトブレイクや異常な感染拡大の報告ではない。
triage.notes: 記事はEV71ワクチンの導入・接種キャンペーンに関するもので、現行のアウトブレイクや症例急増を報告するものではないため、シグナルトリアージ対象外と判断。ただし手足口病（HFMD）流行シーズンに関する言及があり、今後の症例動向には留意が必要。

article.articleHeadline: ஆலங்காயம் பேரூராட்சியில் டெங்கு கொசு ஒழிப்பு விழிப்புணா்வு
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Dengue Mosquito Eradication Awareness Campaign in Alangayam Municipality
article.articleSummary: Dengue fever prevention campaign underway in Alangayam Special Grade Municipality, Tiruppur District, targeting 15 wards. Health officer Rajalakshmi led outreach to educate residents that Aedes mosquitoes breed in clean rainwater collected in households, shops, and public spaces. To curb breeding, residents were urged to promptly remove discarded tyres, coconut shells, broken utensils, plastic waste, and newspaper plates found around homes and shops. Water storage tanks and containers should be kept tightly closed at all times. Municipal workers conducted mosquito-control activities, including insecticide spraying, fumigation, and cleaning operations to reduce breeding sites. The intensified awareness drive aims to prevent dengue transmission in the area.

article.articleHeadline: Gut Microbe's Acetate Signal Calms Deadly Diarrhea in Newborn Calves
article.articleSummary: Published in Microbiome on 2026-09-26, Huazhong Agricultural University researchers trace a microbiota–metabolite–immune axis in neonatal calf diarrhea. Diarrheic newborn calves show gut dysbiosis, metabolic perturbation, and inflammatory activation. Fecal microbiota transplantation from healthy calves alleviates diarrhea and coincides with enrichment of Bifidobacterium pseudocatenulatum and higher fecal acetate. In vitro, live B. pseudocatenulatum increases acetate production, suggesting a causal bacterium–metabolite link. In murine models mimicking calf intestinal injury, treatment with live B. pseudocatenulatum or acetate reduces intestinal damage and pathogen-driven Th17/IL-17A responses; heat-killed bacteria lose protection, implicating microbial metabolism. Acetate signals via FFAR2, and FFAR2 blockade attenuates protection. These findings define a targetable microbiota–metabolite–immune pathway with potential probiotic or metabolite-based interventions for neonatal calf diarrhea.

triage.headline_ja: 腸内細菌のアセテートシグナルが新生子牛の致死的下痢を鎮める
triage.triage_reason: 本記事は子牛の下痢に関する基礎研究論文の紹介であり、実際の感染症アウトブレイクの報告ではないため、公衆衛生上の懸念や社会的関心は認められない。

article.articleHeadline: 65 Kasus Influenza A Terdeteksi di Bandung, Masyarakat Diminta Tak Panik
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: 65 Influenza A Cases Detected in Bandung, Public Urged Not to Panic.
article.articleSummary: As of 26 September 2026, Bandung, West Java reports 65 laboratory-confirmed Influenza A cases from swab tests. Health official Raden Vini Adiani Dewi urges calm, noting Influenza A is highly transmissible and can produce more severe symptoms than ordinary flu. Common signs include headache, high fever, body aches, and fatigue. The public should monitor for three days after onset; if symptoms persist or worsen, seek care promptly. Testing for Influenza A is not available everywhere, and whole genome sequencing is limited to select labs, including the West Java Provincial Health Laboratory. No deaths related to Influenza A have been reported in Bandung.

triage.headline_ja: バンドンでインフルエンザA型65例検出、市民にパニックを起こさないよう呼びかけ
triage.triage_reason: 季節性インフルエンザA型の通常規模の発生と考えられ、死亡例もないが、感染力の高さと検査体制の限界が指摘されており、続報を注視する必要がある。
triage.notes: インドネシア・バンドンでの季節性インフルエンザA型の局地的発生。死亡例なし、当局は冷静な対応を呼びかけている。検査能力の制限とヒト-ヒト感染のしやすさから経過観察が妥当。

article.articleHeadline: AI could expand affordable tuberculosis screening in rural Philippines
article.articleSummary: AI-assisted chest X-ray interpretation could lower TB screening costs in rural Philippines. The 2024 Philippine TB burden reached about 739,000 cases, representing 6.8% of the world’s 10.8 million TB cases. Ateneo de Manila University researchers modeled 1,000 presumptive TB patients undergoing chest radiography over five years, including AI software costs, radiologist fees, and confirmatory GeneXpert testing. The AI strategy shows an estimated annual cost of Php 877,330 versus Php 1.14 million for manual interpretation, equating to roughly Php 877 per person with AI and Php 1,142 per person manually. Beyond efficiency, AI could extend expert-level support to underserved rural communities using portable digital X-rays with limited connectivity, aiming to narrow geographic disparities. AI remains effective but not always cost-saving if radiologist fees are low or Philippine-specific performance estimates apply. The study recommends pilot implementation in underserved rural health units with local validation, QA, monitoring, and budget assessment, with continued confirmatory testing.

triage.headline_ja: AIがフィリピン農村部での安価な結核スクリーニングを拡大できる可能性
triage.triage_reason: 本記事はAIを用いた結核スクリーニングのコスト効率に関する研究報告であり、アウトブレイクや異常な公衆衛生事象を報告するものではないため、トリアージ基準に該当しない。
triage.notes: 既知の疾病負荷（結核）に関する診断技術・医療経済研究であり、感染症イベントのシグナルとしては該当しない。

article.articleHeadline: EAC seeks $45m to strengthen Ebola response
article.articleSummary: East African Community seeks about $45 million from development partners to strengthen Ebola preparedness and response and to bolster management of other high-consequence infectious diseases in the region. The funding would fund training for 500 frontline healthcare workers and community awareness programs reaching 15,000 residents in eastern Democratic Republic of Congo, according to EAC Acting Director of Social Sectors Dr Dorcas Omukhulu. The initiative aims to enhance regional readiness against Ebola and similar threats by building local capacity and broad public outreach. The funding request underscores ongoing efforts to bolster health security in eastern DRC and neighboring states, supporting frontline workers and community engagement for improved early detection and rapid response.

triage.headline_ja: 東アフリカ共同体、エボラ対応強化のため4,500万ドルの資金を要請
triage.triage_reason: エボラという高致死性疾患に関する地域的な対応強化・資金調達要請であり、東部DRCおよび周辺国への波及リスクと外部支援の必要性が示されているため、フルRRAでの精査が妥当と判断した。
triage.notes: 記事は新規アウトブレイクの報告ではなく、EACによる予防・対応能力強化のための資金調達要請に関するもの。具体的な症例数や地理的拡大状況は記載されていないため、続報で実際の疫学的状況を確認する必要がある。

article.articleHeadline: बारिश से हुए जल जमाव ने बढ़ाई परेशानी, वाराणसी में डेंगू के 47 मरीज मिले, नगर निगम को विभाग ने लिखा खत | Varanasi Dengue Cases Waterlogging Malaria Chikungunya
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Rain-induced waterlogging has worsened the problem; 47 dengue patients were detected in Varanasi; the department wrote a letter to the Municipal Corporation | Varanasi Dengue Cases Waterlogging Malaria Chikungunya
article.articleSummary: Varanasi, 26 September 2026: rain-induced waterlogging has escalated mosquito-borne disease. Dengue: 47 cases; malaria: 7; chikungunya: 4. Aedes and Anopheles larvae breed in clogged coolers, pots, old tires, buckets, and other standing water across wards. The Malaria Department has written to the Municipal Corporation urging intensified anti-larva spraying, fogging, and sanitation drives. At Pandit Deendayal Upadhyaya District Hospital's Doctors Colony, waterlogging worsens conditions for residents and health workers. The Chief Medical Officer urges residents to eliminate standing water, refresh cooler water weekly, cover containers, and remove water from tires and pot bases. Use mosquito nets and wear full-body clothing at night. Seek prompt testing for fever, joint or head pains at nearby health facilities.

triage.headline_ja: 雨による水たまりが問題を悪化させ、バラナシでデング熱患者47人確認、保健当局が市当局に対応要請
triage.triage_reason: 季節性のデング・マラリア・チクングニアの局地的増加であり、行政による通常の対応（防除・啓発）が取られている段階。国際的拡大や渡航制限のリスクは低いが、今後の症例数推移を注視する必要がある。
triage.notes: 地方紙報道による季節性感染症（雨季の水たまりに起因する蚊媒介感染症）の局地的増加。市・保健当局が対応中であり、国際的な懸念事項ではない。

article.articleHeadline: தஞ்சாவூர் அருகே வல்லம் பேரூராட்சியில் டெங்கு தடுப்பு, விழிப்புணர்வு பணிகள் குறித்து ஆய்வு
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: A study on dengue prevention and awareness activities in Vallam Town Panchayat near Thanjavur.
article.articleSummary: In Vallam Town Panchayat near Thanjavur, Tamil Nadu, dengue prevention and awareness activities were conducted under Field Officer Rajasekharan. Inspecting all wards, health authorities identified mosquito breeding risks in homes and surrounding areas and instructed residents to prevent water stagnation. With seasonal rains causing standing water in residential areas, Aedes mosquitoes can thrive even in small water collections. Residents were advised to remove discarded items likely to hold rainwater - old drums, plastic containers, tires, and coconut shells - and to cover stored drinking water and any other water containers. Regular maintenance of roof and ground-level tanks was urged, along with keeping yards and public spaces free of standing water. Authorities emphasized weekly cleanliness and educated the public on dengue prevention; fever symptoms should prompt immediate visit to government hospitals or health facilities.

triage.headline_ja: タンジャーヴール近郊ヴァッラム町パンチャーヤトにおけるデング熱予防・啓発活動の視察
triage.triage_reason: 通常のデング熱予防・啓発活動に関するルーティン報道であり、具体的な症例数増加や異常な流行を示す情報がないため。

article.articleHeadline: Fiebre aftosa: APPEC advierte sobre el riesgo económico para las exportaciones de carne
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Foot-and-mouth disease: APPEC warns about the economic risk to meat exports.
article.articleSummary: Foot-and-mouth disease (FMD), especially serotype SAT 1, is framed by Paraguay’s APPEC as an economic threat to meat exports as SAT 1 spreads beyond its historical range. The World Organisation for Animal Health (WOAH) monitors SAT 1 incursions in Africa, Europe, the Middle East and Asia, signaling risks to animal health, livelihoods, food security and international trade. Economic losses can reach about 1% of GDP in small cattle-dependent economies, with trade disruptions potentially matching or exceeding direct production losses. In Paraguay, beef exports through August 2026 totaled 186,175 tonnes worth US$1.299 billion, down 25% in volume versus 2025, while the average price rose to US$7,410/ton. Main destinations included Chile (20,609 t, US$399 million), followed by Israel, the United States, Taiwan and Brazil. APPEC calls for stronger vaccination and epidemiological surveillance; WOAH emphasizes vaccination, biosecurity, movement controls, border surveillance and early warning systems. Paraguay also pursued new markets, such as beef shipments to the UAE and veterinary audits for Turkey.

triage.headline_ja: 口蹄疫：APPECが食肉輸出への経済的リスクについて警告
triage.triage_reason: 動物疾患（口蹄疫）に関する経済的影響の記事であり、対象国での実際の発生や人への公衆衛生上の懸念は確認できないため見送りとする。
triage.notes: 記事はパラグアイの食肉輸出における経済的リスクに焦点を当てた動物疾患（口蹄疫）関連の内容。対象国リストのBrazilは輸出先として言及されているのみで、発生国ではないため verified_locations には含めない。人への感染症事例ではなく、公衆衛生上の直接的リスクは低い。

article.articleHeadline: 24 Kasus Influenza A Terdeteksi di DIY, Didominasi Subtipe H1N1 & H3N2 Tanpa Disertai Lonjakan ISPA
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: 24 Cases of Influenza A Detected in the Yogyakarta Special Region, Dominated by H1N1 and H3N2 Subtypes, Without a Surge in Acute Respiratory Infections.
article.articleSummary: 24 laboratory-confirmed Influenza A cases were detected in the Yogyakarta Special Region (DIY) through sentinel-lab surveillance up to Friday, 25 September 2026. Of these, 11 are H1N1 (pdm09) and 11 are H3N2; two cases are untyped. Common symptoms include fever, cough, and sore throat. There is no overall surge in Acute Respiratory Infections; ISPA incidence has declined in the past four weeks after a prior rise. Typing is limited to sentinel facilities; many cases from other clinics are reported as ISPA without subtype data. Public health surveillance is maintained through sentinel ILI (influenza-like illness) and SARI (severe acute respiratory infection) systems, focusing on outpatient puskesmas and hospitalized patients at referral hospitals.

triage.headline_ja: ジョグジャカルタ特別州でインフルエンザA型24例を検出、H1N1・H3N2亜型が中心もISPA(急性呼吸器感染症)の急増は伴わず
triage.triage_reason: 季節性インフルエンザA(H1N1/H3N2)の通常のサーベイランス報告であり、ISPAの急増もなく、重症化や異常事態を示す情報がない。
triage.notes: 既知の季節性インフルエンザ株(H1N1pdm09, H3N2)による通常のサーベイランス結果。ISPA発生率はむしろ過去4週間で減少傾向にあり、公衆衛生上の懸念は低い。

article.articleHeadline: Новый китайский вирус? Правда об ALTNV и симптомы инфекции
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: New Chinese Virus? The Truth About ALTNV and the Symptoms of Infection.
article.articleSummary: ALTNV is not a new pathogen; it is a tick-borne virus in the Crimean-Congo hemorrhagic fever group, identified through advanced genetic analysis in China. In Russia, there are no officially reported human cases; transmission occurs only via tick bites, specifically the Asian long-horned tick, found in the Far East (Primorsky Krai and southern Khabarovsk Krai), with European Russia unlikely to host this vector. Symptoms resemble other acute tick-borne infections: abrupt fever, chills, severe headache, myalgia, sometimes nausea or diarrhea; labs show thrombocytopenia, leukopenia, and elevated liver enzymes, with potential bleeding or petechiae in severe thrombocytopenia. The 18% mortality figure is overstated and applies only to patients with co-infections; isolated ALTNV infections are typically moderate with no deaths. No vaccine or specific therapy exists; prevention relies on repellents, light-colored closed clothing, and thorough body checks after outdoor activity. In Kuban (Krasnodar region), 2026 tick bites total 3,574 (1,365 children), down 10.5% vs 2025; Krasnodar city accounts for 683 cases (231 children); last week, 21 cases. Surveillance of ~11,000 ticks found 17.2% positive for Lyme borreliosis among 2,802 tested.

triage.headline_ja: 新しい中国のウイルス？ALTNVの真実と感染症状について
triage.triage_reason: 記事はロシア・クラスノダール地方のダニ刺傷統計と、誇張された『新型中国ウイルス』報道を訂正する解説記事であり、ロシア・中国いずれにおいても人での確認症例や深刻な公衆衛生上の懸念は報告されていない。
triage.notes: 見出しは『新型中国ウイルス』への懸念を喚起する体裁だが、記事内容はALTNV（CCHF近縁のマダニ媒介ウイルス）が既知の病原体であり、ロシアでは人での確認症例がないこと、致死率18%という数字が誇張であることを説明する啓発記事。対象国リストに含まれるRussiaは無く、Chinaは『遺伝子解析で同定された場所』としての言及のみで実際の発生事例ではないため、verified_locationsは空配列とした。

article.articleHeadline: Dịch Ebola tại CHDC Congo lan sang hai khu vực mới
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Ebola outbreak in the Democratic Republic of the Congo spreads to two new regions.
article.articleSummary: Ebola outbreak caused by Bundibugyo virus in the Democratic Republic of Congo has spread to two additional health zones, Bulu in Sud-Ubangi and Dungu in Haut-Uele, bringing the outbreak to 63 health zones across 7 provinces. As of Sept 23, 2026, Congo has 7,890 confirmed infections and 3,799 deaths. WHO warns that conflict and population displacement hinder access to affected communities and contact tracing, while the absence of vaccines and licensed treatments for Bundibugy o complicates response and may deter care-seeking. Authorities are expediting clinical trials for vaccines and treatments. The outbreak is crossing borders, with Ubangi River linking areas toward Kinshasa; monitoring is active for neighboring South Sudan, Central African Republic, and Uganda-border regions. Ten countries are deemed high risk, with preparedness efforts underway. Japan has announced urgent aid to assist Congo's Ebola response.

triage.headline_ja: コンゴ民主共和国のエボラ流行、新たに2地域に拡大
triage.triage_reason: コンゴ民主共和国でのエボラ（ブンディブギョ株）流行が63保健地域・7州に拡大し、感染者7890人・死者3799人と深刻な公衆衛生危機であり、国境を越える拡大リスクと国際支援の必要性が明確なため。
triage.notes: スーダン・中央アフリカ共和国・ウガンダは国境監視対象として言及されているが、実際の感染発生国ではないため除外。日本は支援国として言及されているのみで発生国ではない。

article.articleHeadline: Influenza A dan ISPA Merebak, Rumah Sakit di Jatim Diminta Waspada
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Influenza A and ARI Are Spreading, Hospitals in East Java Urged to Be Vigilant
article.articleSummary: Influenza A and acute respiratory infection (ARI) continue to fluctuate in East Java, Indonesia. The Jawa Timur provincial government reports declines in some facilities, notably at Kedungkandang Public Health Center in Malang City, but increases persist in other districts, keeping surveillance ongoing. Influenza is generally self-limiting, yet clinicians are advised to monitor patients closely, especially when immunity is reduced or when complications or comorbid conditions are present. Hospitals should not underestimate patients presenting with flu-like symptoms and should tailor care, including outpatient management or higher-level referrals as needed. No East Java hospital has reported being overwhelmed or turning patients away due to Influenza A to date. Authorities will continually monitor case counts and facility capacity and urge reporting of any service-delivery obstacles.

triage.headline_ja: インフルエンザAとARIが拡大、東ジャワの病院に警戒呼びかけ
triage.triage_reason: 季節性インフルエンザの通常の増減であり、病院の逼迫や重症化の報告もなく、IHR・WPRO基準のいずれにも明確に該当しない。
triage.notes: 地方保健当局が監視を継続している通常の季節性インフルエンザ報道であり、病院の機能不全や重症例急増の証拠はない。

article.articleHeadline: Kasus Influenza di Depok Melonjak hingga 90 Persen, Anak dan Lansia Paling Banyak Terinfeksi
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Influenza cases in Depok rise by as much as 90 percent, with children and the elderly most affected.
article.articleSummary: Influenza cases in Depok, West Java, rise with a 90% laboratory-confirmed positivity rate over the past four weeks, increasing from 140 to 266 cases as of 25 September 2026, according to Depok Health Office data. Disease is caused by influenza A and B viruses. The surge affects primarily children under five and the elderly, but also individuals with chronic conditions or compromised immunity. Reported influenza symptoms include fever or chills, cough, sore throat, runny or congested nose, muscle or body aches, headache, and fatigue. Health official Devi Mayori emphasizes vigilance without overreaction, urging simple risk-mitigation measures: healthy lifestyle, cough and sneeze etiquette, regular handwashing, avoiding close contact with influenza patients, and masking when sick. Vaccination against influenza is recommended for vulnerable groups to reduce complications.

triage.headline_ja: デポック市でインフルエンザ患者が90%増加、子供と高齢者に感染者多数
triage.triage_reason: 季節性インフルエンザの地域的な増加であり、通常の公衆衛生対応の範囲内だが、症例数増加の推移は継続観察が必要。
triage.notes: 季節性インフルエンザA・Bウイルスによる地域内流行。地方保健当局が対応中で、外部支援の必要性は示唆されていない。

article.articleHeadline: 世卫组织：刚果（金）埃博拉疫情扩散至新地区
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: WHO: Ebola outbreak in the Democratic Republic of the Congo has spread to new areas.
article.articleSummary: The Bundibugyo strain of Ebola has spread to new areas in the Democratic Republic of the Congo, with 7 provinces and 63 health zones reporting cases. As of September 23, 2026, the DRC has 7,890 laboratory-confirmed Ebola cases and 3,799 deaths. WHO Director-General Tedros Adhanom Ghebreyesus warned that conflict and population displacement hinder access for health workers and complicate contact tracing, raising transmission risk. Africa CDC head Jean Kaseya estimated about 60 direct or indirect contacts per case; by that rate, tracing should cover over 400,000 people, yet only around 30,000 contact names have been identified, and more than 80% of new confirmed cases are not on contact lists. Tedros noted there is no approved vaccine or treatment for Bundibugyo Ebola virus, making the response harder and potentially deterring people from seeking care at treatment centers.

triage.headline_ja: WHO:コンゴ民主共和国のエボラ出血熱の流行が新たな地域に拡大
triage.triage_reason: コンゴ民主共和国で7,890例・3,799人の死亡が確認され、7州63保健地域に拡大しており、ワクチン・治療法未承認かつ接触者追跡が不十分でヒト-ヒト感染拡大リスクが高いため、IHR基準・WPRO基準ともに複数該当しフルRRAが必要。
triage.notes: WHO事務局長およびAfrica CDC責任者が公式にコメントしており、国際的な関心と支援の必要性が高いことが示唆される。承認済みワクチン・治療薬がないブンディブギョ株である点が特に懸念material。

article.articleHeadline: കേരളം നേരിടുന്ന ഏറ്റവും ഗുരുതര പ്രശ്നമായി തെരുവുനായ ശല്യം മാറി. ഇക്കൊല്ലം ഇതുവരെ കടിയേറ്റത് 2.18 ലക്ഷം പേർക്ക്. പേവിഷബാധ മൂലം14 മരണങ്ങൾ. അപകടങ്ങളിൽ പരിക്കേൽക്കുന്നവരും നിരവധി. ഏറ്റവും മരണങ്ങൾ കൊല്ലത്തും തിരുവനന്തപുരത്തും. ദയാവധം തീരുമാനിച്ചെങ്കിലും നടപ്പാക്കാനായില്ല. വന്ധ്യകരണം, വാക്സിനേഷൻ, ഷെൽട്ടർ എന്നിവയൊന്നും ഫലപ്രദമല്ല. വാക്സിനേഷന് തദ്ദേശസ്ഥാപനങ്ങൾ ചെലവിട്ടത് 18കോടി. സർക്കാരും തദ്ദേശ സ്ഥാപനങ്ങളും ഒത്തുപിടിച്ച് തെരുവുനായ ശല്യം തീർക്കുമോ
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Kerala's street dog menace has become the state's most serious problem. So far, 2.18 lakh people have been bitten. 14 deaths due to rabies. Many are injured in incidents. Most deaths have occurred in Kollam and Thiruvananthapuram. Although a humane decision was taken, it could not be implemented. Sterilization, vaccination, and shelters are not effective. Local authorities spent 18 crore on vaccination. Will the government and local bodies come together to end the street dog menace?
article.articleSummary: Kerala's street-dog menace is the state's most serious public-health challenge, with 2.18 lakh people bitten and 14 rabies deaths. Kollam district reports the most rabies deaths (four), followed by Thiruvananthapuram (three); the issue is pervasive across urban and rural areas. Despite Supreme Court directions to move street dogs from public spaces, shelters and related measures remain inadequate; sterilization, vaccination, and shelters have not been effective. A humane euthanasia policy for rabies-positive or aggressive dogs was approved but not implemented. Local bodies have allocated about 18 crore for vaccination, yet execution has been poor. Implementing humane measures requires ABC centers, trained dog-handlers, and transport facilities. The state needs forest-adjacent shelter land and an integrated, long-term program—eight to ten years of sustained ABC and mass vaccination, plus improved waste management, responsible pet ownership, and wildlife monitoring.

triage.headline_ja: ケララ州で野良犬問題が深刻化、今年これまでに21.8万人が咬傷、狂犬病により14人死亡
triage.triage_reason: 狂犬病による死亡が継続的に発生し公衆衛生上の懸念はあるが、国際的拡大や渡航貿易制限のリスクは低く、既知の風土病的問題であるため経過観察とする。
triage.notes: 狂犬病はインドで風土病的に発生している疾患であり、ヒト-ヒト感染や国際拡大のリスクは低い。地域の公衆衛生・動物管理体制の課題として継続的な情報収集が望ましい。

article.articleHeadline: Deteksi Dini Penyakit Menular, Rutan Balikpapan Gelar Skrining Kesehatan Warga Binaan
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Early Detection of Infectious Diseases, Balikpapan Detention Center Holds Health Screening for Inmates
article.articleSummary: On 26 September 2026, Balikpapan Class IIA Detention Center conducted health screening for inmates, in collaboration with the Balikpapan City Health Office via Gunung Samarinda and Baru Tengah Health Centers. Health teams from both centers, together with Rutan Balikpapan's Clinic staff, carried out early-detection checks to identify health conditions and enable timely follow-up when risks are found. In addition to screening, inmates received education on HIV and tuberculosis, covering transmission, prevention, risk factors, and the importance of regular health examinations. The initiative emphasizes hygiene, clean environments, and shared awareness to prevent infectious disease spread within the facility. Rutan Head Andre Silalahi stressed ongoing collaboration with health authorities to guarantee nondiscriminatory access to healthcare, aiming for a healthy, safe, humane prison environment and prompt medical care.

triage.headline_ja: 感染症の早期発見、バリクパパン拘置所が受刑者向け健康スクリーニングを実施
triage.triage_reason: 定例的な健康スクリーニング・教育活動であり、アウトブレイクや異常事態の報告はない。IHR・WPRO基準のいずれにも該当しない。
triage.notes: 本記事はHIV・結核に関する予防的健康診断・教育プログラムの実施報告であり、具体的な感染症発生や症例急増の報告ではないため、対象国リストへの計上も見送る。

article.articleHeadline: 全球公衛焦點掃描：剛果伊波拉疫情擴散與新藥研發動態 - 民視新聞網
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Global Public Health Focus Scan: Ebola Outbreak in Congo Spreads and Updates on New Drug Development - Formosa TV News Network
article.articleSummary: As of 26 September 2026, the Ebola outbreak in the Democratic Republic of the Congo, caused by Bundibugyo virus, continues to spread, now reaching two additional health zones and expanding across seven provinces and 63 districts. A confirmed mpox (monkeypox) case was also reported in Bunia, a city in the northeast, placing further strain on local health systems already engaged in Ebola response. The dual public health challenges underscore sustained transmission and the importance of reinforced surveillance, rapid case finding, isolation, and contact tracing in affected areas. Ongoing updates indicate the outbreak remains active in multiple jurisdictions, with cross-regional spread requiring coordinated district- and province-level interventions.

triage.headline_ja: 世界公衆衛生フォーカススキャン:コンゴでエボラ流行が拡大、新薬開発の動向も
triage.triage_reason: エボラ(Bundibugyoウイルス)がDRCで7州63地区に拡大し複数の保健区に及んでいること、加えてMpox症例も確認され医療体制に負荷がかかっており、IHR基準・WPRO基準ともに複数該当するためフルRRAへ進むべきシグナルと判断。
triage.notes: 記事はエボラ(Bundibugyoウイルス)の拡大とBuniaでのMpox確認を主題としており、両疾患ともDRC国内の事象。渡航・貿易制限の有無は記事中に明記なし。

article.articleHeadline: ASP in Spanien: Wie stark trifft die Seuche den Schweinefleisch-Export?
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: ASF in Spain: How hard is the outbreak hitting the pork export?
article.articleSummary: Spain’s African swine fever (ASF) outbreak near Barcelona persists. As of 24 Sep 2026, 379 ASF cases have been reported; around 396 animals tested positive near Barcelona, with 354 wild boars captured in the last week. Since the outbreak, roughly 12,300 wild boars have been hunted. Containment relies on ~350 barriers, 130+ traps, and enforcement by about 1,100 personnel, 351 hunters and 400 dogs. Economic impact: live pig imports plunged ~45% in volume to 2.05 million animals; value down ~47% to €157 million. Jan–Jun 2026 pork exports totaled over 1.35 million tonnes worth ~€3.6 billion. China remained the top destination by volume (16.2%) but cut orders 22% in volume and 35% in value; by value, France led (€464m), with China at ~€380m. Catalonia accounted for 49% of volume/value, Aragon 29%/24%. After winter 2025/26 restrictions (~35% exports blocked), H1 2026 shows relief; authorities aim to finish eradication this year.

triage.headline_ja: スペインのASF：豚肉輸出への打撃はどれほどか？
triage.triage_reason: 本イベントは家畜(野生イノシシ・豚)のアフリカ豚熱(ASF)であり、ヒトへの感染性はなく公衆衛生上の直接的リスクは認められない。また発生国スペインは対象国リストに含まれない。
triage.notes: ASFはブタ・イノシシの動物疾病であり人獣共通感染症ではないため、ヒトの公衆衛生イベントとしての基準には該当しない。記事は貿易・経済影響（対中国輸出減少等）を扱っているが、発生国はスペインであり対象国リストに含まれず、中国は輸出先としての言及のみで発生国ではない。
